translations.source: "We now have 4-month-old mice that are non-diabetic that used to be diabetic," he added.
translations.reference: Ugbu a, anyị nwere ụmụ oke ọnwa anọ na-arịabu ọrịa shuga mana ha anaghị arịazi ya.
translations.hypothesis: "Ugbu a, anyị nwere ụmụ anụ ọhịa dị ọnwa anọ, bụ ndị na-adịghị n'ọnụ ọgụgụ shuga, mana bụ ndị nwere ọrịa shuga tupu." ka ọ gbakwunyere.

translations.source: Dr. Ehud Ur, professor of medicine at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia and chair of the clinical and scientific division of the Canadian Diabetes Association cautioned that the research is still in its early days.
translations.reference: Dr. Ehud Ur, ọkammụta nke ọgwụ na Mahadum Dalhousie nọ na Halifax, Nova Scotia na onye isi oche nke ngalaba ụlọ ọgwụ na sayensi ahụ nke Òtù Ọrịa Shuga ndị Kanada dọrọ aka na ntị na nnyocha ahụ ka nọ n’oge ndị mbụ ya.
translations.hypothesis: Dọkta Ehud Ur, onye nkuzi nkeọma na Mahadum Dalhousie na Halifax, Nova Scotia, na onye isi nke ngalaba ọmụmụ na sayensị nke Ụlọ ọrụ Ndị ọrịa Diabetes nke Canada, kwuru na nyocha a ka dị na ngalaba mbụ ya.

translations.source: Like some other experts, he is skeptical about whether diabetes can be cured, noting that these findings have no relevance to people who already have Type 1 diabetes.
translations.reference: Ka ndị ọkachamara ndị ọzọ, o kwenyeghị na a ga agwọtanwu ọrịa shuga, o depụtara na ihe nchọpụta ndị a enweghị mmetụta nye ndị nwere ọrịa shuga Taịp 1.
translations.hypothesis: Dị ka ụfọdụ ndị ọkà mmụta ndị ọzọ, ọ na-enwe obi abụba banyere ma ọ bụrụ na ọ bụrụ na ọ bụrụ na ọ nwere ike ịgwọ ọrịa shuga, sị na ihe ndị a echere adịghị emetụta ndị ahụ nke ọrịa shuga ụdị 1.

translations.source: On Monday, Sara Danius, permanent secretary of the Nobel Committee for Literature at the Swedish Academy, publicly announced during a radio program on Sveriges Radio in Sweden the committee, unable to reach Bob Dylan directly about winning the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, had abandoned its efforts to reach him.
translations.reference: N'ụbọchị Mọnde, Sara Danius, onye odeakwụkwọ Nobel kọmitii maka akwụkwọ agụmagụ n'ụlọ akwụkwọ Swidin, kwuputara n'ihu ọha na ihe omume redio na Sveriges Redio dị na Swidin, mgbe o siere kọmitii ahụ ike inweta Bob Dilan gbasara mmeri na ihe nrite Nobel na mpaghara Akwụkwọ agụmagụ nke afọ 2016 o nwetara, na ha ahapụlarị mbọ ha na-agba inweta ya.
translations.hypothesis: N'Ụbọchịị Mọnde, Sara Danius, onye ode akwụkwọ nke Nobel Committee maka Litrọ na Swedish Academy, kọwara n'ọdịnihu n'oge mmemme redio nke Sveriges Radio na Sweden na komite ahụ, nke enweghị ike ịkpọtụrụ Bob Dylan kpọmkwem maka mmeri ya na Nobel Prize maka Litrọ na afọ 2016, ekwetara ọrụ ya iji kpọtụrụ ya.

translations.source: Danius said, "Right now we are doing nothing. I have called and sent emails to his closest collaborator and received very friendly replies. For now, that is certainly enough."
translations.reference: Danius si, "Ugbu a anyị anaghị eme ihe ọbụla. Akpọọlam oku ma zijere onye ya na ya kacha arụkọ ozi ịntaneetị ma nwetekwa ụsa nnabata. Ugbua nke ahụ zuru oke."
translations.hypothesis: Danius kwuru, "N'ụjụụ ugbu a, anyị anaghị eme ihe ọ bụla. Amalitewo m ịkpọ oku na enyela email ndị enyi ya kachasị nso, ma nweta azịza dị mma. Maka ugbu a, ọ bụrụ n'ezie, nke ahụ zuru ezu."

translations.source: Previously, Ring's CEO, Jamie Siminoff, remarked the company started when his doorbell wasn't audible from his shop in his garage.
translations.reference: Na mbu,onye isi Ring, Jamie Siminoff, kwuru na ulo oru ya bidoro mgbe onughi mgbirigba ya n’ulo ahia ya di na ime ebe o na adoba ugboala ya.
translations.hypothesis: N'oge gara aga, Jamie Siminoff, onye isi ụlọ ọrụ Ring, kwuru na ụlọ ọrụ ahụ malitere mgbe ekwenyeghị ya ụda nke belu anya ya site na ụlọ ahịa ya nke dị n'ime ụlọ gara-ájà ya.

translations.source: He built a WiFi door bell, he said.
translations.reference: O kwuru na ọ rụrụ mgbịrịgba ụzọ ji WiFi arụ ọrụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bịarutere ịmepụta akara ọdụ ụzọ nke na-arụ ọrụ site na netwọkụ WiFi, ka ọ gwara anyị.

translations.source: Siminoff said sales boosted after his 2013 appearance in a Shark Tank episode where the show panel declined funding the startup.
translations.reference: Siminoff sị na orire ahịa gbaliri elu ka ogosichara n'ihe nkiri Shak Tank n'afọ 2013 ebe ndị ndozi ihe ngosi jụrụ itinye ego na mbido.
translations.hypothesis: Siminoff kwuru na ahịa zuru ezu mgbe ọ pụtara na ihe omume "Shark Tank" na afọ 2013, ebe ndị otu nyocha ahụ jụrụ inye ego maka ụlọ ọrụ ahụ.

translations.source: In late 2017, Siminoff appeared on shopping television channel QVC.
translations.reference: Na ngwụcha 2017, e gosiri Siminoff na chanel igbe onyonyo QVC.
translations.hypothesis: N'ime afọ 2017, Siminoff pụtara na ọwa televishọn nke na-ere ngwaahịa, nke a na-akpọ QVC.

translations.source: Ring also settled a lawsuit with competing security company, the ADT Corporation.
translations.reference: Ring dozikwara otu ikpe ha na ụlọ ọrụ ọzọ na-ahụ maka nchekwa, ADT Corporation nwere.
translations.hypothesis: Ring kwesịkwara iweghachite ụdị ikpe a họpụrụ n'etiti ya na ụlọ ọrụ nche dị iche, bụ ADT Corporation.

translations.source: While one experimental vaccine appears able to reduce Ebola mortality, up until now, no drugs have been clearly demonstrated suitable for treating existing infection.
translations.reference: Ọ bụ eziokwu na otu ọgwụ mgbochi aka na-ele anya egosila na o nwere ike ịbelata oke ndị mmadụ ji anwụ n'ihi ọrịa Ebola, mana ruo ugbu a, enwebeghi ọgwụ ọbụla gosiri hooha na o nwere ike ịgwọ onye bu ọrịa a.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bụrụ na otu ọgwụji nyocha na-atụ aro na ọ nwere ike belata ọnụ ọgụgụ mmadụ na-anwụ n'ihi Ebola, mana ruo ugbu a, ọ dịghị ọgwụ ọ bụla ewebatara n'ụzọ doro anya na ọ dị mma iji gwọọ mmerụ ahụ nke na-adị ugbu a.

translations.source: One antibody cocktail, ZMapp, initially showed promise in the field, but formal studies indicated it had less benefit than sought in preventing death.
translations.reference: Otu antibọdi, ZMapp, gosiburu olileanya, mana ka elebakwuru ya anya, achọpụtara na ọbaghị uru na-igbochi ọnwụ ka esiri chee.
translations.hypothesis: Otu ụdị ọgwụ nke a na-akpọ ZMapp, na mbụ, gosiri ọtụtụ ihe dị mma, mana nyocha ndị ọzọ kọwara na ọ nweghị uru dị ukwuu dị ka e chọrọ iji gbochie ọnwụ.

translations.source: In the PALM trial, ZMapp served as a control, meaning scientists used it as a baseline and compared the three other treatments to it.
translations.reference: Na nnwale PALM, eji ZMapp mere ihe nruba ama, nke a putara na ndi sayentist jiri ya mee baseline tunyere ogwugwo ato ozo.
translations.hypothesis: N'ime ule PALM, ZMapp jiri dị ka ihe atụ, ya bụ, ndị ọkà mmụta sayensị jiri ya dị ka ihe mbụ ma họọrọ ihe ọgwụ ndị ọzọ atọ wee were ya tụnyere ha.

translations.source: USA Gymnastics supports the United States Olympic Committee's letter and accepts the absolute need of the Olympic family to promote a safe environment for all of our athletes.
translations.reference: USA Jimnastiks kwadoro ozi Olimpik Kọmitii Amerịka dere ma kwere kwa na oge eruola mgbe onye ọbụla na-eme Olimpiks aghaghị ịrụkọ ọrụ ọnụ ịhụ na ndị egwuregwu anyị niile nọ na nchekwa.
translations.hypothesis: USA Gymnastics na-akwado akwụkwọ nke United States Olympic Committee, ma na-anakwa otú ọ dị mkpa ka e guzobe ebe dị mma na nchekwa maka ndị na-asọmpi niile anyị.

translations.source: We agree with the USOC's statement that the interests of our athletes and clubs, and their sport, may be better served by moving forward with meaningful change within our organization, rather than decertification.
translations.reference: Anyi kwere na ihe USOC dere na odimma ndi egwuregwu anyi na klob ha nakwa egwuregwu ga enweta uru n’ihu karia ma o buru na enwe mgbanwe n’ulo oru anyi kama inapu ndi mmadu asambodo ha.
translations.hypothesis: Anyị na-ekwenye na otu USOC kwuru na ọ nwere ike ịbụ na ọ ga-adị mma maka ndị ọkpụkpọ anyị, ụlọ ọrụ anyị, na egwuregwu ha, ka anyị gbanwee ihe dị mkpa n'ime otu anyị, kama ịkwepụ anyị n'ọkwa anyị.

translations.source: USA Gymnastics supports an independent investigation that may shine light on how abuse of the proportion described so courageously by the survivors of Larry Nassar could have gone undetected for so long and embraces any necessary and appropriate changes.
translations.reference: Mpaghara jimnasktik nke obodo USA kwadoro nlebara anya nke onwe nke nwere ike igosi ka mmegbu nke ndị lanarịrị ihe mberede Larị Nassar kọwapụtara nwere ike ịbụ ihe metere aka a na-amaghị maka ya na anabatakwa mgbanwe ndị kwesịrị ekwesị.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị USA Gymnastics na-akwado nyocha onwe ya nke nwere ike ibunye ọdịdị na otú ihe mgbu nke ụdị ahụ, nke ndị ntorobịa ahụ na-akọkarịta n'ụzọ dị ukwuu, nwere ike ịlaghachite na-enweghị ihe ọ bụla dị ogologo oge, ma ha na-anabata mgbanwe ọ bụla dị mkpa na ziri ezi.

translations.source: USA Gymnastics and the USOC have the same goal — making the sport of gymnastics, and others, as safe as possible for athletes to follow their dreams in a safe, positive and empowered environment.
translations.reference: Egwuregwu Jimnastik nke mba USA na ndi USOC nwere otu ebumnobi - ime egwuregwu jimnastik, na ndi ozo, enweghi iyi-egwu dika ike kwere nye ogwu egwu isoro nro ha n’uzo n’enweghi iyi-egwu, ziri-ezi na gburu-gburu akwadoro akwado.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị na-ahụ maka egwuregwu gymnastics na USA, na USOC, nwere otu ebumnobi - iji mee ka egwuregwu gymnastics, na ndị ọzọ, dị mma dị ka ọ ga-abụ, ka ndị na-ese egwuregwu nwee ike ịgbaso ọmụmụ ha n'otu ebe dị mma, dị ọcha, na ebe ebe ha nwere ikike.

translations.source: Throughout 1960s, Brzezinski worked for John F. Kennedy as his advisor and then the Lyndon B. Johnson administration.
translations.reference: Na 1960 ga, Brzezinski rụụrụ John F. Kennedy ọrụ dị ka onye ndụmọdụ ya ma mechaa rụọkwa otu ihe ahụ n'oge ọchịchị Lyndon B. Johnson.
translations.hypothesis: N'oge 1960, Brzezinski rụrụ ọrụ maka John F. Kennedy dị ka onye nlekọta ya, wee rụọ ọrụ n'okpuru ọchịchị Lyndon B. Johnson.

translations.source: During the 1976 selections he advised Carter on foreign policy, then served as National Security Advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981, succeeding Henry Kissinger.
translations.reference: N’ime nghọpụta nke 1976, ọ dụrụ Carter ndụmọdụ gbasara iwu ndị mba ofesi, wee rụzie ọrụ dịka Onye ndụmọdụ Nchekwa Mba (NSA) site na 1977 ruo 1981, na nnọchi Henry Kissinger.
translations.hypothesis: N'oge nhọrọ nke afọ 1976, ọ nyere Carter ndụmọdụ gbasara ndọzi mba ọzọ, wee jiri nwayọọrụ rụọ ọrụ dịka Onye Nlekọta Nchekwa Ọha (NSA) site n'afọ 1977 ruo 1981, ma were ebe Henry Kissinger.

translations.source: As NSA, he assisted Carter in diplomatically handling world affairs, such as the Camp David Accords, 1978; normalizing US–China relations thought the late 1970s; the Iranian Revolution, which led to the Iran hostage crisis, 1979; and the Soviet invasion in Afghanistan, 1979.
translations.reference: Dịka NSA, o nyere Carter aka n’ijikwa ihe omume mbaụwa n’ụzọ kwesiri ekwesi, dị ka Nkwekọrịta Kampụ Devidi, 1978; ihazigharị mmekọrịta US–Chaịna n'afọ ndị dị na ngwụcha agbata afọ 1970 na 1980; Mgbanwe ọchịchị Iran, nke butere nsogbu njigide Iran, 1979; mbuso agha nke Sọviet n’ime Afghanistan, 1979.
translations.hypothesis: Dịka Onye Isi Oche Ndị Nchekwa Nkebi, ọ nyere Carter aka n'ịzi otu ọtụtụ oké okwu mba ụwa, dịka nkwekọrịta Camp David nke afọ 1978; na ịkwalite mmekọrịta n'etiti United States na China n'oge na-agwụ na afọ 1970; mgbanwe nke Iran, bụ nke butere ọghọm nke ndị a kpọrọ "Iran hostage crisis" na afọ 1979; na ịbọ ha ahụ nke Soviet na Afghanistan na afọ 1979.

translations.source: The movie, featuring Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone, received nominations in all major categories.
translations.reference: Aghoputara ihe nkiri ahu Ryan Gosling na Emma Stone no n’ime ya maka nturu ugo di iche iche.
translations.hypothesis: Ihe nkiri ahụ, bụ nke Ryan Gosling na Emma Stone so n'ụlọ ọrụ ya, natara atụmatụ maka ọtụtụ ụdị ọrụ dị mkpa.

translations.source: Gosling and Stone received nominations for Best Actor and Actress respectively.
translations.reference: E deturu aha Gosling na Stone n'otu ndị nwere ịnweta akara nturu ugo Best Aktọ na Best Aktres, n'otu n'otu.
translations.hypothesis: Gosling na Stone nwetara atụmanya maka onye na-akpọrọ ihe kacha mma na onye na-akpọrọ ihe nwanyị kacha mma, n'otu n'otu.

translations.source: The other nominations include Best Picture, Director, Cinematography, Costume Design, Film-editing, Original Score, Production Design, Sound Editing, Sound Mixing and Original Screenplay.
translations.reference: Nhọrọ ndị ọzọ gụnyere Foto Kacha, Onye nhazi, Ọrụ nkiri fiim, Nhazi Kọstuum, Ọrụrụ fiim, Exigbo Egwu fiim Mbu, Nhazi mmeputa, Ọrụrụ Ụda, Mwụghari Ụda na Ezigbo Mmemme mbu.
translations.hypothesis: Ụfọdụ ụkpụrụ ndị ọzọ gụnyere: ihe nkiri kacha mma, onye nduzi, ihe ndekọ vidio, nhazi uwe, mmezi vidio, egwu nke e kere n'ime, nhazi mmepụta, mmezi olu, mmepụta olu, na akụkọ nke e dere n'ime.

translations.source: Two songs from the movie, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) and City of Stars, received nominations for best original song. Lionsgate studio received 26 nominations — more than any other studio.
translations.reference: Abụ abụọ sitere n’ihenkiri ahụ, Ọdishọn (Onye Iberibe Ahu Rọrọ Nrọ) na Obodo Kpakpandu gasị, nwetara aha maka abụ mbụ kacha mma. N’ihe nlere nke Lionsgate natara ntinye aka 26 — karia ihe ndi a.
translations.hypothesis: Abụọ abụ sitere na ihe nkiri ahụ, "Audition" (The Fools Who Dream) na "City of Stars," natara atụmatụ maka abụ kacha mma. Ụlọ ọrụ Lionsgate natara atụmatụ 26 – karịa ụlọ ọrụ ọ bụla ọzọ.

translations.source: Late on Sunday, the United States President Donald Trump, in a statement delivered via the press secretary, announced US troops would be leaving Syria.
translations.reference: Ka ụbọchị Sọnde nọ na ngwụcha, Onye isi ọchịchị obodo Yunaịted Steeti bụ Donald Trọmp, kwuru n'ozi e nyere site n'aka onye ode akwụkwọ ndị nta akụkọ, nke sịrị na ndị agha obodo US ga ahapụ Sirịa.
translations.hypothesis: N'abalị Sunday, mgbe ehihie, onye isi obodo Amerika, Donald Trump, n'ụzọ ozi nke onye ọkụkọ ya, họpụtara okwu bụ na ndị agha nke Amerika ga-apụ na Syria.

translations.source: The announcement was made after Trump had a phone conversation with Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.
translations.reference: E kwuputara nke a mgbe Trump na Onyeisiala mba Tọkị bụ Rejep Tayyip Erdoghan nwechara mkparịtaụka n'ekwentị.
translations.hypothesis: Otu ọkwa akụpọrọ ahụitụ mgbe Trump họpụtara oku telefọn na onye isi obodo Turkey, Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.

translations.source: Turkey would also take over guarding captured ISIS fighters which, the statement said, European nations have refused to repatriate.
translations.reference: Mba Turkey ga-anarakwa ichebe ndị agha ISIS enwudere ndị, ozi ahụ kwuru, na mba ndị dị na Europe ajụla ịnabata ha ọzọ.
translations.hypothesis: Tọọkị ga-ewe ọrụ ichekwa ndị agha ISIS bụ ndị a kwụpụrụ, nke bụ ihe ozi ahụ kwuru na mba ndị Europe amabeghị ịbụọ ha n'ụlọ.

translations.source: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory already widespread, but provides details fossils generally cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.
translations.reference: Nke a na-egosi na, opekata mpe, ụfọdụ daịnosọọ nwere abụba; ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ nwere echiche a taa, mana ihe ọzọ bụ na ọ na-egosi anyị ihe fosịl enweghị ike igosi, dịka agba na nhazi akụkụ-atọ.
translations.hypothesis: Nke a ọ bụghị naanị na ọ na-akụkọtakwa na enwere ọ dịkarịa nta ụfọdụ ndị dinosaur nwere ọkpụkpụ, nke bụ eziokwu nke amaliwe, kamakwa ọ na-enye ozi ndị ọkpụkpụ na-enweghị ike inye, dịka agba na usoro echiche atọ.

translations.source: . Scientists say this animal's plumage was chestnut-brown on top with a pale or carotenoid-colored underside.
translations.reference: Ndị ọka mmụta sayensị kwuru na abụba anụmanụ a nwere mgbe ọ na-acha aja aja n'elu ma na-acha ka karotenọịd n'okpuru.
translations.hypothesis: . Ndị ọkà mmụta na-ekwu na akpụkpụ nke anụ ahụ a bụ agwa aja aja n'elu, yana akpụkpụ ọzọ na-acha ọcha ma ọ bụ agwa nke carotenoid n'okpuru.

translations.source: The find also grants insight into the evolution of feathers in birds.
translations.reference: Ihe nchọpụta ahụ nyekwara ntụziaka gbasara mmalite ipu nku n'ụmụ nnụnụ.
translations.hypothesis: Okwu a na-enye anyị ozi dị mkpa banyere otú ejiri ahụhụ na-etolite n'ime anụmanụ dị ka nkita.

translations.source: Because the dinosaur feathers do not have a well-developed shaft, called a rachis, but do have other features of feathers — barbs and barbules — the researchers inferred the rachis was likely a later evolutionary development that these other features.
translations.reference: Maka na nku ajọ anụ daịnosọ enweghị akụ toro nke ọma, nke a na akpọ rachis, ma na o nwere ihe ndị ọzọ nke na-enwe - dịka barbs na barbules - ndị nchọpụta ihe kwuru na ọdịka rachis ọbụ ihe mechara si n'ihe ndị ọzọ a were toputa.
translations.hypothesis: N'ihi na ejiri ọkwụ nke dinosaur ahụ adịghị nke ọma, nke a na-akpọ "rachis," mana ọ nwere ihe ndị ọzọ dị ka ọkwụ—"barbs" na "barbules"—, ndị nyocha ahụ kwuru na o yikarịrị ka "rachis" ahụ bụ ihe pụrụ ịmepụta n'oge mgbe e mere mmụọ ahụ, mgbe e mechara, karịa ihe ndị ọzọ ahụ.

translations.source: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.reference: Nhazi nku ha gosiri na ha ejighi ya efe efe kama ha ji ya edokwa okpomọkụ maọbụ eme ihe ngosi. Ndị nchọpụta ihe tụrụ aro sị na, n'agbanyeghị na nke a bụ ọdụ daịnosọ na-eto eto, ihe ngosi ahụ gosiri nku anụ tochara etocha na-abụghị nku nwa anụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ụkpụrụ nke ọkpụkpụ ahụ na-egosi na ha anaghị eji ha maka igwu egwu, kamakwa maka idozi okpomọkụ ma ọ bụ maka igosi ihe. Ndị nyocha ahụ kwuru na, ọ bụrụ na nke a bụ ihi nke dinosaur dị obere, ihe atụ ahụ na-egosi ọkpụkpụ nke onye zuru oke, ọ bụghị ọkpụkpụ nke obere ọkwụ.

translations.source: The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.reference: Ndị nchọpụta ihe tụrụ aro sị na, n'agbanyeghị na nke a bụ ọdụ daịnosọ na-eto eto, ihe ngosi ahụ gosiri nku anụ tochara etocha na-abụghị nku nwa anụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị nyocha ahụ kwuru na, ọ bụrụ na nke a bụ akụ nke obere onye ndụndụ, nlele ahụ na-egosi ọkpụkpụ nke onye zuru oke, ọ bụghị ọkpụkpụ nke obere onye.

translations.source: A car bomb detonated at police headquarters in Gaziantep, Turkey yesterday morning killed two police officers and injured more than twenty other people.
translations.reference: Otu bọmbụ gbawara n'isi ụlọ ọrụ ndị uwe ojii n’ime Gaziantep, Tọkii ụtụtụ ụnyaahụ na-egbu ndị uwe ojii abụọ ma merụọ ahụ ihe karịrị ndị mmadụ ọzọ iri abụọ.
translations.hypothesis: Ebe agha nke ụgbọ ala merụrụ ahụ na ụlọ ọrụ ndị uwe ojii na Gaziantep, na Turkey, n'ụtụtụ ụbọchị gara aga, ma ọ wụrụ abụọ n'ime ndị uwe ojii ahụ ọkụ, ma gbasara karịa ndị mmadụ iri abụọ ndị ọzọ.

translations.source: The governor's office said nineteen of the injured were police officers.
translations.reference: Ụlọ ọrụ gọvanọ kwuru iri na itoolu na ndị merụrụ ahụ bụ ndị uwe ojii.
translations.hypothesis: Ozi sitere n'ofis gọvanọ ahụ na ndị metụtara uwe ahụhụ iri na ise bụ ndị ọrụ ndị uwe nchekwa.

translations.source: Police said they suspect an alleged Daesh (ISIL) militant of responsibility for the attack.
translations.reference: Ndị uwe ojii sị na ha na-enyo otu onye a na-ebo ebubo na ọ bụ onye agha nnupuisi Daesh (ISIL) dịka onye mere mwakpo ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị ọchịchịọ ọdịmma kwuru na ha na-achọpụta onye a na-akpọ na ọ bụ onye na-eme ihe ike nke Daesh (ISIL) bụ onye nwere ụkpọrụ maka ọrụ a maara dị ka "ịgbachi."

translations.source: They found the Sun operated on the same basic principles as other stars: The activity of all stars in the system was found to be driven by their luminosity, their rotation, and nothing else.
translations.reference: Ha chọpụtara na Anyanwụ na-arụ ọrụ n’otu ụdị isi iwu dịka kpakpandu ndị ọzọ: A chọpụtara na omume kpakpandu niile nọ na sistemụ bụ onwunwu ọkụ na ntụgharị ha na-anya ha, ma ọ nweghị ihe ọzọ..
translations.hypothesis: Ha chọpụtara na Anyanwụ na-arụ ọrụ site na usoro ndị ọkachamara ahụ yiri usoro ndị ọzọ na-eme ka ndị ọkụ nke ọzọ na-achaacha: A chọpụtara na ọrụ niile nke ndị ọkụ niile na sistemụ ahụ na-adịgide n'ihi ọkụ ha, ịdịgide ha na-agbanụ, na ihe ọ bụla ọzọ.

translations.source: The luminosity and rotation are used together to determine a star's Rossby number, which is related to plasma flow.
translations.reference: A na-ejikọta ọnụ ọnwụnwụ ọkụ na ntụgharị ya amata akara Rossby nke otu kpakpando, nke metụtara na ọwụwụ plasma.
translations.hypothesis: Agbụrụ na mgbanwe ọkpụkpụ nke otu ihe ndụ (star) na-eji eme atụmatụ maka ọnụọgụ Rossby ya, nke nwere mmekọrịta na usoro mmiri plasma.

translations.source: The smaller the Rossby number, the less active the star with respect to magnetic reversals.
translations.reference: Ka akara Rossby na-adị obere karịa, ka arụmarụ na-adịkwu obere nke kpakpando n’ikwanye ugwu nye ụmụ ntụgharị nke ihendọta.
translations.hypothesis: O dika na ọnụọgụ Rossby dị nta, otú ahụkwa ka ọ bụrụkwa na ọkụ ahụ adịghị enwe ọtụtụ mgbanwe na ike eletrik ya.

translations.source: During his trip, Iwasaki ran into trouble on many occasions.
translations.reference: Na njem ya, Iwasaki banyere na nsogbu ọtụtụ mgbe.
translations.hypothesis: N'oge ọ dị na njem ahụ, Iwasaki enwetakwara nsogbu ọtụtụ oge.

translations.source: He was robbed by pirates, attacked in Tibet by a rabid dog, escaped marriage in Nepal and was arrested in India.
translations.reference: Ndị ohi ụgbọ mmiri zuri ya ohi, nkịta ara lụsoro ya ọgụ, o siri na-alụm di na nwunye gbalaga na Nepal a tụọ ya nga na India.
translations.hypothesis: A bị ndị onye ohi eme ihe ọjọọ, a kụrụ ya n'ebe ahụ na Tibet site n'otu nkịta na-efe, ọ gbapụrụ n'ụlọ nkwari akụ na Nepal, ma a kọrọ ya n'India.

translations.source: The 802.11n standard operates on both the 2.4Ghz and 5.0Ghz frequencies.
translations.reference: Oke 802.11n na arụ ọrụ ma na frikwensi nke 2.4Ghz na nke 5.0Ghz.
translations.hypothesis: Usoro 802.11n na arụ ọrụ na akụkọ mmiri abụọ: 2.4GHz na 5.0GHz.

translations.source: This will allow it to be backwards compatible with 802.11a, 802.11b and 802.11g, provided that the base station has dual radios.
translations.reference: Nke a ga-enye ya ohere ka dịrị na ndakọta nlaghachi azụ na 802.11a, 802.11b na 802.11g, ma ọ bụrụhaala na isi ebe ahụ ụgbọigwe na-anọ nwere redìò abụọ.
translations.hypothesis: Nke a ga-eme ka ọ nwee ike ịrụ ọrụ na ụdị teknụzụ 802.11a, 802.11b, na 802.11g, ọ bụrụ na e nwere ọwa ọkụ abụọ na ebe nrụnye ọwa ahụ.

translations.source: The speeds of 802.11n are substantially faster than that of its predecessors with a maximum theoretical throughput of 600Mbit/s.
translations.reference: Na 802.11n, ọsịsọ ya ji nnukwu ihe kara nke ndị bu ya ụzọ; ya mere, ọrụ ọ na-arụpụta ga-eru 600Mbit/s.
translations.hypothesis: Oge ọrụ nke 802.11n karịrị oke oge ọrụ nke ndị ọzọ tupu ya, yana ọ nwere ike ịrụ ọrụ na ọsọ kacha elu nke 600Mbit/s n'oge ọkacha.

translations.source: Duvall, who is married with two adult children, did not leave a big impression on Miller, to whom the story was related.
translations.reference: Duval, bụ onye lụgoro nwanyị ma mụta ụmụ abụọ bụgoro okenye, a hapụghịrị Mila onyere akọọrọ akụkọ nnukwu ihe nlere anya.
translations.hypothesis: Duvall, onye lụrụ di na ụmụ abụọ nke ha adịrịla afọ, adịghị etinye ọtụtụ echiche na uche Miller, onye o mechara akụkọ ahụ.

translations.source: When asked for comment, Miller said, "Mike talks a lot during the hearing...I was getting ready so I wasn't really hearing what he was saying."
translations.reference: Mgbe a sị ya kwuo okwu gbasara ihe mere, Mila kwuru, "Mike na-ekwu ọtụtụ okwu mgbe a na-eme ọnụnụ ahụ...anọ m na-akwado ya mere na anụghị m ihe ọ na-ekwu."
translations.hypothesis: Mgbe ajụrụ ya maka otú o si echeta, Miller kwuru, "Mike na-ekwu okwu ọtụtụ mgbe n'oge nyocha ahụ... Ana m atụgharị uche, yabụ na amụghị nke ọma ihe o na-ekwu."

translations.source: "We will endeavour to cut carbon dioxide emissions per unit of GDP by a notable margin by 2020 from the 2005 level," Hu said.
translations.reference: Anyị ga-agba mbọ belata ikuku kabon dioxide kwa nke Mkpokọta ihe nrụpụta obodo site na oke 2020 site n'ọkwa 2005, Hu kwuru.
translations.hypothesis: "Anyị ga-agba mbọ belata mmepụta carbon dioxide n'otu ụlọ ọrụ ọ bụla, site na afọ 2005, site na nnukwu uru tupu afọ 2020," ka Hu kwuru.

translations.source: He did not set a figure for the cuts, saying they will be made based on China's economic output.
translations.reference: O kwughi oke a ga-akwụ, kama ọ sị na a ga-ele anya na nrụpụta akụ na ụba China wee kwụọ ụgwọ.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ naghị enye ụkpụrụ ọ bụla maka mbelata ahụ, sị na mbelata ahụ ga-eme gbasie uru akụ na ụba nke China.

translations.source: Hu encouraged developing countries "to avoid the old path of polluting first and cleaning up later."
translations.reference: Hu gbara obodo ndị na emepe emepe ume "ka ha ghara itinye aka n'usoro omume mgbe ochie bụ ibu ụzọ metọọ were kpochawa ma emechaa."
translations.hypothesis: Hu kwuru na mba ndị na-etolite n'ụlọ ahụ kwesịrị "izu anya n'ụzọ ochie nke ịmalite imegbu gburugburu ebe obibi tupu ịmalite ịkwọchi mmetụta ahụ."

translations.source: He added that "they should not, however, be asked to take on obligations that go beyond their development stage, responsibility and capabilities."
translations.reference: O tinyekwara na "ha ekwela ka adị ha buru ibu karịrị ogugo uto na ike ha."
translations.hypothesis: Ọ gwakwara na "ọ baghịrị ekwu ka ha ji, ọ dịghị ka a ga-akpọ ha ka ha jide ọrụ na-erughị ọkwa mmepe ha, ọrụ na-erughị ọrụ ha na ike ha."

translations.source: The Iraq Study Group presented its report at 12.00 GMT today.
translations.reference: Òtù Mmụta Irak ahụ gosipụtara nchọpụta ya na 12.00 GMT taa.
translations.hypothesis: Otu ndụmọdụ nke Iraq họpụtara akụkọ ha n'eleele elekere 12 nke ụtụtụ, n'oge GMT, taa.

translations.source: It warns No one can guarantee that any course of action in Iraq at this point will stop sectarian warfare, growing violence, or a slide toward chaos.
translations.reference: Ọ dọrọ aka na ntị sị na onweghị onye ga-ekwe nkwa na usoro ọbụla e jiri mee ihe na mba Aịrak ugbu a ga-akwụsị agha otu, ntolite ihe ike, maọbụ ndabanye n'ọgbaghara.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ na-agwa anya na ọ dịghị onye nwere ike ịkwụsị ihe ọ bụla dị ka usoro omume na Iraq n'oge a, nke ga-ebelata okwu okpukpu dị n'etiti ndị mmadụ, ime ka ime ihe ọjọọ belata, ma ọ bụ gbochie ọdịda na mpempepe.

translations.source: The Report opens with plea for open debate and the formation of a consensus in the United States about the policy towards the Middle East.
translations.reference: Di Rịpọt bidoro site n'ịkpọ oku ka onye ọbụla nwee mkpakọrịta ụka ma nwee nkwekọrịta n'Amerịka gbasara etu aga na-esi akpaso ndị Etiti Ọwụwa Anyanwụ agwa.
translations.hypothesis: Akụkọ a malitere site n'ịkọwa mkpa maka mkparịta ụka ọha na ebe ọdịnala, yana mkpali maka inwe otu echiche n'etiti ndị America banyere usoro atụmatụ gbasara mpaghara Mgbere Ohu.

translations.source: The Report is highly critical of almost every aspect of the present policy of the Executive towards Iraq and it urges an immediate change of direction.
translations.reference: Ọ fọrọ obere ka mkpesa ahụ kwuo okwu ofụma gbasara akụkụ nile nke iwu ndị isi n'ebe mba Aịrak nọ ma ọ na-akwado mgbanwe ụzọ ozigbo ozigbo.
translations.hypothesis: Akụkọ a na-akpali akpali ihe ọtụtụ nsụgharị nke ọrụ gọọmentị a na-eme ugbu a banyere Iraq, ọ na-akpọrọ maka mgbanwe ozugbo na ụzọ e si eme ihe.

translations.source: First among its 78 recommendations is that a new diplomatic initiative should be taken before the end of this year to secure Iraq’s borders against hostile interventions and to re-establish diplomatic relations with its neighbors.
translations.reference: Nke izizi n'ime nkwado iri asaa na asatọ ya bụ na a ga-eso usoro ọchịchị ọhụrụ tupu ọgwụgwụ afọ ị hụ na echebere oke ala Aịrak megide ndị ọchọ okwu ma wughachikwa mmekọrịta ọchịchị ha na agbataobi ha.
translations.hypothesis: Uru lịọdị na mbụ n'ime ihe atọ ndị a tụrụ anya, bụ na a ga-amalite ọrụ ọhụrụ n'akụkọ diplomacy tupu ngwụsị afọ a, iji chebe mpụga Iraq megide mgbe ọ bụla ha ga-atọgbu ya, ma ọ bụkwa iweghachi mmekọrịta diplomatic na ndị obodo ya.

translations.source: Current senator and Argentine First Lady Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner announced her presidential candidacy yesterday evening in La Plata, a city 50 kilometers (31 miles) away from Buenos Aires.
translations.reference: Onye omeiwu nakwa nwunye onyeisiala mba Argentina bụ Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner mara ọkwa na mgbede ụnyahụ na La Plata, obodo nọpụrụ kilomita 50 (maịlụ 31)site na Buenos Aires na ọ ga-eso zọọ ọkwa onyeisiala mba Argentina.
translations.hypothesis: Onyeisi ụlọ akwụkwọ anya bụ Senator Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner, bụkwa nwunye onyeisi mba Argentina, họpụtara onwe ya maka ọkwu ụlọ ọrụ ahụ n'abalị nke ụzu, na obodo La Plata, nke dị kilomita 50 (maịl 31) site na Buenos Aires.

translations.source: Mrs. Kirchner announced her intention to run for president at the Argentine Theatre, the same location she used to start her 2005 campaign for the Senate as member of the Buenos Aires province delegation.
translations.reference: Ọ bụ n'Ajentaịn Tiyeta ka Lọọlọ Kirchner kwuputara ebumnuche ya ịzọ maka ọkwa onye isi ala, otu ebe ahụ ọ ji bido kampen ya maka ọkwa Sịnetọ na 2005 dịka onye otu nke ndị mpaghara Buenos Aires zigara.
translations.hypothesis: Madam Kirchner họpụtara echiche ya ịgaba ọrụ dịka onye isi obodo, na ụlọ ihe nkiri Argentine, bụ ebe ahụkwa ọ jiri malite ọrụ ya na afọ 2005 iji gbaa maka oche na Senate dị ka onye nọ na otu ndị na-anọchọta steeti Buenos Aires.

translations.source: The debate was sparked by controversy over spending on relief and reconstruction in the wake Hurricane Katrina; which some fiscal conservatives have humorously labeled "Bush's New Orleans Deal."
translations.reference: Ọ bụ esemokwu maka mmefu ego na nkwado na nrụgharị e mere mgbe Oke ikuku Katrina gasịrị kpatara arụmụka a; ụfọdụ ndị kweere na iji nwayọ emefụ ego steeti akọwaala mmefụ a n'ụzọ ntọrọmọchị dịka "Nkwekọrịta Niu Ọlịns nke Bush mere".
translations.hypothesis: Aghụghụ ahụ malitere n'ihi mgbaghara banyere ego eji na-akpọrọ na ịnweta ụlọ na-emeghe mgbe ahụ Hurricane Katrina merụrụ. Ụfọdụ ndị na-elekọta ego nke ukwuu, n'ụzọ dị mkpa, kpọrọ ya "Nkwekọ New Orleans nke Bush."

translations.source: Liberal criticism of the reconstruction effort has focused on the awarding of reconstruction contracts to perceived Washington insiders.
translations.reference: Nnyocha nke mgbalị nrụgharị chere ihu na-enye ndị e chere na ha bụ ndị si Wọshịntịn ọrụ nrụgharị.
translations.hypothesis: Ụfọdụ ndị na-akparị, n'ihe gbasara ọrụ mmelite ahụ, emeela mkparị na ụzọ eji nyere nkekọrịta maka mmelite ahụ, ọkachasị na e nyere ha ndị a na-achọpụta na ha bụ ndị nwere mmekọrịta dị n'etiti ndị na-achị Washington.

translations.source: Over four million people went to Rome to attend the funeral.
translations.reference: Ihe karịrị nde mmadụ anọ gara Rom maka olili ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: Karịa ụmọọka abụọ na ise, ndị mmadụ gara Rome iji sonye na emume ewuputa nwoke ahụ.

translations.source: The number of people present was so large that it was not possible for everybody to gain access to the funeral in St. Peter's Square.
translations.reference: Ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị mmadụ nọ ebe n'ahụ dị ukwuu nke na o kweghị mmadụ niile omume inwèta òhèrè n'olili ozu na St. Peter Square.
translations.hypothesis: Oge ahụ, ọtụtụ mmadụ nọrị na ebe ahụ, na ọ dịghị ka ọ bụrụ nke ọma ka onye ọ bụla wee nwee ohere ịbịa na ezi-izizi ahụ nke mere na St. Peter's Square.

translations.source: Several large television screens were installed in various places in Rome to let the people watch the ceremony.
translations.reference: Etinyere ọtụtụ nnukwu igwe onyonyo n'ọtụtụ ebe na Rom, ka ndị mmadụ nwee ike kirie mmemme ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: Akwụkwọ vidiyo dị ukwuu ebe atọrọ n'ọtụtụ ebe dị na Roma iji nye ndị mmadụ ohere ịlele emume ahụ.

translations.source: In many other cities of Italy and in the rest of the world, particularly in Poland, similar setups were made, which were viewed by a great number of people.
translations.reference: N'ọtụtụ obodo Itali ndị ọzọ ma na uwa nile, ọkachasị na Poland, emere nkwazi dị ka ibe ya, nke ọtụtụ mmadụ hụrụ.
translations.hypothesis: N'ọtụtụ obodo ndị ọzọ na Italy, na ụwa niile, karịsịa na Poland, e guzobere usoro ndị yiri nke a, nke ọtụtụ mmadụ kpebiri ịlele.

translations.source: Historians have criticized past FBI policies for focusing resources on cases which are easy to solve, especially stolen car cases, with the intent of boosting the agency's success rate.
translations.reference: Ndị akụkọala akọtọla ụmụ iwuikikere FBI ndị gara aga maka ịgbado anya akụrụngwa n’ụmụ okwu ndị dị mfe ikpezi, tụmadị ụmụ okwu ụgbọ ala ezuru ezuru, n’iji ebumnobi nke ịkwalite nsìàga ọganihu ha.
translations.hypothesis: Amadi ndị na-akụkọ akụkọ gara aga emeghị mmetụta dị mma banyere usoro ndị FBI nke gara aga, n'ihi na ha na-etinye akụ na ụzọ na ikpe ndị dị mfe iji họrọ, karịsịa ikpe gbasara ụgbọ ala ndị a butara, iji mee ka ọrụ FBI dịkwuo mma.

translations.source: Congress began funding the obscenity initiative in fiscal 2005 and specified that the FBI must devote 10 agents to adult pornography.
translations.reference: Nzukọ omeiwu bidoro ikwado nnyocha ihe ndị dị aṅaa na fiskal n'afọ 2005 ma kwukwaa kpọmkwem na ngalaba FBI ga ewepụtarịrị ndị ozi iri maka ihe ngosi na-akpali agụụ mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị.
translations.hypothesis: Ọtụtụ ndị otu na National Assembly malitere inye ego maka ọrụ nke e mere iji gbochie ihe ndị na-emetụta ihu, na afọ 2005. Ha kwuputara na FBI (Federal Bureau of Investigation) ga-eji ndị ọrụ rụọ ọrụ iri na otu maka ịlele ihe ndị a na-akpọ "pornografi maka ndị ọrịa."

translations.source: Robin Uthappa made the innings highest score, 70 runs in just 41 balls by hitting 11 fours and 2 sixes.
translations.reference: Robin Uthappa nwetara akara kachasị na innings, ọsọ 70 n’ime naanị ụmụ bọọlụ 41 site n’ịkụ anọ ugboro 11 na isii ugboro 2.
translations.hypothesis: Robin Uthappa kụrụ ọkpụrụ ọkpụrụ anya nke kacha elu na egwuregwu ahụ, bụ nke 70, site na ịgba bọọlụ 41 naanị, site na ịgba bọọlụ anọ na-abụ abụọ na bọọlụ abụọ na-agba elu.

translations.source: Middle order batsmen, Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid, performed well and made a hundred-run partnership.
translations.reference: Ndị na-eji batị akụ n'usoro etiti, Sachin Tendulkar na Rahul Dravid rụrụ ọrụ nke ọma ma mee otu nrụkọọrụ nke ọsọ-otu narị.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị egwuregwu egwuregwu nke nwere ọkwa dị n'etiti, Sachin Tendulkar na Rahul Dravid, mere nke ọma wee mee otu egwuregwu ebe ha họpụtara otu narị ụkwụ.

translations.source: But, after losing the captain's wicket India only made 36 runs loosing 7 wickets to end the innings.
translations.reference: Mana, mgbe ha dara wicket India naanị mere 36 gbara ọ tọpụ wicket 7 iji kwụsị innings.
translations.hypothesis: Mana, mgbe India gburu onyeisi otu egwuregwu ahụ, ha emeghị ọtụtụ egwuregwu, ha nwetara naanị 36 egwuregwu, ma gburu ndị otu egwuregwu 7 tupu ha kwụsị egwuregwu ahụ.

translations.source: U.S. President George W. Bush arrived in Singapore the morning of November 16, beginning a week-long tour of Asia.
translations.reference: U.S. Onye isi oche Jiọj W. Bush batata Singapọ n'ụtụtụ ụbọchị nke iri na isii nke ọnwa Nọvemba, iji malite njem njegharị mba Eshia nke ga-anọzu otu izuụka.
translations.hypothesis: Onye isi obodo Amerika, George W. Bush, bịara Singapore n'ụtụtụ nke 16 Nọvemba, wee malite njem ọzụzụ nke otu izu gbasara mba ndị dị na Asia.

translations.source: He was greeted by Singapore's Deputy Prime Minister Wong Kan Seng and discussed trade and terrorism issues with the Singapore Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong.
translations.reference: Onye na-esote onye isi iche mba Sịngapọ bụ Wong Kan Seng nabatara ya ma ya na onye isi oche mba Sịngapọ bụ Lee Hsien Loong kparịtara ụka gbasara ahịa na ihe iyi ọha egwu.
translations.hypothesis: Onye ahụ zutere onyeisi ọkacha mma nke Singapore, Wong Kan Seng, wee kwurịta okwu gbasara azụmahịa na nsogbu ndị ohi na onyeisi obodo Singapore, Lee Hsien Loong.

translations.source: After a week of losses in the midterm election, Bush told an audience about the expansion of trade in Asia.
translations.reference: Mgbe otu izu gasịrị ebe ọ dara ada na ntuliaka ọkara oge, Bush gwara ndị na-ege ya ntị maka mmụba nke azụmahịa n'Eshia.
translations.hypothesis: Mgbe otu izu nke mmerụ ahụ na nhọrọ etiti, Bush kọwara otu ọtụtụ ndị na-echeta ya banyere mmepe azụmahịa na Asia.

translations.source: Prime Minister Stephen Harper has agreed to send the government's 'Clean Air Act' to an all-party committee for review, before its second reading, after Tuesday's 25 minute meeting with NDP leader Jack Layton at the PMO.
translations.reference: Onye isi oche Stivin Hapa ekwetala iziga iwu ọhụrụ nke ikuku ọcha nke gọọmenti ebe a ga elebara ya anya, tupu nleba anya nke abụọ, ma emechaa nzukọ ga-ewe ya na onye isi NDP bụ Jak Leeton nkeji iri abụọ na ise n'ụbọchị Tuzde na PMO.

translations.source: Layton had asked for changes to the conservatives' environmental bill during the meeting with the PM, asking for a "thorough and complete rewriting" of the Conservative party's environmental bill.
translations.reference: Layton arịọla maka mgbanwe nye akwụkwọ iwu gburugburu ebe obibi nke ndị otu ọdịkaọgadị mgbe ya na PM nwere nnọkọ, na-arịọ maka "ndezigharị zuru oke nke zuru ezu" nke iwu gburugburu ebe obibi nke ndị otu ọdịkaọgadị
translations.hypothesis: Layton chọrọ mgbanwe na usoro iwu gbasara gburugburu ebe obibi nke ndị na-akwado ọtụtụ echiche, n'oge mkparịta ụka ya na Prisident, wee kọwaa na ọ chọrọ "mmezi zuru oke na mmezi ọhụrụ" na usoro iwu ahụ nke otu ndọrọndị nke ndị na-akwado ọtụtụ echiche.

translations.source: Ever since the Federal Government stepped in to take over funding of the Mersey hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, the state government and some federal MPs have criticised this act as a stunt in the prelude to the federal election to be called by November.
translations.reference: Kemgbe gọọmenti weere ọnọdụ ịkwụ ụgwọ ụlọ ọgwụ Mersey na Devọnpọt, Tasmania, gọọmenti steeti na ụfọdụ ndị ome iwu gọọmenti etiti ekwuola okwu megide omume a sị na ọ bụ mere mere n'ihu maka ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị gọọmenti etiti na-abịa na Nọvemba.
translations.hypothesis: Kemgbe mgbe ọchịchị obodo ahụ batara ịkwụnye ụgwọ maka ụlọ ọgwụ Mersey na Devonport, Tasmania, gọọmentị steeti ahụ na ụfọdụ ndị otu naasị obodo ahụ emeela atụmụta n'ihe a, sị na ọ bụ ihe a na-eme iji mee ka mmadụ na-ele anya, dị ka nnukwu ihe a ga-eme tupu nhọrọ obodo ahụ nke ga-adị na Nọvemba.

translations.source: But Prime Minister John Howard has said the act was only to safeguard the facilities of the hospital from being downgraded by the Tasmanian government, in giving an extra AUD$45 million.
translations.reference: Mana Prime Minista John Howard ekwuola na ihe a mere bụ naanị ka ichebe ụmụ akụrụngwa nke ụlọ ọgwụ ahụ site n'aka mwedàta siri n'aka gọọmentị Tasmania, n'inye mmezi nke nde AUD$45.
translations.hypothesis: Mana Prisident Minista John Howard kwuru na ihe omume ahụ bu naanị iji chebe ụlọọgwụ ahụ site na mmebi nke gọọmentị Tasmania, ma ọ gafere ego ọzọ nke AUD$45 miriyọn.

translations.source: According to the latest bulletin, sea level readings indicated a tsunami was generated. There was some definite tsunami activity recorded near Pago Pago and Niue.
translations.reference: Dika obere akwụkwọ akụkọ kachasị ohuru si kwuo, ogugu oke osimiri gosiri na oke ikuku malitere. O doro anya na enwere oru oke ikuku na mpaghara Pago Pago na Niue.
translations.hypothesis: Dịka akụkọ ọhụrụ ahụ si akọ, ihe ngosi ọkụkpụ ụsọ mmiri egosila na e mere tsunami. E nwetakwara ụfọdụ ihe atụ nke mmadụ na-akpọ tsunami nso ebe Pago Pago na Niue.

translations.source: No major damage or injuries have been reported in Tonga, but power was temporarily lost, which reportedly prevented Tongan authorities from receiving the tsunami warning issued by the PTWC.
translations.reference: O nweghị nnukwu mmebi ma ọ bụ mmerụ ahụ akọrọna n’ime Tonga, mana e were ọkụ nwa oge, nke a kọrọ gbochiri ndị ọchịchị Tongan ịnata ịdọ aka na ntị maka ajọ ebili mmiri PTWC ahụ nyere.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ dịghị ihe mgbu ma ọ bụ mmerụ dị ukwuu nke a tụrụ anya na e gosiri na Tonga, mana ọkụ eletrik kwụsịrị na nkeji ole na ole, nke, dị ka akụkọ sịrị, gbochiri ndị ọchịchị Tonga ịnabata ihe ngosi ihe egwu mmiri tsunami nke PTWC nyere.

translations.source: Fourteen schools in Hawaii located on or near coastlines were closed all of Wednesday despite the warnings being lifted.
translations.reference: Ụlọ akwụkwọ iri na anọ na Hawaii ndị nọ na ma ọ bụ na nso akụkụ mmiri bụ ndị e mechiri na Wenezdee niile na-agbanyeghị ndọ aka na ntị niile ewepụrụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ụlọ akwụkwọ iri na anọ na Hawaii, nke dị n'akụkụ osimiri ma ọ bụ nso ya, ejiri akwụghị ụgwọ niile na ụbọchị Wednesday ahụ, ọ bụrụkwa na ozi gbasara ihe ọjọọ ahụ eweghara.

translations.source: U.S. President George W. Bush welcomed the announcement.
translations.reference: Onyeisiala mba Amerịka bụ George W. Bush nabatara ọkwa ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: Onye isi obodo Amerika, George W. Bush, ji obi ụtọ nabata ozi ahụ.

translations.source: Bush spokesman Gordon Johndroe called North Korea's pledge "a major step towards the goal of achieving the verifiable denuclearization of the Korean peninsula."
translations.reference: Gọdọn Jọndro onye na-ekwuchitere Bush okwu kpọrọ nkwa Nọt Koria bụ "nzọụkwụ dị oke mkpa na ịnweta mwepụ were anya nke ngwa agha nuklia ndị Koria."
translations.hypothesis: Onye akụkọ akụkọ nke Gọvanọ Bush, Gordon Johndroe, kpọrọ olulu nke Kọria Utara ahụ "usọ nke ukwuu na-agafe n'ụzọ dị mma iji rute ebumnuche nke inwe ọdịmma na ịkwụsị mgbawa n'akụkụ ahụ nke Kọria."

translations.source: The tenth named storm of the Atlantic Hurricane season, Subtropical Storm Jerry, formed in the Atlantic Ocean today.
translations.reference: Oke ifufe nke iri abụrụ aha nke oge oke ifufe Atlantik, Oke ifufe akpọrọ Jeri, gbakọrọ n'oke osimiri atlantik taa.
translations.hypothesis: Ọdụndụ nke iri nke aji egwu ikpuru mmiri nke Atlantic, bụ "Subtropical Storm Jerry," merụrụ ahụ na Oké Osimiri Atlantic taa.

translations.source: The National Hurricane Center (NHC) says that at this point Jerry poses no threat to land.
translations.reference: Ụlọọrụ Etiti na-ahụ maka Ajọ ifufe (NHC) kwuru sị n’oge a Jeri abụghị ihe iyi egwu nye ala.
translations.hypothesis: Otu Ndị na-elekọta ihe mgba ọchịchị nke mba (National Hurricane Center, NHC) kwuru na, n'oge a, Jerry abụghị ihe egwu na-emetụta ala.

translations.source: The U.S. Corps of Engineers estimated that 6 inches of rainfall could breach the previously damaged levees.
translations.reference: Ụlọ Ọrụ nke Ndị injinia nke U.S. mere atụmatụ na mmiri mmiri dị inchi isii nwere ike ịgabiga ihe mgbochi ide mmiri e mebibiri na mbụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị ọrụ injinịa nke United States kwesịrị echiche na mmiri ozuzo nke inches 6 nwere ike ibute mmebi ọzọ na akụkụ ụkwụ dị n'akụkụ osimiri nke e biputere n'oge gara aga.

translations.source: The Ninth Ward, which saw flooding as high as 20 feet during Hurricane Katrina, is currently in waist-high water as the nearby levee was overtopped.
translations.reference: Ward Itoolu, nke hụrụ oke ide mmiri ruru ihe dị ka feet iri abụọ n'oge Ajọ Ifufe Katrina, nọ na nnukwu mmiri na eru ukwu ma gafere akwa levee nọ nso.
translations.hypothesis: Ebe a na-akpọ "Ninth Ward," bụ ebe ụdị mmiri dị oke ọnụ, ruo ụkwụ mmadụ, n'oge mgbe mmiri ozuzo nke Hurricane Katrina rutere. Ugbu a, ebe ahụ nwere mmiri ruo ọkpuru mmadụ, ebe mmiri gbasara n'elu akụ ụkwụ dị nso.

translations.source: Water is spilling over the levee in a section 100 feet wide.
translations.reference: Mmiri n’aghafu n’otu akuku levee obodobo ya di 100feet.
translations.hypothesis: Mmiri na-agbaze n'elu akụkụ ụkpụrụ mmiri ahụ, na mpaghara nke nwere ọkwa dị elu dị elu dị ka ụkwụ 100.

translations.source: Commons Administrator Adam Cuerden expressed his frustration over the deletions when he spoke to Wikinews last month.
translations.reference: Onye nchikwa commons Adam Cuerden gosiputara iwe ya  n’elu ihe eghichapuru mgbe ogwara Wikinews okwu n’onwa gara gara.
translations.hypothesis: Onye njikwa nke Commons, Adam Cuerden, gosiri echiche ya na-adịghị mma banyere mmebi ndị ahụ mgbe ọ na-ekwu okwu na Wikinews naanị ọnwa gara.

translations.source: "He [Wales] basically lied to us from the start. First, by acting as if this was for legal reasons. Second, by pretending he was listening to us, right up to his art deletion."
translations.reference: O (Wales) n’ezie turu anyi asi site na mbido. Mbu, site na ikpa-agwa ka ihe a bu okwu iwu, Nke abuo, site na igho-aghugho na ona ege anyi nti, ruori mgbe ehichapuru nka ya.
translations.hypothesis: "Ọ [Wales] kwuru akụkọ ahụghị na mbụ. Ọkara, site n'ịdị ka ọ na-eme ya maka ihe ndị metụtara iwu. Ọkara abụọ, site n'ịdị ka ọ na-anụ anyị, ruo mgbe ọ wepụtara ihe nkiri ya."

translations.source: The community irritation led to current efforts to draft a policy regarding sexual content for the site which hosts millions of openly-licensed media.
translations.reference: Mkpadu iwe obodo butere maka mgbali ide iwu gbasara ihe ngosi mmekọahụ na webụsaịtị na-egosi ọtụtụ ihe.
translations.hypothesis: Mmetụta ọjọọ nke e nwere n'etiti ndị mmadụ mere ka a malite ọrụ iji dee usoro iwu gbasara ihe ndị metụtara mmekọrịta uwe na akụrụngwa maka saịtị ahụ, nke na-eji ọtụtụ nde ihe nkesa ihe ndekọ nke bụrụ ndị na-ekesa ya n'efu.

translations.source: The work done was mostly theoretical, but the program was written to simulate observations made of the Sagittarius galaxy.
translations.reference: Ọrụ arụrụ bụkarịrị nke iwu a ka na enyocha enyocha, mana edere usoro omume ihe ahụ ka o gosipụta ihe ahụtara ụyọkọ kpakpando Sajiterius.
translations.hypothesis: Ọrụ ahụ nke e mere bụkarị nke ndụmọdụ, mana ngwaọrụ ahụ e dere bụ iji mepụta ihe ndị a na-ahụ n'ime galaksi Sagittarius.

translations.source: The effect the team was looking for would be caused by tidal forces between the galaxy's dark matter and the Milky Way's dark matter.
translations.reference: Mmetụta otu ahụ nọ na-achọ ga-esite n'aka ikikere taịdị ndị dị n'etiti mata ojii nke galaxy na mata ojii nke Milky Way.
translations.hypothesis: Ọrụ ahụ dịka otu ahụ na-achọ bụ nke ga-abụ n'ihi ike nke mmiri osimiri dị n'etiti ihe omume na-adịghị ahụ anya nke galaksi ahụ na ihe omume na-adịghị ahụ anya nke Milky Way.

translations.source: Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy.
translations.reference: Dị ka ọnwa na etinye ndọta n’ụwa, na-akpata elili mmiri, etu ahụ ka Milky Way ahụ si etinye ike na galazi Sagittarius ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: Dị ka anyanwụ na-emetụta ụwa, na-ebute mmiri osimiri, otu ahụkwa, Milky Way na-emetụta galaksi Sagittarius, na-ebute ọrụ dị iche iche.

translations.source: The scientists were able to conclude that the dark matter affect other dark matter in the same way regular matter does.
translations.reference: Ndị ọka mmụta sayensị nwere ike kwubie na dak mata na emetụta dak mata ibe ya otu mata si eme.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị ọchịchịmma ahụ nwere ike ikwenye na ihe omume na-adịghị ahụ anya na-emetụta ihe omume ndị ọzọ na-adịghị ahụ anya n'otu ụzọ ahụ dị ka ihe omume dị gbanụ na-emetụta ihe ndị ọzọ dị gbanụ.

translations.source: This theory says that most dark matter around a galaxy is located around a galaxy in a kind of halo, and is made of lots of small particles.
translations.reference: Tiori a na-ekwu na imirikiti mata dị oji gburugburu otu ụyọkọ kpakpando dị na gburugburu otu ụyọkọ kpakpando n'otu ụdị halo, ma e mejupụtara ya site n'ọtụtụ urughuru dị obere.
translations.hypothesis: Akụkọ a na-ekwu na ihe ndị na-acha ọcha karịrị na mpaghara gbara gbara galaksi bụ ihe dị mkpa, ọtụtụ n'ime ha bụ obere ngwaahịa.

translations.source: Television reports show white smoke coming from the plant.
translations.reference: Ụmụ akụkọ si telivishọn na-egosi anwụrụ ọcha si n'igwe nrụpụta ahụ apụta.
translations.hypothesis: Akụkọ televizhan na-egosi osisi ọcha na-apụta site na ụlọ ọrụ ahụ.

translations.source: Local authorities are warning residents in the vicinity of the plant to stay indoors, turn off air-conditioners and not to drink tap water.
translations.reference: Ndị isi obodo na-adọ ndị bi n'obodo gburugburu igwe ọrụ ahụ aka na ntị ka ha nọrọ n'ime ụlọ, gbanyụọ ntụ oyi ma ghara iṅu mmiri na-agba n'ụlọ.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị ọchịchị obodo na-adụ ndị bi nso ụlọ ọrụ ahụ ọtụtụ ụzọ iji chebe ha: ha na-agwa ha ka ha nọrọ n'ụlọ, kpọchie akụrịta ikuku, ma ọ bụghị ịsa mmiri site na tapị.

translations.source: According to Japan's nuclear agency, radioactive caesium and iodine has been identified at the plant.
translations.reference: Na ndabere nke ụlọ ọrụ nuklia Japan, a chọpụtawo n'ụlọ mmepụta cesium na ayodiin dị redioaktivu.
translations.hypothesis: Dịka otu ọchịchị nke ụlọ ọrụ nuklia Japan si kwuo, a matara na caesium na iodine na-emetụta ahụahụ na-emetụta ahụ na ụlọ ọrụ ahụ.

translations.source: Authorities speculate that this indicates that containers holding uranium fuel at the site may have ruptured and are leaking.
translations.reference: Ndị isi chere na nke a na-egosi na o nwere ike gbọmgbọm ndị ji mmanụ ụgbọ yurenium agbawaala ma na-ehi ehi.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị ọchịchị na-akọwapụta na nke a nwere ike ịbụ ihe ngosi na akwụkwọ ụlọ ọrụ nke nwere ihe mkpụrụ uranium nwere ike ịgbaji ma na-esi n'ime ya.

translations.source: Dr. Tony Moll discovered the Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) in the South African region KwaZulu-Natal.
translations.reference: Dr. Toni Moll chọpụtara nje Tubakụlọsis (XDR-TB) nke na-emegide ọgwụ na ngalaba Sawụt Afrịka nke KwaZulu-Natal.
translations.hypothesis: Dọkta Tony Moll chọpụtara ọrịa Tuberculosis (TB) nke na-adịkarị na-adị izeegwu na-enweghị mmerụ ahụ (XDR-TB) na mpaghara KwaZulu-Natal na South Africa.

translations.source: In an interview, he said the new variant was "very highly troubling and alarming because of the very high fatality rate."
translations.reference: N'otu ajụjụ ọnụ, ọ sị na bke ọhụrụ a na enye "oke nsogbu ma bụrụkwa ihe egwu n'ihi ogugo ọnwụ dị elu si na ya abịa."
translations.hypothesis: N'oge otu mkparịta ụka, ọ kwuru na ụdị ọrịa ahụ ọhụrụ ahụ "na-adighi mma nke ukwuu ma na-atụ ụjọ n'ihi ọnụ ọgụgụ mmadụ na-anwụ n'ihi ya."

translations.source: Some patients might have contracted the bug in the hospital, Dr. Moll thinks, and at least two were hospital health workers.
translations.reference: Ụfọdụ ndị ọrịa enweela ike ibute ọrịa ahụ n'ụlọ ọgwụ, Dr. Moll cheere, ma ihe dị ka abụọ bụ ndị ọrụ ụlọ ọgwụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ọtụtụ ndị ọrịa nwere ike ịnweta ọrịa ahụ n'ụlọ ọgwụ, Dr. Moll na-eche, ma o kwesịrịkarịrị na ma ọ dịkarịa nta abụọ n'ime ha bụ ndị ọrụ ahụike nọ na ụlọ ọgwụ ahụ.

translations.source: In one year's time, an infected person may infect 10 to 15 close contacts.
translations.reference: Na otu afo n’abia abia, onye butara nje nwere ibunye ya mmadu 10 ruo 15 n’eru ya nso.
translations.hypothesis: N'ime otu afọ, onye nwere ọrịa ahụ nwere ike ịgwasa ndị mmadụ 10 ruo 15 bụ ndị nwere nso n'ime ya.

translations.source: However, the percentage of XDR-TB in the entire group of people with tuberculosis still seems to be low; 6,000 of the total 330,000 people infected at any particular moment in South Africa.
translations.reference: Agbanyeghị, pacentị nke XDR-TB nọ n’ime òtù niile nke ndị nwere ụkwara nta ka yiri ka ọ dị obere; 6,000 nke mpokọta ndị mmadụ 330,000 nwetere ọrịa ahụ n’oge ọ bụla n’ime South Afrịka.
translations.hypothesis: Agụkwa, ọnụọgụ nke XDR-TB n'ime otu ahụ niile nke ndị nwere ọrịa tuberculosis ka dị nta; e nwere ndị 6,000 n'ime ndị 330,000 ndị metụtara ọrịa ahụ n'oge ọ bụla na South Africa.

translations.source: The satellites, both of which weighed in excess of 1,000 pounds, and traveling at approximately 17,500 miles per hour, collided 491 miles above the Earth.
translations.reference: Satịlaịtị ndị ahụ, abụọ nke na-anyị arụ karịa nke gafere paụnd 1,000, ma na-ekwo ọsọ n’ọdịka maịlị kwa awa 17,500, sukọrọ ọnụ maịlị 491 n’elu Eluụwa.
translations.hypothesis: Satọlitị abụọ ahụ, ọ bụla nke ibu ya karịrị 1,000 paọndu, na-agafe na ọsọ nke ihe dị ka 17,500 kilomita n'eleghari, gbakọrọ aka n'elu ụwa, n'ebe dị anya kilomita 491.

translations.source: Scientists say the explosion caused by the collision was massive.
translations.reference: Ndị ọka mmụta sayensị sị na mgbasa nkụkọta isi ahụ butere dị ukwu.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị ọkà mmụta na-ekwu na mgbasa ahụ nke mere n'ihi mmebi ahụ bụ nnukwu otu.

translations.source: They are still trying to determine just how large the crash was and how the Earth will be affected.
translations.reference: Ha ka na anwale ịchọpụta etu ibu mkpọka ahụ dị ma etu ọ ga-esi emetụta Uwa.
translations.hypothesis: Ha ka na-anwa ịmatakwu banyere ọkwa mụmụ nke ọkụ ahụ, na otu ụwa ga-emetụta ya.

translations.source: The United States Strategic Command of the U.S. Department of Defense office is tracking the debris.
translations.reference: United States Strategic Command nke ụlọ ọrụ Ngalaba Nchebe U.S. na-esochi irighiri ihe ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ofisi nke United States Strategic Command, nke bụ otu akụkụ nke U.S. Department of Defense, na-elele ihe ndị merụrụ ahụ.

translations.source: The result of plotting analysis will be posted to a public website.
translations.reference: A ga-ezìga ozī nyocha nke nkata akpara n'otu weebụsaịtị ọha.
translations.hypothesis: Nsonụ nke nyocha a ga-etinye na weebụsaịtị ọha.

translations.source: A doctor who worked at Children's Hospital of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania will be charged with aggravated murder after her mother was found dead in the trunk of her car Wednesday, authorities in Ohio say.
translations.reference: Otu dibia-bekee onye rubuuru oru ulo-ogwu umuaka nke pittsburgh, Pennysylvania ka aga ekpe ikpe banyere igbu-mmadu nke akpasuru-iwe ka ahuchara nne ya na azu ugbo-ala na-onwu n’ubochi Wednesde, ka ndi isi no na Ohio kwuru.
translations.hypothesis: Onye dọkịta nke rụrụ ọrụ na ụlọọgwụ ụmụaka nke Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, ga-akpọọ ya aha maka mmeghachi omume nke ịmakụ mmadụ, mgbe e chọpụtara nne ya nwụrụ n'ime akụ ụgbọ ala ya na Wednesdey, dịka ndị ọchịchị na Ohio si kwuo.

translations.source: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, was found in Blue Ash, Ohio, a suburb approximately 15 miles north of Cincinnati lying on the ground beside the road in a T-shirt and underwear in an apparently heavily medicated state.
translations.reference: Ahuru Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, na Blue Ash, Ohio otu sobob di nso 15 miles n’ebe ugwu Cincinnati ka o dine n’ala n’akuku okporouzo naani ihe oyi bu tshirt na uwe ime, otu osi noro gosiri na ono n’okpuru ike ogwu.
translations.hypothesis: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, dị afọ 29, chọpụtara na Blue Ash, Ohio, otu obere obodo dị nso Cincinnati, n'ebe ugwu dị ka kilomita 24. Ọ nọrị na ala, nso ọkpụkpụ, na-eyi akwa na uwe nkịtị, ma ọ dị ka ọ na-eri ọgwụ ọtụtụ.

translations.source: She directed officers to her black Oldsmobile Intrigue which was 500 feet away.
translations.reference: Ọ dụrụ ndị ọrụ nche gaa na Oldsmobile Intrigue ojii ya nke nọ n’ụzọukwu narị ise n’itoanya.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ kpọrọ ndị ọrụ ụlọ ọrụ ahụ ka ha gaa leta ụgbọ ala agba ojii Oldsmobile Intrigue ya, nke nọrịrị n'ebe dị anya, ihe ruru ụkwụ 500.

translations.source: There, they found the body of Saroja Balasubramanian, 53, covered with blood-stained blankets.
translations.reference: Achọtara ozu Saroja Balasubramanian, onye dị afọ iri ise na atọ, ebe ahụ, ja akwa mkpuchi kpudoro ya.
translations.hypothesis: N'ebe ahụ, ha chọtara ahụ Saroja Balasubramanian, otu nwanyị dị afọ 53, nke e kewara akwa ndị nwere ọbara.

translations.source: Police said that the body appeared to have been there for about a day.
translations.reference: Ndị uwe ojii kwuru na ahụ ahụ dị ka ọ nọọla ebe ahụ ruo ihe dị ka otu ụbọchị.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị ọchịchịọ akọwara na ahụ ahụ yiri ka ọ nọrọ n'ebe ahụ ihe dị ka otu ụbọchị.

translations.source: The first cases of the disease this season were reported in late July.
translations.reference: Okwu mbu ndị ahụ nke ọrịa ahụ n'oge a bụ ka a kọrọ n'ime ebe ọgwụgwụ May.
translations.hypothesis: Aghụtawo ihe ngosi mbụ nke ọrịa a n'afọ a na ngwáọrụ July.

translations.source: The disease is carried by pigs, which then migrates to humans through mosquitos.
translations.reference: Ezi na ebu ọrịa ahụ, nke anwụnta na ebunyezi ndị mmadụ.
translations.hypothesis: Asebe a na-ebute n'ime anụ ọhịa, ma mgbe ahụ na-agbanwe na mmadụ site n'aka anụ ọkụkọ.

translations.source: The outbreak has prompted the Indian government to undertake such measures as deployment of pig catchers in seriously affected areas, distributing thousands of mosquito curtains and spraying pesticides.
translations.reference: Ihe ndaputa a emela ka goomenti mba India bido mebe ihe dika izipu ndi na ejide ezi na mpaghara ometuru hinne, ikesa akwa mgbochi anwu nta makwa igba ogwu na-egbu pesti.
translations.hypothesis: Aghụghọ a emeela ka gọọmentị India were na-eme usoro ụfọdụ, dị ka itinye ndị na-achọ nkịta na mpaghara ndị metụtara nke ukwuu, na-ekesa puku ndị na-egbochi anụ ọkụ, na ịgba akwụkwọ anụ.

translations.source: Several million vials of encephalitis vaccine have also been promised by the government, which will help prepare health agencies for next year.
translations.reference: Ọgwụ mgbochi ensefalitis dị nde kwuru nde ka gọọmenti kwere na nkwa, nke ga-akwado ndị ọrụ ahụike maka afọ na-abịa abịa.
translations.hypothesis: Akwụkwọ ndụ akụrụ ọrịa encephalitis na-emepụta n'ọtụtụ nde, na gọọmentị ahụ kwadoro ịnye ha, nke ga-enyere ọrụ ahụike aka iji nkwadebe maka afọ na-abịa.

translations.source: Plans for vaccines to be delivered to the historically most affected areas this year were delayed due to lack of funds and low prioritisation relative to other diseases.
translations.reference: E gburu oge ịnye ndị ọrịa kacha metụta n'afọ a ọgwụ mgbochi maka ego adịghị nakwa enwere ọrịa ndị ọzọ ka ya mkpa igbochi.
translations.hypothesis: Atụmatụ iji ebube ndị mmadụ wetara ebe ndị nwere mmetụta kacha ukwuu n'oge a adịghị ala, n'ihi na enweghị ego zuru ezu, na ọ bụghị na a nyere ya ọtụtụ uru dị ka ọrịa ndị ọzọ.

translations.source: In 1956 Słania moved to Sweden, where three years later he began work for the Swedish Post Office and became their chief engraver.
translations.reference: N'afọ 1956 Słania gara Swiden, ebe afọ atọ gasịrị o bidoro ịrụ ọrụ na ụlọ ọrụ nzipu ozi nke Swiden ma bụrụkwa onye isi mbinye.
translations.hypothesis: N'afọ 1956, Słania gbakwuru Sweden, ebe afọ atọ ka eme, ọ malitere ọrụ na Post Office Sweden, wee bụrụ onye isi na-eme ihe osise n'ọrụ ahụ.

translations.source: He produced over 1,000 stamps for Sweden and 28 other countries.
translations.reference: O mepụtaara stampụ karịrị 1,000 maka Swidin na mba 28 ndị ọzọ.
translations.hypothesis: Ọrụ ahụ kụwara ihe karịrị 1,000 mkpụrụ ederede maka Sweden na mba ndị ọzọ 28.

translations.source: His work is of such recognized quality and detail that he is one of the very few "household names" among philatelists. Some specialize in collecting his work alone.
translations.reference: Oru ya bunke amaara nke oma na iti igba ma doo kwa anya nke oma na obu otu nime ndi amaara n’ezinulo nile na ndi philatelist. Ufodu lekwasiri anya nnoo na ichikota oru ya nani.
translations.hypothesis: Ọrụ ya bụ nke nwere ọkwa dị elu na nkọwa zuru oke, ya mere ọ bụ otu n'ime ndị na-eme ka aha ya mara na ụlọ ndị na-echeta akwụkwọ nkwụnye ego (philatelists). Ụfọdụ na-eche naanị akwụkwọ nkwụnye ego nke ọrụ ya.

translations.source: His 1,000th stamp was the magnificent "Great Deeds by Swedish Kings" by David Klöcker Ehrenstrahl in 2000, which is listed in the Guinness Book of World Records.
translations.reference: Stampụ ya nke otu puku bụ “Nnukwu Omume nke Ndị Eze Sweden” ahụ dị ebube nke David Klöcker Ehrenstrahl dere na 2000, nke edepụtara na Akwụkwọ Guiness nke Ndekọ Ụwa.
translations.hypothesis: Akụkọ ifo ya nke puku nke atọ bụ "Ọrụ Magbakwaghị Uche nke ndị Eze Sweden" nke David Klöcker Ehrenstrahl rụpụtara na afọ 2000, nke edebebebe n'akwụkwọ ndekọ ụwa Guinness.

translations.source: He was also engaged in engraving banknotes for many countries, recent examples of his work including the Prime Ministerial portraits on the front of the new Canadian $5 and $100 bills.
translations.reference: O sokwa na aru ego akwukwo mba di iche iche, otu oru oruru ohuru bu foto Onye isi goomenti Canada etinyeru n’ihu ego ohuru $5 na $100 ndi Canada.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bụghị naanị ya, ọ na-arụkwa ọrụ nke ịme ihe ndabere maka mba ndị ọzọ. Ọmume ya dị mgbe ahụ gụnyere ihe osiriisi nke uwe ahụhụ nke ndị minista na akụ ụlọ ọrụ Canada, dị ka $5 na $100, nke e biputara n'ime akwụghị ụgwọ ahụ.

translations.source: After the accident occurred, Gibson was transported to a hospital but died shortly afterwards.
translations.reference: Mgbe ihe mberde ahụ mechara, e buru Gibson gawa n’ụlọ ọgwụ mana ọ nwụrụ mgbe obere oge gachara.
translations.hypothesis: Mgbe ihe mberede ahụ mere, Gibson bịarutere ụlọ ọgwụ, mana ọ nwụrụ n'oge na-adịghịkarịrị.

translations.source: The truck driver, who is aged 64, was not injured in the crash.
translations.reference: Ọkwọ ụgbọ gwongworo ahụ, nke gbara afọ 64, emerụghị ahụ na mkpọka ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ọnye na-anya ụgbọ mmiri, bụ onye dị afọ 64, enweghị mmerụ ahụ n'oge ihe mgba ọchịchị ahụ.

translations.source: The vehicle itself was taken away from the scene of the accident at approximately 1200 GMT on the same day.
translations.reference: N'otu ụbọchị ahụ, ebe elekere nke iri na abụọwepụrụ ụgbọ ahụ n'ebe ihe mbere mere.
translations.hypothesis: Ebe aghaala ahụ, ụgbọ ala ahụ, ewetara ya pụọ na ebe mmerụ ahụ n'eleghari nkeji 12 nke ọla olika (GMT) na ụbọchị ahụ.

translations.source: A person working in a garage near where the accident occurred said: "There were children waiting to cross the road and they were all screaming and crying."
translations.reference: Otu onye na-arụ ọrụ ebe a na-adọba ụgbọala nọ n’akụkụ ebe ihe mberede ahụ mere kwuru si: "E nwere ụmụaka nọ na-eche ịgafe okporo ụzọ ahụ nakwa ha nille nọ na-eti mkpu ma na-ebe akwa."
translations.hypothesis: Onye ọrụ nke nọ na ụlọ akụrụ dị nso ebe ihe mberede ahụ mere, kwuru: "Enwere ụmụaka na-echebe iji gaafe ọkpụkpụ anya, ha niile na-akpa olili na-emenyi."

translations.source: They all ran back from where the accident had happened.
translations.reference: Ha niile gbaghachitere azụ site na ebe ihe mberede okporo ụzọ ahụ mere.
translations.hypothesis: Ha niile gbachara azụ, si n'ebe ihe mberede ahụ merụrụ ahụ.

translations.source: Other subjects on the agenda in Bali include saving the world's remaining forests, and sharing technologies to help developing nations grow in less-polluting ways.
translations.reference: Ihe ndi ozo akpara na Bali bu izoputa ohia ndi ozo di n’uwa na ikee nka n’uzu nwere ike inyere ndi mba n’ebilite aka itoo n’uzo ga-akwusi mmeto ikuku.
translations.hypothesis: Ụfọdụ ihe ndị ọzọ dị na ọtụtụ okwu nke nzukọ ahụ na Bali gụnyere inachọpụta ụlọ ọhịa ndị fọrọ nke ọma n'ụwa ahụ, na ịnye teknụzụ iji nyere mba ndị na-etolite n'ụzọ nke na-ebelata mmiri na-emerụ ahụ.

translations.source: The U.N. also hopes to finalize a fund to help countries affected by global warming to cope with the impacts.
translations.reference: Ndi U.N. nwekwara olileanya iwepụta ego iji nyere mba niile aka ndị global wọmịn metụtara iji nagide nsogbu o butere.
translations.hypothesis: Ụlọ Na Mba Ụwa (UN) nwekwa olileanya ịmekarịrị usoro ego iji nyere aka maka mba ndị metụtara n'ihi mmụọ ụwa, ka ha nwee ike ịmegharị na-emepepe.

translations.source: The money could go toward flood-proof houses, better water management, and crop diversification.
translations.reference: Enwere ike iji ego agụ rụọ ụlọ ndị mmiri anaghi ebu, njikwa dọtị ka mma, na ọkụkụ ihe dị iche iche.
translations.hypothesis: Akụ ahụ nwere ike iji eme ụlọ nke na-agụsi mmiri ozuzo, iji kwalite usoro njikwa mmiri, na iji wezuga ụdị ọrụ ahụ na-arụ.

translations.source: Fluke wrote that the efforts by some to drown out women from speaking out about women’s health were unsuccessful.
translations.reference: Fluke dere na mbo ufodu gbara ihu na emechiri onu umunwanyi iji kwusi ha ikwuputa okwu maka ihe gbasara ahuike umu nwanyi agaghi nkeoma.
translations.hypothesis: Fluke dere na ihe ndị ụfọdụ mere iji gbochie ụmụ nwanyị ịkekọrịta banyere ahụike ụmụ nwanyị adịghị ọkachie.

translations.source: She came to this conclusion due to the multitude of positive comments and encouragement sent to her by both female and male individuals urging that contraception medication be considered a medical necessity.
translations.reference: O ruru na mkpebi a n'ihi ọtụtụ okwu nkwado o nwetara n'aka ụmụnwoke ma ụmụnwaanyị ndị sị ya na ọgwụ mgbochi afọ ime bụ ihe kwesịrị ekwesị.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bọrọ n'echiche a n'ihi ọtụtụ okwu na nkwụnye uche dị mma nke ndị nwanyị na ndị nwoke nyere ya, bụ ndị kọwara na usoro mgbochi ịme nwa ga-atụgharịrị dị ka ihe dị mkpa n'ọgwụgwụ ahụike.

translations.source: When the fighting ceased after the wounded were transported to the hospital, about 40 of the other remaining inmates stayed in the yard and refused to return to their cells.
translations.reference: Oge ya bụ ọgụ gwụchara mgbe e wegara ndị merụrụ ahụ n'ụlọ ọgwụ, ihe dị ka ndị mkpọrọ 40 fọrọ afọ nọọrọ na mpụga, jụ ịlaghachi n'ime ụlọ mkpọrọ ha.
translations.hypothesis: Mgbe a kwụsịrị ọgụ, mgbe ewetara ndị merenụ ahụ gaa ụlọ ọgwụ, ihe dị ka ndị fọdụrụ n'ime ha, karịrị 40, nọọrọ n'ebe mpụga ụlọ ahụ wee jụọ ịlaghachi n'ime ụlọ ha.

translations.source: Negotiators tried to rectify the situation, but the prisoners' demands are not clear.
translations.reference: Ndị mkparịta ụka nwara ịweta udo, mana ihe ndị mkpọrọ chọrọ edoghi anya.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị na-eme mkparịta ụka gbaliri inwezi ọnọdụ ahụ, mana ihe ndị mkpọrọ na-achọ adịghị doro anya.

translations.source: Between 10:00-11:00 pm MDT, a fire was started by the inmates in the yard.
translations.reference: N'etiti 10:00 na 11:00 MDT n'abalị, ndị mkpọrọ nọ na mpụta mụnyere ọkụ.
translations.hypothesis: N'etiti eleghara nke 10:00 na 11:00 nke abalị, ndị ebulite n'ụlọ mkpọrọ malitere ọkụ n'ebe ọrụ.

translations.source: Soon, officers equipped with riot gear entered the yard and cornered the inmates with tear gas.
translations.reference: N'oge na-adịghị anya, ndị ọrụ uwe ojii ejikere na gịa ogbaaghara batara n'ime yad ahụ ma jiri gaasị anya mmiri wee gbakọta ndị mkpọrọ n’otu ebe.
translations.hypothesis: Nke ọzọ, ndị ọrụ uche dị gịrịgịrị, bụ ndị nwere ngwaọrụ iji chịkwa mgbe egwu, banyere n'ime ebe ahụ wee gbachara ndị ebulitebeghị n'ime ụlọ mkpọrọ ahụ, wee jiri akwụkwọ ndụ nke na-eme ka anya mgbu.

translations.source: Fire rescue crews eventually doused the fire by 11:35 pm.
translations.reference: Ndị otu mgbanyụ ọkụ mechara gbanyụọ ọkụ ahụ ebe 11:35 nke abalị.

translations.source: After the dam was built in 1963, the seasonal floods that would spread sediment throughout the river were halted.
translations.reference: Mgbe aruchara akwa-mmiri ahu na afo 1963, ewee kwusi udu idemiri ahu nke na agbasa unyi na ahu mmiri ahu nile.
translations.hypothesis: Mgbe e wuru ọdọmmụ na afọ 1963, mmiri ozuzo nke na-abịa kwa afọ na-ebufe ihe ndị dị n'ime osimiri ahụ kwụsịrị.

translations.source: This sediment was necessary for creating sandbars and beaches, which served as wildlife habitats.
translations.reference: Sedimenti a dị mkpa maka ịmepụta ụmụ mgbochi ejiri aja mee ma akụkụ osimiri, nke jere ozi dị ka ebe obibi anụ ọhịa.
translations.hypothesis: Akwụkwọ ụlọ na-acha aja aja a dị mkpa iji mee ọdụ ụfụfụ na ọdọọdọọ, bụ ndị jere dị ka ebe ndụ ọhịa.

translations.source: As a result, two fish species have become extinct, and two others have become endangered, including the humpback chub.
translations.reference: N’ihi nke ahụ, ụdị azụ abụọ ekpochapụla, ma abụọ ndị ọzọ abụrụla ndị nọ n’ihe ize ndụ, gụnyere humpback chub.
translations.hypothesis: N'ihi ya, ụdị azụ abụọ agbanweela, ebe ụdị ndị ọzọ abụọ na-ebu egwu nke ịgbasa, gụnyere azụ "humpback chub".

translations.source: Although the water level will only rise a few feet after the flood, officials are hoping it will be enough to restore eroded sandbars downstream.
translations.reference: Agbanyeghi na larịị mmiri ahụ ga-eto elu ụkwụ ole na ole naanị mgbe idei mmiri ahụ gasịrị, ndị isi na-enwe olile anya na ọ ga-ezu iji weghachi ụmụ ugwu aja nke mmiri riri na ndịda ụzọ mmiri.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bụ ezie na ọchịchị mmiri ahụ ga-ebelata obere oge, ma ọ bụghị karịa obere mita ole na ole, ndị ọchịchị na-atụ anya na ọ ga-ekwesị iweghachi ala ọcha nke merụrụ ahụ n'ebe ndị ọzọ.

translations.source: No tsunami warning has been issued, and according to the Jakarta geophysics agency, no tsunami warning will be issued because the quake did not meet the magnitude 6.5 requirement.
translations.reference: E nwebeghị ịdọ aka na ntị nke ajọ ebili mmiri enyegoro, ma na-ndabere na ụlọ ọrụ jiofiziz Jakarta ahụ, a gaghị adọ aka na ntị nke ajọ ebili mmiri n’ihi na ala ọma jijiji ahụ eruteghị iheachọrọ nke ịdị ukwuu 6.5.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ dịghị ihe egwu tsunami, ma dị ka ọkwa ụlọ ọrụ sayensị ụwa nke Jakarta, a gaghị akpọ ihe egwu tsunami, n'ihi na ahụhụ ahụ adịghị n'ọkwa dị elu karịa 6.5.

translations.source: Despite there being no tsunami threat, residents started to panic and began to leave their businesses and homes.
translations.reference: Agbanyeghị na enweghị ihe n'egosi na a ga-enwe sunami, ndi bi ebe ahụ bidoro tụwa egwu, jiri ọsọ na-ahapụsị ụlọ na ahịa ha.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bụ ezie na enweghị ihe ọ bụla na-egosi mmetụta nke tsunami, ndị bi n'obodo ahụ malitere ịba ọbụba, wee malite ịhapụ azụ azụ ụlọ ha na azụ azụ azụ azụ azụ azụ azụ azụ azụ azụ translations.source: Although Winfrey was tearful in her farewell, she made it clear to her fans she will be back.
translations.reference: N'agbanyeghi na Winfrey bu anya mmiri n'okwu ije ọma ya, o mere ka ndị ihe ya na-amasị mata nke ọma na ọ ga-alọghachi.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bụ ezie na Winfrey nwere mmiri anya mgbe ọ na-akpọrọ ndị na-eso ya, ọ gwakọtakwara ndị enyi ya na ha na-eche banyere ya na ọ ga-abịa ọzọ.

translations.source: "This is not going to be goodbye. This is the closing of one chapter and the opening of a new one."
translations.reference: “Nke a abụghị ịsị ka e mesịa. Nke a bụ imechi otu isi na imeghe nke ọhụrụ.”
translations.hypothesis: "Nke a abụghị ebe anyị ga-akpọrọ nkwa. Kama, ọ bụ ebe anyị na-agwụ otu akụkọ ahụ, ma malite otu akụkọ ọhụrụ."

translations.source: Final results from Namibian presidential and parliamentary elections have indicated that the incumbent president, Hifikepunye Pohamba, has been reelected by a large margin.
translations.reference: Akara nchịkọta ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị obodo egosila na ahọrọgharịrị onye isi obodo nọ n'ọchịchị bụ Hifikepunye Pohamba.
translations.hypothesis: Nsonaazụ kacha ọhụrụ sitere na nhọrọ ọchịchị na ndị otu ụlọ akwụkwọ anya nke Namibia egosila na onye bụbu president, Hifikepunye Pohamba, etoliteregharịrị, ọtụtụ ndị votere ya.

translations.source: The ruling party, South West Africa People's Organisation (SWAPO), also retained a majority in the parliamentary elections.
translations.reference: Otu ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị na-achị ugbu a, Sawụt West Afrịka Pịpụls Ọganaịzeshọn (SWAPO), jidekwara ọnọdụ ha dịka otu kacha n'ọnụ ọgụgụ na ntuli aka ndị omeiwu.
translations.hypothesis: Otu ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị, nke bụ South West Africa People's Organisation (SWAPO), nọkwa na-achị, ma jiri ọtụtụ mmeri n'ọrụ ahọpụta ndị otu ụlọ akwụkwọ ụlọ.

translations.source: Coalition and Afghan troops moved into the area to secure the site and other coalition aircraft have been sent to assist.
translations.reference: Ndị mmekọta na ndị agha Afghan banyere n’ime ebe ahụ ichekwa saịtị ahụ ma ezitela ụgbọ elu ndị mmekọta inyere aka.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị otu na ndị agha Afghanistan abanyere n'ebe ahụ iji chekwaa ebe ahụ, ma ezigotachara ụgbọ elu ndị ọzọ sitere n'otu ahụ iji nyere aka.

translations.source: The crash occurred high up in mountainous terrain, and is believed to have been the result of hostile fire.
translations.reference: Mkpọkasị ahụ mere n'elu ugwu, e kwenyekwara na ọ bụ ya kpatara ajọ ọkụ.
translations.hypothesis: Agbanyeghị, ihe mere bụ na ọkụ ahụ rụrụ na mpaghara dị elu, n'etiti uwe, ma a tụrụ anya na ọ bụ ihe ndị na-eme ihe ọjọọ mere ya.

translations.source: Efforts to search for the crash site are being met by bad weather and harsh terrain.
translations.reference: Mgbalị ị na-achọ saịtị okuku ahụ na-emebi ihu igwe site na ihu igwe dị njọ na ala siri ike.
translations.hypothesis: Ihe ndị mmadụ na-eme iji chọpụta ebe ọkụ ahụ rụrụ bụ ihe ngosi na-enweghị ọdịmma, yana ebe ahụ siri ike ịga.

translations.source: The medical charity Mangola, Medecines Sans Frontieres and the World Health Organisation say it is the worst outbreak recorded in the country.
translations.reference: Ụlọ ọrụ enyemaka ahụike Mangola, 'Medecines Sans Frontieres', na Wọld Helt Ọganaịzeshọn na-ekwụ na ọ bụ ntiwapụ ọrịa kachasị njọ ahụrụla na mba ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị otu enyemaka ahụike, Mangola, Medecines Sans Frontieres, na Ụlọ Ọrụ Ahụike nke Ụwa, kwuru na ọ bụ nnukwu mgbe a hụrụ nke a na mba ahụ.

translations.source: Spokesman for Medecines Sans Frontiere Richard Veerman said: "Angola is heading for its worst ever outbreak and the situation remains very bad in Angola," he said.
translations.reference: Onye nkwuchite maka Medecines Sans Frontiere Richard Veerman kwuru: "Angola na-agaru maka ntiwapụ ya kacha njọ mgbe ọ bụla ma ọnọdụ ahụ ka dịkwa njọ n’ime Angola,” o kwuru.
translations.hypothesis: Onye ọkọwa ụka nke Medecines Sans Frontiere, Richard Veerman, kwuru: "Angola na-agafe ọrịa kachasị njọ ya ruo taa, ma ọnọdụ ahụ ka na-adị oke ọjọọ na Angola," ka ọ kwuru.

translations.source: The games kicked off at 10:00am with great weather and apart from mid morning drizzle which quickly cleared up, it was a perfect day for 7's rugby.
translations.reference: Egwuregwu ji ihu igwe dị mma bido ebe elekere iri nke ụtụtụ, ewepụ igirigi yọrọ n'ụtụtụ nke gbachara ọsịsọ, ọ bụ ụbọchị zuru oke nye 7's rugbi.
translations.hypothesis: Egwuregwu ahụ malitere n'elekere 10 nke ụtụtụ, na ihu igwe dị mma. Ọ bụ ezie na e nwere obere osisi na ọkara ụbọchị, mana ọ gwara ngwaa, ọ bụ ụbọchị dị mma maka egwuregwu rugby nke ndị otu asaa.

translations.source: Tournament top seeds South Africa started on the right note when they had a comfortable 26 - 00 win against 5th seeded Zambia.
translations.reference: Ndi kachasị elu na asọmpi bu South Africa bidoro na akara nke oma mgbe ha nwere mmeri ntụsara ahụ nke 26 - 00 megide Zambia gbara mkpụrụ nke 5.
translations.hypothesis: Otu South Africa, bụ ndị nwere ọkwa kacha elu na asọmpi ahụ, malitere nke ọma mgbe ha meriri Zambia, bụ ndị nwere ọkwa nke ise, site na ebuli dị mma nke 26 - 00.

translations.source: Looking decidedly rusty in the game against their southern sisters, South Africa however steadily improved as the tournament progressed.
translations.reference: N'agbanyeghị na ọ dị ka ndị na emegide ha bụ ndị ndịda ka ha mma, ndị mba Sawụt Afrịka melitere nwayọ nwayọ ka ịsọ mpi gara n'ihu.
translations.hypothesis: N'oge egwuregwu ahụ nke ha nwere megide ndị ụmụ nwanyị ha si n'ebe ndịda, South Africa dị ka ọ dị, egosighi ezigbo ọha mmụọ, mana ha nọgidewo ịmụta na ịmụba uru ka asọmpi ahụ na-aga.

translations.source: Their disciplined defence, ball handling skills and excellent team work made them stand out and it was clear that this was the team to beat.
translations.reference: Ụzọ mkpachapụ anya ha n’ime mgbochi, ka ha si ejide bọọlụ ma ụzọ nhàzi pụrụ iche mere ha ka ha pụọ iche ma o doro ha anya n’òtù a bụ òtù ha ga-emeri.
translations.hypothesis: Ọrụ ha nke ọma n'akụkụ ahụ, ọrụ ha na bọọlụ, na ọrụ otu ha nke dị mma mere ka ha pụta, ma ọ bụrụla ka ọ dị mma na a maara na a ga-adịkarịrị otu a iji merie ha.

translations.source: Officials for the city of Amsterdam and the Anne Frank Museum state that the tree is infected with a fungus and poses a public health hazard as they argue that it was in imminent danger of falling over.
translations.reference: Ndị ọrụ maka obodo nke Amstardam na Ebe ngosi ihe ndị mgbe ochie Anne Frank na-ekwu na osisi ahụ ebutela ọrịa n’iji ero ma dịkwa njọ makka ahụike ọha dịka ha na-agbagha na ọ nọbụrụ n’ezigbo ihe ize ndụ nke ịdapụga n’ofe.
translations.hypothesis: Onyeisi ndị ọchịchị obodo Amsterdam na Musée Anne Frank kwuru na osisi ahụ nwere ọrịa fungal na ọ bụ ihe ncheta ahụike maka ndị mmadụ, ebe ha na-akọwa na ọ nwere ihe dị ka ọ ga-ebufe.

translations.source: It had been scheduled to be cut down on Tuesday, but was saved after an emergency court ruling.
translations.reference: Akara ya maka mgbututu n'ụbọchị Tuzde, mana azọpụtara ya ka ụlọ ikpe kpegharịrị ikpe na mberede.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ dị ka e kwadoro ka a gbajie ya na Ụzọ Tuesday, mana e chekwaara ya mgbe ụlọ ikpe kpọrọ mkpe ahụ n'oge nsogbu.

translations.source: All of the cave entrances, which were named "The Seven Sisters", are at least 100 to 250 meters (328 to 820 feet) in diameter.
translations.reference: Ụzọ niile dị n'ọgba ahụ a kpọrọ “Ụmụnne nwanyị asaa” dị ihe dịka opekatampe 100 mita ruo mita 250 (fiiti 328 ruo 820) na dayamita.
translations.hypothesis: Ufọdụ ụmọmụ niile, bụ ndị akpọrọ ha aha "Ndị Nwanyi Asaa," nwere ọkwa dịkarịrị nke dị elu, site na metiru 100 ruo 250 (site na ụkwụ 328 ruo 820).

translations.source: Infrared images show that the temperature variations from night and day show that they are likely caves.
translations.reference: Ụmụ onyinyo infràreèd na-egosipụta na mgbanwe okpomọkụ ahụ sitere n'ụbọchị na abalị na-egosi na ha nwere ike ịbụ ọgba.
translations.hypothesis: Ihe ndị na-egosi onyonyo infrared na-egosi na mgbanwe okpomọkụ nke na-abata n'etiti abalị na ụbọchị na-egosi na ha bụ, enwere ike ịbụ, ụlọ ọdụ dị n'okpuru ala.

translations.source: "They are cooler than the surrounding surface in the day and warmer at night.
translations.reference: Ha na-adị oyi karịa gburugburu ha n'ehihie ma dị ọkụ karịa n'abalị.
translations.hypothesis: "Ha na-adị gịrị gịrị karịa ihe ndị ọzọ gbara ha n'ụbọchị, ma na-adị ọkụ karịa n'abalị."

translations.source: Their thermal behavior is not as steady as large caves on Earth that often maintain a fairly constant temperature, but it is consistent with these being deep holes in the ground," said Glen Cushing of the United States Geological Survey (USGS) Astrogeology Team and of Northern Arizona University located in Flagstaff, Arizona.
translations.reference: Omume okpomọkụ ha anaghị adịgide ka nnukwu ọgba dị n'ụwa nke na-enwe okpomọkụ na-anaghị agbanwe, mana ọ dị ka ndị a maka na ha bụkwa olulu miri emi n'ime ala," Glen Cushing kwuru, onye United States Geology Survey (USGS) Otu Astrojiọlọji na nke Mahadum Northern Arizona dị na Flagstaff, Arizona.
