translations.hypothesis: "Ọ dịghị ka ọkụ na-agbanwe mgbe niile n'ime ha, dị ka ọ dị na agwaetiti ndị dị ukwuu na Ala, nke na-adịkarị na-enwe okpomọkụ dịgide, mana ọ dabara nke ọma na ha bụ ọkpọ ụzọ dị oke ịtọ, nke dị n'ime ala," ka Glen Cushing, onye nọ na otu Astrogeology nke United States Geological Survey (USGS) na Mahadum Northern Arizona nke dị na Flagstaff, Arizona, kwuru.

translations.source: In France, voting has traditionally been a low-tech experience: voters isolate themselves in a booth, put a pre-printed sheet of paper indicating their candidate of choice into an envelope.
translations.reference: Na mba Frans, ịtụ ụtụ bụ ihe anaghị eji ike eme: ndị na-atụ ụtụ na ewezuga onwe ha n'otu ụlọ ndo, tinye akwụkwọ ebiri na ndịnihu nke na-egosi onye ha na atụrụ ụtụ n'ime akwụkwọ amachiri amachi.
translations.hypothesis: Na n'ọhịa France, ọbụla adịghị dị mfe: ndị vota na-akpọrọ onwe ha n'otu ebe, wee tinye akwụkwọ akara nke ha chọrọ n'ime akpachị.

translations.source: After officials verify the voter's identity, the voter drops the envelope into the ballot box and signs the voting roll.
translations.reference: Ka ndị nchịkọta nyochachara onye na-atụ ụtụ, onye na-atụ ụtụ etinye akwụkwọ ụtụ ya amachiri amachi n'ime igbe nnakọ ụtụ ma bie aka n'akwụkwọ ndị tụrụ ụtụ.
translations.hypothesis: Mgbe ndị ọrụ na-ahụ maka ya na-akụọzi akụkọ ahụ maka onye na-atụ, onye ahụ na-etinye akwụkwọ ahụ n'ime igbe atụ na-ede akwụkwọ ya na akwụkwọ ndekọ atụ.

translations.source: French electoral law rather strictly codifies the proceedings.
translations.reference: Iwu gbasara ntuliaka na Frans depụtara usoro ikpe kpọmkwem.
translations.hypothesis: Usoro iwu ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị nke mba France na-achịkọta usoro ndị a na-eme n'oge nhọrọ nke ọma.

translations.source: Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters.
translations.reference: Kemgbe 1988, ụmụ igbe ntuli aka ga-abụrịrị ngafe-ahụ-ụzọ ka ndị ntụli aka na ndị nnyota ga-agba akaebe na o nweghị envelopu nọ na ya mgbe a na-ebido ntuli aka nakwa o nweghị envelopu etinyere ewezụga nke ndị agụgwere ọnụ ma nye ikikere nke ọma.
translations.hypothesis: Kemgbe afọ 1988, akwụkwọ ndụle ahụ ga-adị gbara ọchịchị, ka ndị vota na ndị na-ele anya wee nwee ike ịhụ na enweghị akwụkwọ enwepụtara na mbido ịbụọ ahụ, na akwụkwọ enwepụtara adịghị egbakwute, eweghachi akwụkwọ ndị otu ndị vota ndị nwere ikike na e-atụ aro ha.

translations.source: Candidates can send representatives to witness every part of the process. In the evening, votes are counted by volunteers under heavy supervision, following specific procedures.
translations.reference: Ndị a na atụrụ ụtụ nwere ike iziga ndị nnọchiteanya ka ha gbaa ama ihe nile mere. Na mgbede, ndị ọrụ efu ga agụkọ ụtụ nile na oke nlegideanya , ma site n'usoro atọrọ atọ.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị na-asọ aso nwere ike zipụ ndị nọchitere anya ha iji hụ akụkụ niile nke usoro ahụ. N'abalị, ndị otu na-enyere aka na-atụ ụbọchị, n'okpuru nlekọta siri ike, site na ịlegharị ụkpụrụ ndị e kwadoro.

translations.source: ASUS Eee PC, earlier launched world-wide for cost-saving and functionality factors, became a hot topic in 2007 Taipei IT Month.
translations.reference: ASUS Eee PC, ewepụtara ụwa niile na mbụ maka ụmụ ihe nchekwa-ego na arụmọrụ ya, wụrụ isiokwu na-ewu ewu n’Ọnwa IT Taipei 2007.
translations.hypothesis: ASUS Eee PC, nke ebidoro ere n'ụwa niile n'oge gara aga maka uru ahịa na ọrụ ya, ghọrọ ihe a na-ekwu banyere ya n'afọ 2007 n'oge "Taipei IT Month".

translations.source: But the consumer market on laptop computer will be radically varied and changed after ASUS was awarded in the 2007 Taiwan Sustainable Award by Executive Yuan of the Republic of China.
translations.reference: Mana ogugo ahịa kọmpụta laptop ga-agbanwe ma dị iche ri nne ka ASUS nwetachara Nturu ugo Taịwan Sọstenebụl Awọdụ n'afọ 2007 site n'aka Ezekutiv Yuan si na Repọblik Chaịna.
translations.hypothesis: Mana ahịa ndị na-azụta kọmputa laputọọ, ọ ga-agbanwekarị na-agbanwe mgbe ASUS ritere ihe nrite "Taiwan Sustainable Award" nke afọ 2007 site na "Executive Yuan" nke Repubuliki China.

translations.source: The station's web site describes the show as "old school radio theater with a new and outrageous geeky spin!"
translations.reference: Webụsaịtị steshọn a kpọrọ ihe ngosi a "ihe ngosi redio ndị mgbe ochie nke osote ya ọhụrụ gbasara ịgba ara akwụkwọ ma dị egwu!"
translations.hypothesis: Onye ọrụ weebụịtaị nke ụlọ ọrụ ahụ na-akọwa ihe omume ahụ dị ka "ihe nkiri redio nke ochie, mana nwere usoro ọhụrụ na ihe dị ịtụnanya."

translations.source: In its early days, the show was featured solely at the long-running internet radio site TogiNet Radio, a site focused on talk radio.
translations.reference: N’oge mbu ya, ihe ngosi a ka egosiputara n’igwe saịtị intaneti na-agba ọsọ nke TogiNet Radio, ebe a lekwasịrị anya na redio na-ekwu okwu.
translations.hypothesis: N'oge mbụ ya, emepụtala ihe omume ahụ naanị na akụrụngwa redio ntan bụ TogiNet Radio, bụ́ site nwere ọtụtụ afọ na-arụ ọrụ, nke na-elekwasị anya na redio okwu.

translations.source: In late 2015, TogiNet established AstroNet Radio as a subsidiary station.
translations.reference: N'ọgwụgwụ afọ 2015, TogiNet bidoro AstroNet Redio dị ka mpaghara nọ n'okpuru ya.
translations.hypothesis: N'ime afọ 2015, TogiNet kọrọ AstroNet Radio dị ka otu ụlọ ọrụ nke nwere ọrụ dị iche.

translations.source: The show originally featured amateur voice actors, local to East Texas.
translations.reference: Na mbụ, ihe nkiri ahụ gosipụtara ndị omee olu ka bidoro ebido, ndị si n'ọwụwa anyanwụ Tegzas.
translations.hypothesis: N'oge mbụ, ihe ngosi ahụ gosiri ndị na-eme ihe nkiri olumba ndị na-eme olumba, bụ ndị si n'obodo ndị dị na mpaghara ndịda Texas.

translations.source: Widespread looting reportedly continued overnight, as law enforcement officers were not present on Bishkek's streets.
translations.reference: A sị na ozuzu ohi gara n'ihu ogologo abalị niile, n'ihi na ndị ọrụ mmanye iwu anọghị n'okporo ama Bishkek.
translations.hypothesis: Akwụkwọ ụlọ ọrụ anọọ mụọ na mmadụ nọgidere na-eme ihe ọjọọ mgbe ụtụtụ, ebe ndị ọrụ udo anọghị n'okporo ụzọ nke Bishkek.

translations.source: Bishkek was described as sinking into a state of "anarchy" by one observer, as gangs of people roamed the streets and plundered stores of consumer goods.
translations.reference: Otu onye nkere anya kọwapụtara Bishkek dịka ihe na-emikpu n'ọnọdụ "ọgba aghara", ka ndị mmadụ na akpagharị na eburughara ngwa ahịa n'ike.
translations.hypothesis: Bishkek bụ otu e kwuru na ọ na-ebu ụzọ bido n'ọnọdụ "anarchism," ebe otu ndị na-eme ihe ọjọọ na-agba egwu n'okporo ụzọ, na-atọgbu ụlọ ahịa yana ịcha mba ụlọ.

translations.source: Several Bishkek residents blamed protesters from the south for the lawlessness.
translations.reference: Otutu ndi bi na Bishkek tara ndi na-eme ngaghari iwe si na odida anyanwu uta gbasara imebi iwu
translations.hypothesis: Ọtụtụ ndị bi na Bishkek kwere na ndị otu ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị si n'ebe ndịda bụ ndị kpalitere ọdịda nke iwu na usoro.

translations.source: South Africa have defeated the All Blacks (New Zealand) in a rugby union Tri Nations match at the Royal Bafokeng Stadium in Rustenburg, South Africa.
translations.reference: Mba Sawụtụ Afrịka emeriela Ọl Bụlaksị (Nuu Ziilandị) n'egwuregwu rọgụbi nke Mbanaatọ n'ama egwuregwu Royal Bafokeng nke dị na Rọstenbọgụ, Sawụtụ Afrịka.
translations.hypothesis: Agha South Africa merụrụ ndị All Blacks (New Zealand) n'asọmpi rugby Tri Nations nke mere na Royal Bafokeng Stadium na Rustenburg, South Africa.

translations.source: The final score was a one-point victory, 21 to 20, ending the All Blacks' 15 game winning streak.
translations.reference: N'ikpeazụ, otu ọkpụ ka ha jiri merie ha, ha sara ọkpụ iri abụọ na otu ebe ndị mmegide ha sara ọkpụ iri abụọ. Nke a usoro mmeri iri na ise ndị Ọl Blaks na mmechi.
translations.hypothesis: Ọnọdụ ikpeazu bụ mmeri nke otu pọnt, bụ nke 21 kpara 20, na ebe a mechara ọtụtụ asụsụ nke 15 egwuregwu nke All Blacks nwere.

translations.source: For the Springboks, it ended a five-match losing streak.
translations.reference: Maka òtù Springboks ndị ahụ, ọ kwụsịrị na egwuregwu-ise nke ogologo usoro ọdịda.
translations.hypothesis: Maka ndị Springboks, ọ kwụsịrị ọtụtụ egwuregwu ise ha nwetara agbụrụ.

translations.source: It was the final match for the All Blacks, who had already won the trophy two weeks ago.
translations.reference: Ọ bụ ịsọmpi ikpeazụ nke Ọl Blaks ndị merigoro ihe nnweta izu ụka abụọ gara aga.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bụ asọmpi ikpeazụ maka ndị "All Blacks," bụ ndị eweghara ihe nrite ahụ abụọ izu gara.

translations.source: The final match of the series will take place at Ellis Park in Johannesburg next week, when the Springboks play Australia.
translations.reference: A ga-agba egwuregwu ikpeazụ nke ogbe a n'Elis Pak na Johanesbọg n'izu na-abịa abịa, mgbe ndị Sprịngbọks ga-agba Ọstrelia.
translations.hypothesis: Asọmpi ikpeazụ nke usoro ahụ ga-eme na Ellis Park na Johannesburg n'izu na-abịa, ebe Springboks ga-ege Australia asọmpi.

translations.source: A moderate earthquake shook western Montana at 10:08 p.m. on Monday.
translations.reference: Ala ọma jijiji dị larịị mara ọdịda anyanwụ Montana jijiji mgba ojiri nkeji asatọ gafee elekere nke iri n'abalị Monde.
translations.hypothesis: Otu mkpụrụ ndụ nke ụwa merụrụ obere mmerụ na mpaghara ọdịdaanyere Montana na elekere 10:08 nke abalị nke Mọnde.

translations.source: No immediate reports of damage have been received by the United States Geological Survey (USGS) and its National Earthquake Information Center.
translations.reference: Mpaghara mba Yunaịted Steeti na-ahụ maka mmegharị ala (USGS) na mpaghara nke na-ezite ozi gbasara ala ọma jijiji enwetabeghị mkpesa ihe mmebi.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ dịghịzi enwetala akụkọ ọ bụla banyere mmebi ọ bụla site na United States Geological Survey (USGS) na Kọntọ ya nke Ozi Bụrụ Bụ na Nkọwa Gbasara Oké Osimiri (National Earthquake Information Center).

translations.source: The earthquake was centered about 20 km (15 miles) north-northeast of Dillon, and about 65 km (40 miles) south of Butte.
translations.reference: Ala ọma jijiji ahụ nwere etiti ya na ihe dị ka km 20 (maịlị 15) ugwu-ebe ugwu ọwụwa anyanwụnke Dillon, na ihe dị ka km 65 (maịlị 40) ndịda nke Butte.
translations.hypothesis: Agharị ala ahụ malitere n'ebe dị nso na kilomita 20 (maịlụ 15) n'ebe ugwu-ebe ọdịda anyanwụ nke Dillon, yana kilomita 65 (maịlụ 40) n'ebe ndịda nke Butte.

translations.source: The strain of bird flu lethal to humans, H5N1, has been confirmed to have infected a dead wild duck, found on Monday, in marshland near Lyon in the east of France.
translations.reference: N'ụbọchị Mọnde, n'ala mpịtọ dị Lyon nso nke dị n'ọwụwa anyanwụ mba Frans, ka achọpụtara na ọrịa gburu otu ọbọgwụ bụ ụdịrị ọrịa nnụnụ nke nwere ike igbu mmadụ, bụ H5N1.
translations.hypothesis: Aghụghọ nke ọrịa influenza nke nwere ike ibu ọrụ na mmadụ, H5N1, egosiri ka ọ jidere anụ ọcha nke nwụrụ, nke chọpụtara na Mọnde, n'ebe osimiri dị nso Lyon, na mpaghara ndịda France.

translations.source: France is the seventh country in the European Union to suffer this virus; following Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece and Italy.
translations.reference: Frans bụ mba nke asaa n'ọgbakọ Iroopu ịta ahụhụ n'ihi ọrịa a; osotere Ọstrịa, Jemani, Slovenia, Bọlgeria, Gris na Itali.
translations.hypothesis: France bụ mba nke asaa n'etiti mba ndị dị na European Union nke amụtala ọrịa a; mgbe e tinyeere ya na mba ndị ọzọ dị ka Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece, na Italy.

translations.source: Suspected cases of H5N1 in Croatia and Denmark remain unconfirmed.
translations.reference: Enwere orịa a ka na-enyo enyo ka ọ bụ H5N1na mba Kroeshia na Denmak.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ dịghị ka akụkọ banyere ọrịa H5N1 na Croatia na Denmark egosighi eziokwu.

translations.source: Chambers had sued God for "widespread death, destruction and terrorization of millions upon millions of the Earth's inhabitants."
translations.reference: Chambers gbara Chukwu akwụkwọ maka "ọnwụ zuru ebe niile, mmebi na iyi egwu eyiri nde ka nde mmadụ bi n’ụwa."
translations.hypothesis: Chambers họpụtara Chineke n'ụlọ ikpe maka "ọnwụ na-akwakwasị, mbibi, na iwu ọjọọ nke etu ọtụtụ nde mmadụ na-ebi n'ụwa ahụ si emetụta."

translations.source: Chambers, an agnostic, argues that his lawsuit is "frivolous" and "anybody can sue anybody."
translations.reference: Chambers, onye na-ajụkarị oge niile, na-agbagha na ikpe ya "abaghị uru" ma "onye ọ bụla nwere ike ịkụ onye ọbụla ikpe."
translations.hypothesis: Chambers, onye na-enweghị ntụzi anya banyere Chineke, na-akọwa na ikpe a ọ na-ebute bụ "eziokwu enweghị isi" na "onye ọ bụla nwere ike ịkpọ onye ọ bụla ikpe."

translations.source: The story presented in the French opera, by Camille Saint-Saens, is of an artist "whose life is dictated by a love for drugs and Japan."
translations.reference: Akụkọ egosipụtara na opera french, nke Camille Saint-Saens dere, bụ maka onye na-ese ihe "nke ịhụnanya o nwere maka Japan na ọgwụ ike na-achị ndụ ya."
translations.hypothesis: Akụkọ ahụ nke etuputara na opera France ahụ, nke Camille Saint-Saens kere, bụ gbasara onye na-ese ihe "ndụ ya nke etu ya si dị, na-achịkọta site n'ịhụnanya ya maka ọgwụ na Japan."

translations.source: As a result, the performers smoke cannabis joints on stage, and the theatre itself is encouraging the audience to join in.
translations.reference: N'ihi nke a ndị na-eme ihe ngosi na-ese igbo n'ebe ngosi ihe, ndị nwe ụlọ ngosi ihe na-akwadokwa ndị nlere anya ka ha sonye.
translations.hypothesis: N'ihi ya, ndị na-eme ihe nkiri na-eji ọgwụ cannabis eme ihe n'elu igwe, ma ụlọ ihe nkiri ahụ nwekwara na-agba ndị na-ele ihe nkiri ahụ aka ka ha joo jikwa.

translations.source: Former House Speaker Newt Gingrich, Texas governor Rick Perry, and Congresswoman Michele Bachmann finished in fourth, fifth, and sixth place, respectively.
translations.reference: Onye na-ekwubu okwu n'ụlọ omeiwu bụ Newt Gingrich, onye isi obodo Tekzas bụ Rik Perị, na onye otu nzukọ omeiwu Mishel Bakmann mechara gba ndị anọ, ise na isii, n'usoro.
translations.hypothesis: Onyeisi ụlọ akwụkwọ ụlọ ochie, Newt Gingrich, onye isi obere Texas, Rick Perry, na onye otu Nyocha, Michele Bachmann, choputara n'ebe nke anọ, nke ise, na nke ise na anọ, n'otu nọgide.

translations.source: After the results came in, Gingrich lauded Santorum, but had tough words for Romney, on whose behalf negative campaign advertisements were aired in Iowa against Gingrich.
translations.reference: Ka akara omume pụtara, Gingrich kelere Santorum, mana ọ gwara Rọmni okwu ike, n'ihi ụdịrị mkpọsa ozi ọ kpọsara megide Gringrich na Ayowa.
translations.hypothesis: Mgbe ngwaahụ bịara, Gingrich were Santorum ekele, mana ọ jụrụ Romney okwu siri ike, ebe ọtụtụ akụkọ ifo na-emepụta maka Romney, na-akpali akụkọ na-adịghị mma gbasara Gingrich na Iowa.

translations.source: Perry stated that he would "return to Texas to assess the results of tonight's caucus, determine whether there is a path forward for myself in this race", but later said that he would remain in the race and compete in the January 21 South Carolina primary.
translations.reference: Perry kwuru na ọ ga "agaghachị Tekzas ileba anya n'akara omume abalị a, ịchọpụta ma o nwere ọganihu n'ọsọ ahụ", ma na omechara kwuo na ọ ga anọgide n'ọsọ ma sọọ mpi izizi na Karolaina n'ụbọchị nke iri abụọ na otu nke ọnwa Jenụwarị.
translations.hypothesis: Perry kwuru na ọ ga- "agbadata na Texas iji nyochaa nsona nke mkpebi nke taa, wee chọpụta ma ọ bụrụ na enwere ụzọ ọ ga-aga n'ọganihu n'asọmpi a". Mana ka emechara, ọ kwuru na ọ ga-enwekwuo mmeri na asọmpi a, ma ọ ga-asọ mpi na nhọrọ ahụ nke South Carolina na Jenụwarị 21.

translations.source: Bachmann, who won the Ames Straw Poll in August, decided to end her campaign.
translations.reference: Bakman, onye meriri Ntuliaka Ames Strọ n'Ọgọọst, kpebiri ịkwụsị kampen ya.
translations.hypothesis: Bachmann, onye meriri ntuli nke Ames Straw Poll n'ọnwa Ọgọstụ, kpebiri ịkwụsị ọrụ ya na ọrụ ahụ.

translations.source: The photographer was transported to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he subsequently died.
translations.reference: E bugara onye ahụ na-ese fòto na Ụlọ Ọgwụ Reagan UCLA, ebe o mechara nwụọ.
translations.hypothesis: Onye na-egosi foto ahụ bịara n'ọgwụgwụ ahụike Ronald Reagan nke dị na UCLA, ebe ọ nwụrụ n'oge na-esote.

translations.source: He was reportedly aged in his 20s. In a statement, Bieber said "[w]hile I was not present nor directly involved with this tragic accident, my thoughts and prayers are with the family of the victim."
translations.reference: A kọbụrụ na ọ nọ n’ime ụmụ afọiri abụọ ya. N’otu nkwupụta, Bieber siri "Agbanyeghị na ọ nọghị ma ọ sonyeghị ozugbo ọdachi ihe mberede okporo ụzọ a, echiche na ekpere m nonyere ezinụlọ ndị onye a tara ahụhụ."
translations.hypothesis: Akwụkwọ akụkọ na-akọ na ọ dịkarịrị afọ iri abụọ na otu. N'akwụkwọ ozi otu, Bieber kwuru, "[sị] N'agbanyeghị na m dịghị ebe ahụ ma ọ bụ na m so n'ihe a merụrụ ahụ, echiche m na uche m dị n'aka ezinụlọ onye ahụ bụ onye merụrụ ahụ."

translations.source: Entertainment news website TMZ understands the photographer stopped his vehicle on the other side of Sepulveda Boulevard and attempted to take pictures of the police stop before crossing the road and continuing, prompting the California Highway Patrol police officer conducting the traffic stop to order him back across, twice.
translations.reference: Webụsaịtị akụkọ ntụrụndụ TMZ ghọtara onye na-ese fòto ahụ kwụsịrị ụgbọala ya n'akụkụ nke ọzọ nke okporo ámá Sepulveda sara mbara nwere ụmụ osisi akwụwara n'akụkụ ya ma nwaa ị see fòto nkwụsị ndị uwe ojii tupu ya agafee okporo ụzọ wee gaa n'ihu, na-akpali onye uwe ojii Njeghari ilekota Nnukwu okporo ụzọ anya nke California na-eduzi okporo ụzọ iji nyeghachi ya iwu gafeghachị , ugboro abụọ.
translations.hypothesis: Onye ode akụkọ na weebsaịtị TMZ, nke na-akụkọ akụkọ gbasara mmekọrịta na nka, chọpụtara na onye na-egosi foto ahụ kwụsịrị ụgbọ ya n'akụkụ ọzọ nke Sepulveda Boulevard, wee gbalị ịnakọta foto ndị ọtọ na ndị ọrụ ụlọ ọrụ ndị uwe ojii ahụ na-ele anya tupu ọ gaa n'ụzọ ọzọ wee gaa n'ihu. Nke a mere ka onye ọrụ ụlọ ọrụ ndị uwe ojii nke California, bụ onye na-elekọta okporo ụzọ ahụ, gwara ya ka ọ laghachi, abụọ ugboro.

translations.source: According to police, the driver of the vehicle that hit the photographer is unlikely to face criminal charges.
translations.reference: Dị ka ndị uwe ojii kwuru, ọkwụ ụgbọ ala ahụ suru onye na-ese fòto eleghị anya ọ gaghị enwe ebubo mpụ ọ bụla.
translations.hypothesis: Dịka ndị ọchịchịọ ọchịchị sịrị, ọ bụghị nke ọma na onye na-anya ụgbọ ala nke merụrụ onye na-ewu foto ahụ ga-enwe ụdị ikpe azụ.

translations.source: With only eighteen medals available a day, a number of countries have failed to make the medal podium.
translations.reference: Ya na naanị medaal iri na asatọ dị kwa otu ụbọchị, ọtụtụ mba adala imepụta ikpo okwu medaal ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: N'ihi na naanị medal dị iri na asatọ ka enwere n'ụbọchị ọ bụla, ọtụtụ mba amaghịkwa ụzọ izutere na ọkwa ndị meriri medal.

translations.source: They include the Netherlands, with Anna Jochemsen finishing ninth in the women's standing class in the Super-G yesterday, and Finland with Katja Saarinen finishing tenth in the same event.
translations.reference: Ha gụnyere mba Nedalands, ebe Anna Jochemsen gbara onye nke itoolu n'egwuregwu nkwụmọtọ ụmụ nwanyị nke asọmpi Super-G ụnyaahụ, na Fịnland ebe Katja Saarinen gbara onye nke iri n'otu egwuregwu ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ha gụnyere Netherlands, ebe Anna Jochemsen mechara nọrọ na nke ise na-agba ọsọ n'okpuru anyanwụ (Super-G) n'ụbọchị gara echi na kọọsụ ụmụ nwanyị, yana Finland, ebe Katja Saarinen mechara nọrọ na nke iri na otu na ihe omume ahụ.

translations.source: Australia's Mitchell Gourley finished eleventh in the men's standing Super-G. Czech competitor Oldrich Jelinek finished sixteenth in the men's sitting Super-G.
translations.reference: Michel Gọrli gbachara Super-G nkwụmọtọ ụmụ nwoke dịka onye nke iri na otu. Oldrich Jelinek, onye Chek rịpọblik gbara onye nke iri na isii na Super-G ọnụnọ ala ụmụ nwoke.
translations.hypothesis: Mitchell Gourley, onye Australia, pụtara n'ọkwa nke iri na abụọ na asatọ na asọmpi Super-G maka ndị nwoke nke ha nọ n'ọnọdụ siri ike. Oldrich Jelinek, onye Czech, pụtara n'ọkwa nke iri na ise na iri na abụọ na asọmpi Super-G maka ndị nwoke nke ha nọ n'ọdịnihu.

translations.source: Arly Velasquez of Mexico finished fifteenth in the men's sitting Super-G. New Zealand's Adam Hall finished ninth in the men's standing Super-G.
translations.reference: Arly Velaskwez, onye Megziko, gbara onye nke iri na ise na Supa-G ịnọ ọdụ nke ụmụ nwoke. Adam Họl, onye Niu Ziland, gbara onye nke itoolu na Supa-G nkwụmọtọ ụmụ nwoke.
translations.hypothesis: Arly Velasquez, onye si Mexico, pụtara n'ebe iri na ise na asọmpi Super-G maka ndị nwoke na-anọghị na ụkwụ. Adam Hall, onye si New Zealand, pụtara n'ebe ise na asọmpi Super-G maka ndị nwoke na-ese.

translations.source: Poland's men's visually impaired skier Maciej Krezel and guide Anna Ogarzynska finished thirteenth in the Super-G. South Korea's Jong Seork Park finished twenty-fourth in the men's sitting Super-G.
translations.reference: Onye Poland kpuri isi bụ Maciej Krezel na-egwu egwuregwu ski, na onye ndu ya Anna Ogarzynska mechara onye nke iri na atọ na asọm mpi Supa-G. Jong Seork Park onye South Korea mechara onye nke iri abụọ na ano na asọm mpi ụmụnwoke Super-G.
translations.hypothesis: Maciej Krezel, onye na-agba egwuregwu skiing nke ndị Igbo dị na Poland, na onye na-akpọrọ ya, Anna Ogarzynska, kwadoro ọnọdụ nke iri na atọ na asọmpi Super-G. Jong Seork Park, onye na-agba egwuregwu skiing nke ndị Igbo dị na Kọria, kwadoro ọnọdụ nke iri na anọ na asọmpi Super-G maka ndị Igbo.

translations.source: UN peacekeepers, whom arrived in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake, are being blamed for the spread of the disease which started near the troop's encampment.
translations.reference: Ndị nchekwa udo UN, ndị lọtara n’ime Haịti mgbe ala ọma jijiji 2010 gachara, bụ ndị a na-ata ụta maka nkesa ọrịa ahụ nke malitere n’akụkụ kampụ ndị agha ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị na-elekọta udo nke UN, bụ ndị bịara Haiti mgbe ahụ ụlọ ahụ gasịrị na afọ 2010, na-akpọrọ aha ha dị ka ndị metụtara mgbasa nke ọrịa ahụ, nke malitere nso ebe ndị agha ahụ nọ.

translations.source: According to the lawsuit, waste from the UN camp was not properly sanitized, causing bacteria to enter the tributary of the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest.
translations.reference: Na-ndabere n’ikpe ahụ, ehichaghị ọfụma mkpofu si na kampụ UN, nke na-akpata nje ịbanye nna nwaghara ụzọ nke osimiri Artibonite, otu n’ime nke Haịti kachasị ibu.
translations.hypothesis: Dịka akụkọ ụlọikpe ahụ sịrị, ihe mkpofu sitere na obere obodo nke United Nations (UN) anwetaghị nhicha ziri ezi, na-ebute ụdị osisi na-emerụ ahụ banye n'otu osimiri nke na-erubeghị osimiri Artibonite, otu n'ime osimiri kacha ukwuu na Haiti.

translations.source: Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had not encountered problems related to the disease since the 1800s.
translations.reference: Tupu ndị agha abịarute, Haiti ezutebeghị nsogbu ndị metụtara ọrịa ahụ kemgbe oge ndị 1800.
translations.hypothesis: Tupu ndị agha bịa, Haiti ahụ amaghị ọrịa ọ bụla dị otú ahụ kemgbe afọ 1800.

translations.source: The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti.
translations.reference: Ụlọọrụ ikpe na ọchịchị onye kwuo uche ya na Haiti atụjela aka n'ọmụmụ sị na ndị agha udo UN nke Nepal bubatara ọrịa na Nepal n'amaghị ama.
translations.hypothesis: Institutọ Haitian maka Ikpe na Ọchịchị emeela ihe atụ na ọmụmụ sayensị ndị nọ n'otu n'otu nke gosiri na ndị agha Nepal nke nọ n'ọrụ nchekwa udo nke UN, n'enweghị enweghị amụma, wetere ọrịa ahụ gaa Haiti.

translations.source: Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.
translations.reference: Danielle Lantagne, otu onye ọkachamara UN n’ọrịa ahụ, kwuru na ntiwapụ ahụ bụ ndị na-eme ụdọ nwere ike ịkpata ya.
translations.hypothesis: Danielle Lantagne, onye ọkachamara nke UN gbasara ahụmahụ a, kwuru na ọ bụ ike na ndị na-achọzi udo bụ ndị kụrụ akara ahụ.

translations.source: Hamilton confirmed Howard University Hospital admitted the patient in stable condition.
translations.reference: Hamilton kwetere na Ụlọ ọgwụ Mahadum Howard nabatara onye ọrịa ahụ n’ọnọdụ ahụ kwụsiri ike
translations.hypothesis: Hamilton kwuru na ụlọ ọgwụ Howard University nabatara onye ahụ, ma ọ dị na ọnọdụ dị mma.

translations.source: The patient had been to Nigeria, where some cases of the Ebola virus have occurred.
translations.reference: Onye ọrịa ahụ agabuola na Naịjirịa, ebe a na-enwela ụfọdụ ndị bu nje Ebola ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ọrịa ahụ gara Nigeria, ebe ụfọdụ akụkụ nke ọrịa Ebola ahụ apụtala.

translations.source: The hospital has followed protocol for infection control, including separating the patient from others to prevent possible infection of others.
translations.reference: Ụlọ ọgwụ ahụ esorola ìwuùsòrò maka njikwa ọrịa ofufe, gụnyere iwepụta iche onye ọrịa ahụ site na ndị ọzọ iji gbochie mbufe ndị ọzọ ọrịa nwere ike ime.
translations.hypothesis: Ọrụ ahụọma ahụ egosila usoro ndị e kwadoro iji chekwaa ahụike, gụnyere ichebe onye ọrịa ahụ site na ndị ọzọ iji gbochie mmerụ ahụike ọ bụla nwere ike ịbụ.

translations.source: Before The Simpsons Simon had worked on several shows in various positions.
translations.reference: Tupu Simpsons Simon Ahụ arụọla ọrụ n’ọtụtụ ihe nkiri n’ọkwa dị iche iche.
translations.hypothesis: Tupu o bọọ The Simpsons, Simon arụrụ ọrụ na ọtụtụ usoro vidiyo n'ọtụtụ ọrụ dị iche iche.

translations.source: During the 1980s he worked on shows such as Taxi, Cheers, and The Tracy Ullman Show.
translations.reference: N'afọ ndị 1980, ọ rụrụ ọrụ n'ihe ngosi dị ka Tagzi, Cheers, ya na ihe ngosi Tresi Ullman.
translations.hypothesis: N'oge na mba nke 1980, ọ rụrụ ọrụ na usoro uche dị iche iche, dị ka "Taxi," "Cheers," na "The Tracy Ullman Show."

translations.source: In 1989 he helped create The Simpsons with Brooks and Groening, and was responsible for hiring the show's first writing team.
translations.reference: Na 1989 ọ nyere aka na mmepụta The Simpsons ya na Brooks na Groening, ọ bụ ya hụrụ maka ịwe ndị otu edemede mbụ nke ihe nkiri a.
translations.hypothesis: N'afọ 1989, ọ kọwara "The Simpsons" na-akọwa akụkọ na Brooks na Groening, ọ bụkwa onye zụrụ ndị mbụ na-ede akụkọ maka usoro ihe nkiri ahụ.

translations.source: Despite leaving the show in 1993 he kept the title of executive producer, and continued to receive tens of millions of dollars every season in royalties.
translations.reference: N'agbanyeghi na ọ hapụrụ ihe ngosi a n'afọ 1993, ọ ka jidere ọkwa onye isi mmepụta ya, gaa n'ihu na-anara ọtụtụ nde dọla iri kwa sizin n'ụgwọ royalti.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bụ ezie na ọ hapụrụ ihe ngosi ahụ na afọ 1993, ọ nọgidewo n'ọkwu dị ka onye nchịkwa ụlọ ọrụ, ma nọgidewo ritere nde ọtụtụ dollar kwa oge site na ụgwọ.

translations.source: Earlier the Chinese news agency Xinhua reported a plane to be hijacked.
translations.reference: Ụlọ ọrụ mgbasa ozi ndị Chaịna n’oge mbụ kọrọ maka ụgbọ elu a chọrọ izuru.
translations.hypothesis: N'oge gara aga, ụkọrọ akụkọ China, Xinhua, kọrọ banyere ụgbọ elu nke e jidere.

translations.source: Later reports then stated the plane received a bomb threat and was diverted back to Afghanistan, landing in Kandahar.
translations.reference: Ozi ndị ọzọ mechara bata kwuru na ụgbọ elu ahụ natara iyi ụjọ gbasara ogbunigwe ya mere o ji wee lọghachi Afganistan, lotuo na Kandahar.
translations.hypothesis: N'ime akụkọ ndị bịara mgbe ehihie, etuputara na ọgbọ ụgbọ elu ahụ natara ihe egwu bomba, ya mere ewegara ya n'azụ na Afghanistan, wee erute Kandahar.

translations.source: The early reports say the plane was diverted back to Afghanistan after being denied an emergency landing in Ürümqi.
translations.reference: Mkpesa mbụ kwuru na achụghachiri ụgbọelu ahụ azụ gawa Afghanistan mgbe anapụrụ ya ikikere ịfedà na mberede n’Ürümqi.
translations.hypothesis: Nke mbụ, akụkọ ahụ na-agwa na ọgbụgbọ elu ahụ bịarutere n'azụ na Afghanistan mgbe e jụrụ ya ikwụsị iji nweta enyemaka n'ebe ahụ na Ürümqi.

translations.source: Air accidents are common in Iran, which has an aging fleet that is poorly maintained both for civil and military operations.
translations.reference: Ihe mberede ụgbọ elu, na-eme ọtụtụ mgbe na mba Aịran, nke nwere ụgbọ elu ndị agha na ndị nkịtị kara nka nke anaghị eleọkọta anya nke ọma.
translations.hypothesis: Mmetụta ikuku na-emekarị na Iran, ebe ha nwere ọtụtụ ọgbakọ ikuku ochie, nke a na-enweghị enyemaka ọma, ma maka ọrụ ndị ọchịchị na ndị agha.

translations.source: International sanctions have meant that new aircraft cannot be purchased.
translations.reference: Ntarama-ahuhu nke mba uwa putara na agaghi azutali ugbo-elu ohuru.
translations.hypothesis: Ihe ndị mba ụwa họpụtara eme ka ọ ghara ịwekweta ụgbọ elu ọhụrụ.

translations.source: Earlier this week, a police helicopter crash killed three people and wounded three more.
translations.reference: Na mbido izu a, helịkọpta ndị uwe ojii kpọkasịrị gbuo mmadụ atọ ma merụọ mmadụ atọ ọzọ ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: N'ime izu a, otu helikopter nke ndị uwe ojii ji erube, na ezigbo mmadụ atọ nwụrụ, ebe ndị ọzọ atọ jiri.

translations.source: Last month Iran saw its worst air disaster in years when an airliner heading to Armenia crashed, killing the 168 on board.
translations.reference: N’ọnwa gara aga Iran hụrụ ihe ọdachi ikuku ya kachasị njọ n’ọtụtụ afọ mgbe otu ụgbọ elu na-aga Amenịa kpọkara, na-egbu ndị 168 nọ n’ime ya.
translations.hypothesis: N'ọnwa gara aga, Iran hụrụ ihe ọjọọ kacha ukwuu n'usoro afọ ole na ole, mgbe ọtụ ọnụ ọchịchịagha nke na-aga Armenia gbapụrụ, ma ọ wụli 168 ndị dị n'ime ya.

translations.source: The same month saw another airliner overrun a runway at Mashhad and strike a wall, killing seventeen.
translations.reference: N'otu ọnwa ahụ ka ụgbọ elu ọzọ na Mashhad si n'ụzọ ya gbapụ sụnye isi na mgbidi, were gbuo mmadụ iri na asaa.
translations.hypothesis: N'otu ọnwa ahụ, ọzọ, otu ọgbara ọchịchịagha bịara eje gaa elu ụzọ mgbawa na Mashhad, wee gbapụta na akwa ụlọ, na ebuo mmadụ iri na asaa.

translations.source: Aerosmith have cancelled their remaining concerts on their tour.
translations.reference: Erosmit akagbuola ihe ngosi ha fọdụrụ na njem ha.
translations.hypothesis: Aerosmith ekewere ụmụ mmadụ niile na ha adịghịzi eme ọpụrụiche ndị ọzọ ha nwere atụ anya ime n'oge njem ha.

translations.source: The rock band was due to tour the United States and Canada until September 16.
translations.reference: Bandị rọk ahụ tozuru oke ịga njem nleta na United States na Kanada ruo Septemba 16.
translations.hypothesis: Otu egwu rock ahụ kwadoro ịgba egwu na mba United States na Canada ruo ụbọchị 16 nke Ọktoba.

translations.source: They have cancelled the tour after lead singer Steven Tyler was injured after he fell off stage while performing on August 5.
translations.reference: Ha kagburu njem ngagharị ahụ mgbe onye isi ịgụ egwu Steven Tyler merụrụ ahụ mgbe ọ si n’ebedielu dapụ dị ka ọ na eme emume ngosi na Ọgọst 5.
translations.hypothesis: Ha akpọrọ mgbazinye ahụ pụọ, mgbe onyeisi otu egwu ahụ, Steven Tyler, merụrụ ahụ mgbe ọ tụrụ n'ala site n'elu ọdụ ụlọ egwu n'abalị 5 nke Ọgọstụ, n'oge ọ na-eme egwu.

translations.source: Murray lost the first set in a tie break after both men held each and every serve in the set.
translations.reference: Emeriri Murray na seti nke mbu na ndorondoro njirimara onye mmeri mgbe umu nwoke abuo jidere bolu ọ bụla n’ime setị.
translations.hypothesis: Murray jụrụ egwuregwu ahụ na setị mbụ, ebe ọ bịara na "tie break" mgbe ọ bụla ụmụ nwoke abụọ ahụ jiri ike chebe oge ha n'oge egwuregwu ahụ.

translations.source: Del Potro had the early advantage in the second set, but this too required a tie break after reaching 6-6.
translations.reference: Del Potro nwere uru dị oge na seetị nke abụọ, mana nke a kwa chọrọ ịchọpụta onye mmeri mgbe eruchara 6-6.
translations.hypothesis: Del Potro nwere uru na mbụ na egwuregwu nke abụọ, mana ọbụna nke a chọrọ "tie break" mgbe ha erutere 6-6.

translations.source: Potro received treatment to his shoulder at this point but managed to return to the game.
translations.reference: Potro natara nlekota na ubu ya n’oge a mana were ike laghachi azu n’egwuregwu ahu.
translations.hypothesis: N'oge ahụ, Potro jiri ọgwụgwọ gwọọ ahụ ya na akụkụ aka ya, mana ọ nwekwara ike ịlaghachi na egwulegwu ahụ.

translations.source: The program started at 8:30 p.m. local time (15.00 UTC).
translations.reference: Ihe omume bidoro n’elekere 8:30 nke ụtụtụ. oge mpaghara (15.00 UTC).
translations.hypothesis: Eprogramụ ahụ malitere n'elekere 8:30 nke abalị, n'oge mpaghara (15:00 UTC).

translations.source: Famous singers across the country presented bhajans, or devotional songs, to Shri Shyam's feet.
translations.reference: Ndị ọgụ egwu ama ama n’obodo niile bụkuru bhajan, maọbụ abụ ofufe, nye ụkwụ Shri Shyam.
translations.hypothesis: Onye ọkpụrụkpụ ndị agha egwu sitere n'ofe obodo ahụ kọrọ abụ ndị metụtara Chineke, maọbụ abụ ndị na-agba ume, maka ụmụaka nke Shri Shyam.

translations.source: Singer Sanju Sharma started the evening, followed by Jai Shankar Choudhary. esented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.
translations.reference: Onye ọgụ egwu Sanju Sharma bidoro na mgbede, Jai Shankar Choudhary were sote ya. Ọ gụkwara chhappan bhog bhajan. Onye ọgụ egwu Raju Khandelwal sonyekwara ya.
translations.hypothesis: Onye na-agụ egwu, Sanju Sharma, malitere mkpebi ahụ, wee bịa Jai Shankar Choudhary. Ọ gwakwara egwu "chhappan bhog bhajan." Onye na-agụ egwu, Raju Khandelwal, nọ ya n'akụkụ.

translations.source: Then, Lakkha Singh took the lead in singing the bhajans.
translations.reference: Lakkha Singh wee bido idu n'ịbụ abụ bajan gasị.
translations.hypothesis: Mgbe ahụ, Lakkha Singh wepụtara onwe ya iji chịkọta ndị ọzọ ịkpọ abụ abụ ndị a.

translations.source: 108 plates of Chhappan Bhog (in Hinduism, 56 different edible items, like, sweets, fruits, nuts, dishes etc. which are offered to deity) were served to Baba Shyam.
translations.reference: Efere 108 nke Chhappan Bhog (na okpukpe Hindu, ihe erimeri 56 dị iche iche, dị ka, swiiti, mkpụrụ osisi, akị, nri dị iche iche wdg. Nke e ji achụrụ chi aja) ka e ji wee nye Baba Sham onyinye.
translations.hypothesis: Ebute 108 nke "Chhappan Bhog" (na Hinduism, ihe oriri 56 dị iche iche, dị ka mkpụrụ nri, mkpurumkpu, mkpuru, na ụzụ ndị ọzọ) bịara nye Baba Shyam.

translations.source: Lakkha Singh presented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.
translations.reference: Lakkha Singh gosirikwara chhappan bhog bhajan. Oguegwu, Raju Khandelwal nọ na-esonye ya.
translations.hypothesis: Lakkha Singh kpakwara ụta egwu "chhappan bhog bhajan." Onye na-agụ egwu, Raju Khandelwal, so na ya.

translations.source: At Thursday's keynote presentation of the Tokyo Game Show, Nintendo president Satoru Iwata unveiled the controller design for the company's new Nintendo Revolution console.
translations.reference: Na nguputa isi okwu ubochi Tozdee maka Ihe ngosi Egwuregwu Tokyo, onye isi Nintendo Satoru Iwata kpughere controller design ulo oru ya maka njikwa ohuru Nintendo Revolution.
translations.hypothesis: N'oge ihe ngosi bụ isi nke Tokyo Game Show na Thursday, onye isi ụlọ ọrụ Nintendo, Satoru Iwata, họpụtara nhazi nke akụrịta (controller) maka ngwaọrụ ọhụrụ nke ụlọ ọrụ ahụ, bụ nke a na-akpọ Nintendo Revolution.

translations.source: Resembling a television remote, the controller uses two sensors placed near the user's television to triangulate its position in three-dimensional space.
translations.reference: Ngwa Kọntrola, nke yiri rimotu onyonyo, na-eji ihe mmetụta abụọ dị n'akụkụ onyonyo achọpụta ọnọdụ ya n'oghere ọbụla nwere akụkụ atọ.
translations.hypothesis: Akwụkwọ njikwa ahụ, nke na-achọkarị ka akwụkwọ njikwa televizhan, na-eji abụọ sensors nke etinyere nso televizhan onye ọrụ ahụ iji chọpụta ebe ọ nọ n'ime oghere atọ.

translations.source: This will allow players to control actions and movements in video games by moving the device through the air.
translations.reference: Nke a ga-ekwe ka ndị na-egwu egwuregwu jikwaa ihe omume na njegharị n'egwuregwu vidiyo site na imegharị ngwa ọrụ ahụ n'ikuku.
translations.hypothesis: Nke a ga-enyere ndị na-egwu egwuregwu ohere ijebe ihe omume na usoro ije n'ime egwuregwu eletrọniki site na iji aka ha na-etinye ngwaọrụ ahụ n'elu.

translations.source: Giancarlo Fisichella lost control of his car and ended the race very soon after the start.
translations.reference: Giancarlo Fisichella ejikwalighi ụgbọ ala ya wee si n'ọsọ ahụ pụọ n'isi mmalite ya.
translations.hypothesis: Giancarlo Fisichella weghachara ikike ụgbọ ya, wee kwụsị asọmpi ahụ n'oge na-adịkarịrị mgbe ọ malitere.

translations.source: His teammate Fernando Alonso was in the lead for most of the race, but ended it right after his pit-stop, probably because a badly tucked right front wheel.
translations.reference: Onye otu ya Fenando Alonso nọ n'isi ọsọ ọtụtụ mgbe, mana nke ahụ kwụsịrị mgbe ọ kwụsịrị ụgbọala ya, o nwere ike ịbụ n'ihi ụkwụ ihu ụgbọala a na-etinyeghi nke ọma.
translations.hypothesis: Onye otu egwuregwu ya, Fernando Alonso, nọ n'ogo mbụ n'oge ọtụtụ akụkụ nke asọmpi ahụ, mana ọ kwụsịrị asọmpi ahụ ozugbo ka ọ gbanwere akụkụ ụgbọ ya, ma ọ bụghịkwa n'ihi na akụkụ ahụ n'ihu nke ọwụwa anyanwụ ya adịghị mma.

translations.source: Michael Schumacher ended his race not long after Alonso, because of the suspension damage in the numerous battles during the race.
translations.reference: Michael Schumacher kwụsịrị ọsọ ya n’oge na-etoghị anya mgbe Alonso mesịrị, n’ihi mmebi sọspenshọn n’ime ọtụtụ agha n’ime oge ọsọ ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: Michael Schumacher kwụsịrị asọmpi ahụ ọtụtụ oge ka Fernando Alonso kwụsịrị, n'ihi mmebi nke akụkụ nke na-adị na igwe ya, nke mere n'oge ọtụtụ asọmpi dị iche iche n'ime asọmpi ahụ.

translations.source: "She’s very cute and sings quite well, too," he said according to a transcript of the news conference.
translations.reference: Dịka edemede nzukọ nta akụkọ ahụ kwuru, "ọ sị na ọ mara oke mma ma mara ka esi agụ egwu ọfụma".
translations.hypothesis: "Ọ mara mma nke ukwuu, ọ bụkwa onye na-elekwu egwu nke ọma," ka o kwuru, dịka akụkọ nke mkparịta ụka ahụ gosiri.

translations.source: "I was moved every time we did a rehearsal on this, from the bottom of my heart."
translations.reference: Ọ metụtara m n'ala ala obi m mgbe ọbụla anyị mere mmegharị nkwado maka nke a.
translations.hypothesis: "Ọ bụrụla m obi ụtọ mgbe ọ bụla anyị na-eme atụmatụ maka ihe a, site n'ime obi m niile."

translations.source: Around 3 minutes into the launch, an on-board camera showed numerous pieces of insulation foam break away from the fuel tank.
translations.reference: K’oforo nkeji 3 ka ha fenyie, igwefoto no n’ime ugbo ahu gosirika otutu foam n’ekpuchi ihe kewapuru na tanki mmanu.
translations.hypothesis: N'ime ihe dị ka nkeji atọ mgbe ọbụna ahụ malitere ịga, kamera nke nọ n'ime ọbụna ahụ gosiri ọtụtụ akụ nke foam dị n'ime ya na-apụ n'aka tankị ikpa.

translations.source: However, they are not thought to have caused any damage to the shuttle.
translations.reference: N’agbanyegghị, echeghị na ha kpatara mmebi ọ bụla n’ụgbọ njem ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: Otú ọ dị, a maghị na ha mere mmebi ọ bụla na ụgbọ elu ahụ.

translations.source: NASA's shuttle program chief N. Wayne Hale Jr. said the foam had fallen "after the time we are concerned about."
translations.reference: Onye isi ihe mmemme shọtụl NASA bụ Wayne Hale Jr. kwuru na fom ahụ dara "mgbe oge anyị na-ele anya gasịrị."
translations.hypothesis: Onyeisi ọrụ ụgbọ elu nke NASA, N. Wayne Hale Jr., kwuru na akara ahụ "bụrụrụ otu ọkụkọ mgbe anyị na-enyocha ya."

translations.source: Five minutes into the display a wind starts rolling in, about a minute later, the wind is reaching 70km/h... then the rain comes, but so hard and so large that it slaps your skin like a needle, then hail fell from the sky, people panicking and screaming and running over each other.
translations.reference: Ka nkeji ise gachara e bidoro ihe ngosi a, ikuku ebido kuwe, ka nkeji ọzọ gachara, ikuku a na-eru ọsọ kilomita 70 kwa awa... mmiri ebido zowe, mana o ji iwe bịa, ụdịrị iwe na-eme ka ọ na-adụ gị adụ ka ntu, mkpụrụ mmiri ebido zowe, ndị mmadụ a na-agbagharị, na-atụ egwu, na-eti mkpu.
translations.hypothesis: N'ime nkeji ise nke ihe ngosi ahụ, ikuku malitere ịbịa, ma n'ime nkeji ọzọ, ikuku ahụ ruru ọsọ nke kilomita 70 n'eleghari. Mgbe ahụ, mmiri malitere ịbụ, mana ọ bụ mmiri siri ike na nnukwu, nke na-atụ aka gị dị ka ọtụtụ ọkwụ. Mgbe ahụ, ọkpụkpụ si n'elu igwe, ndị mmadụ nwere ọghọm, na-akpọ nkwa, na-agba ọsọ na ibuliri onwe ha.

translations.source: I lost my sister and her friend, and on my way there were two disabled people in wheelchairs, people just jumping over and pushing them," Armand Versace said.
translations.reference: Nwanne m nwanyị na enyi ya nwụrụ, na dịka m na-aga n'ụzọ, enwere ndị mmadụ abụọ nwere nkwarụ, ndị mmadụ a na-arị ha elu, na-akwagharị ha," Amand Vesachi kwuru.
translations.hypothesis: "Mụ na-ele anya, ụkwụ nwanyị m na enyi ya gbapụrụ, ma n'ụzọ m na-aga, ahụrụ m otu mmadụ abụọ nwere agụụ, ha nọ n'oche ndị agụụ, ndị mmadụ na-awụli elu na-agba ha," Armand Versace kwuru.

translations.source: NHK also reported that the Kashiwazaki Kariwa nuclear power plant in Niigata prefecture was operating normally.
translations.reference: NHK kwukwara na ulo oru nuklia power plant nke Kashiwazaki Kariwa di na mpaghara Niigata n’aru oru ofuma.
translations.hypothesis: NHK kwekọkwara na ụlọ ọrụ eletrik nuklia Kashiwazaki Kariwa dị na obere obodo Niigata na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma.

translations.source: Hokuriku Electric Power Co. reported no effects from the earthquake and that the Number 1 and 2 reactors at its Shika nuclear power plant were shut down.
translations.reference: Hokuriku Electrik Pawa Co. zitere ozi na ala ọma jijiji emebighi ihe n'igwe ọkụ nke izizi na nke abụọ n'ụlọ ọrụ ike nuklia dị na Shika nke emechiri emechi.
translations.hypothesis: Hokuriku Electric Power Co. kọwara na enweghị mmetụta ọ bụla sitere na mmiri ahụ, ma ụlọ ọrụ eletrik nuklia dị na Shika, nọọdụ nke 1 na 2, ejebeghị.

translations.source: It is reported that some 9400 homes in the region are without water and approximately 100 without electricity.
translations.reference: A kọrọ na ụfọdụ ebeobibi dị 9400 na mpaghara ahụ nọ na-enweghị mmiri ma ihe dị ka 100 na-enweghị ọkụ eletriki.
translations.hypothesis: Akwụkwọ akụkọ na-akọ na ihe dị ka ụlọ 9,400 na mpaghara ahụ enweghị mmiri, yana ihe dị ka ụlọ 100 enweghị eletrik.

translations.source: Some roads have been damaged, railway service interrupted in the affected areas, and the Noto Airport in Ishikawa prefecture remains closed.
translations.reference: O mebiri ụfọdụ ụzọ, kwụsịtụ njem ụgbọ oloko n'ebe ndị o metụtara, ma ọdụ ụgbọelu Ishikawa ka mechiri emechi.
translations.hypothesis: Ụfọdụ ọdụ ụgbọ okporo ụzọ emetụtawo, ọrụ ụgbọ njem eletriki kwụsịrị na mpaghara ndị metụtara, ma ọdụ ụgbọ elu Noto na Ishikawa prefecture ka emeghị emepe.

translations.source: One bomb exploded outside the governor general's office.
translations.reference: Otu ogbunigwe gbawara n'ezi ụlọ ọrụ onye isi ọchịchị.
translations.hypothesis: Otu bomba merụrụ ahụ n'ebe dị nso na ụlọ ọrụ onyeisi steeti ahụ.

translations.source: Three more bombs exploded near government buildings in a period of two hours.
translations.reference: Ogbunigwe atọ ọzọ gbara na nsonso ụlọ gọọmenti gasị n'ime awa abụọ.
translations.hypothesis: Ezigbo ihe ndị na-bụrịrị ọgbaghara atọ ọzọ gbapụrụ nso ụlọ ọrụ gọọmentị n'ime awa abụọ.

translations.source: Some reports put the official death toll at eight, and official reports confirm that up to 30 were injured; but final numbers are not yet known.
translations.reference: Akụkọ ụfọdụ sịrị na mmadụ asatọ nwụrụ, ma akụkọ gọọmenti sị na ihe ruru mmadụ iri atọ merụrụ ahụ; ma na amatabeghị ọnụ ọgụgụ ikpeazụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ụfọdụ akụkọ na-ekwu na ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị nwụrụ n'ọdịnihu bụ asatọ, yana akụkọ gọọmentị na-akụkọ na ruo ndị iri abụọ na otu nwere mmerụ; mana ọnụ ọgụgụ kacha ọhụrụ ka amabeghị.

translations.source: Both cyanuric acid and melamine were found in urine samples from pets that died after consuming contaminated pet food.
translations.reference: A chọpụtara ma sayanọriki asidi ma melamini na mamịrị anụụlọ ndị nwụrụ ka ha richara nri anụụlọ merụrụ emerụ.
translations.hypothesis: Anya acid na melamine ahụ bịara n'ime mmiri mmanya nke ụlọ anwụrụ ahụ, bụ ndị nwụrụ mgbe ha rii nri nke ụlọ anwụrụ ahụ nke nwere ihe ndị na-emerụ ahụ.

translations.source: The two compounds react with one another to form crystals that may block kidney function, researchers at the university said.
translations.reference: Ndị nchọpụta na mahadum sị na ihe ndị a na-emekorịta imepụta mkpụrụ nwere ike ịkwụsị ọrụ akụrụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị nyocha na mahadum ahụ kwuru na ihe ndị a abụọ na-emeji egwu egwu n'etiti ha iji bubu ihe ndị na-acha, ma ihe ndị a nwere ike igbochi ọrụ nke mkpụrụ ndụ.

translations.source: The researchers observed crystals formed in cat urine by the addition of melamine and cyanuric acid.
translations.reference: Ndị nnyocha ahụ chọpụtara na ọ kpụrụ okwute mgbe e tinyere melamin na siyanurik asid n'ime amịrị buusu.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị nyocha ahụ chọpụtara na akara (crystals) bịrịrị na mmiri mmanya nke ụmụ agụụ site n'ịgbakwunye melamine na cyanuric acid.

translations.source: The composition of these crystals matches those found in the urine of affected pets when compared by infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).
translations.reference: Ngwakọta nke kristal ndị a dị ka ndị a hụrụ n'amịrị ụmụ anụmanụ ụlọ ndị emetụtara, ma e jiri infrared spektroskopi (FTIR) lee ya.
translations.hypothesis: Usoro ihe ndị a dị n'ime akwa ndị a yiri nke a na-ahụ n'ime mmiri ahụ nke ụlọ ụmụ anụmụ na-enweta ahụ, mgbe a na-atụgharị ha akaebe site na usoro nyocha infrared (FTIR).

translations.source: I don't know if you realize it or not, but most of the goods from Central America came into this country duty-free.
translations.reference: Amaghị m ma Ị matara nke a ma ọ dịghị, mana ọtụtụ ngwaahịa si Sentral Amerịka batara n'obodo a n'akwụghị ụgwọ mbubata.
translations.hypothesis: Amaghị m ma ị mara ma mara, mana ọtụtụ ngwaahịa sitere na Amerika Kọntinentị Central banyere n'obodo a n'enweghị ụgwọ ọzụzụ.

translations.source: Yet eighty percent of our goods were taxed through tariffs in Central American countries. we treat you.
translations.reference: Ma a nara ụtụ isi pasentị iri asatọ na ngwaahịa anyị site na ụmụ tarifu na mba Keetiti Amerịka. anyị na-eleta gị anya.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bụ ezie na pasentụ iri na asatọ nke ngwaahịa anyị bịara akụ ụgwọ site na ụgwọ n'oge mbanye na mba ndị dị na Amerika Kọntinent. Anyị na-elekọta gị.

translations.source: That didn't seem to make sense to me; it certainly wasn't fair.
translations.reference: Ọ dịghị m n'anya ka ihe kwesịrị ekwesị; ọ bụghị ezi ihe n'ezie.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ dịghị ka ihe ahụ dị mma; ọ maghịkwa echiche dị mma. Ọ maghịkwa eziokwu.

translations.source: All I say to people is you treat us the way we treat you.
translations.reference: Naanị ihe m na-agwa ndị mmadụ bụ na gị meso anyị etu anyị si emeso gị.
translations.hypothesis: Nke m na-ekwu kwa n'aka ndị mmadụ bụ na anyị ga-atụkwa ha otu ha si atụ anyị.

translations.source: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger signed into law a bill that bans the sale or rental of violent video games to minors.
translations.reference: Gọvanọ California Arnold Schwarzenegger tiri iwu nke machibidoro iresi ụmụaka maọbụ ịgbazinye ha egwuregwu vidio ihe ike.
translations.hypothesis: Gọvanọ Steeti California, Arnold Schwarzenegger, họpụtara iwu nke na-akpọpụta ịre ma ọ bụ itinye vidio egwuregwu na-agụụ n'aka ndị na-eto eto.

translations.source: The bill requires violent video games sold in the state of California to be labeled with a decal reading "18" and makes their sale to a minor punishable by a fine of $1000 per offense.
translations.reference: Iwu ahụ chọrọ ka egwuregwu vidio ime ihe ike ndị e rere na steeti California ka a mapanye mmewe na-agụpụta "18" na ha ma mere ka ntaramahụhụ maka orire ha nye nwata bụrụ $1000 kwa ịda iwu.
translations.hypothesis: Ihe a na-akpọ "bill" chọrọ ka egwuregwu vidiyo ndị na-egosi ime ihe ọjọọ nke ewere ere na steeti California nwee akara nke na-akọwapụta "18" na ya. Ọ na-eme ka ire egwuregwu ndị a nye onye obere afọ bụrụ ihe na-adịghị mma, na onye na-eme ya ga-anwa ego nke $1000 maka ọ bụla ihe ọ jidere.

translations.source: The Director of Public Prosecutions, Kier Starmer QC, gave a statement this morning announcing the prosecution of both Huhne and Pryce.
translations.reference: Onye nchịkwa Amamikpe n'ihu ọha, Kier Stama QC, kwuru okwu n'ụtụtụ a ikwusa amamikpe Huhne na Pryce.
translations.hypothesis: Onye isi nke ụlọ ọrụ ikpe, Kier Starmer QC, họpụtara akụkọ a ụtụtụ a, sịrị na a ga-akpe gọọli na Huhne na Pryce.

translations.source: Huhne has resigned and he will be replaced in the Cabinet by Ed Davey MP. Norman Lamb MP is expected to take the Business Minister job Davey is vacating.
translations.reference: Huhne agbaala arukwaghi ma onye ga anochi ya na otu ndi oso-eze achi bu Ed Davey MP. Norman Lamb MP ka ana atu-anya ka owere oru onye ozi azumahia Davey na apu-apu.
translations.hypothesis: Huhne ekwetala ebe ọchịchị, ma a ga-akpọ Ed Davey, onye otu Ndị Ndị Nọọrị, ka were ya n'ọkwu ahụ. A tụrụ anya na Norman Lamb, onye otu Ndị Ndị Nọọrị, ga-ewe ọrụ nke Minista Azụmahịa, bụ nke Davey na-ahụ.

translations.source: Huhne and Pryce are scheduled to appear at the Westminster Magistrates Court on February 16.
translations.reference: Ahazirioge Huhne na Pryce ibia n’ihu oka ikpe n’ulo ikpe nke Westiminster Magistrates Court ubochi onwa Februari ga di na 16.
translations.hypothesis: Huhne na Pryce nwere atụmanya ịbịta na ụlọ ikpe Westminster Magistrates na Febrụwarị 16.

translations.source: The fatalities were Nicholas Alden, 25, and Zachary Cuddeback, 21. Cuddeback had been the driver.
translations.reference: Ndị nwụrụ na ya bụ Nicholas Alden, dị afọ 25, na Zachary Cuddeback, dị afọ 21. Cuddeback bụ ya nọ na-anya ụgbọ.
translations.hypothesis: A ndị toro elu bụ Nicholas Alden, afọ 25, na Zachary Cuddeback, afọ 21. Cuddeback bụ onye na-anya ụgbọ ahụ.

translations.source: Edgar Veguilla received arm and jaw wounds while Kristoffer Schneider was left requiring reconstructive surgery for his face.
translations.reference: Edgar Veguilla merụrụ ahụ n'aka na n'agba ma Kristoffer Schneider bụ onye mmerụ ahụ ya ga-ewe ihe ọwụwa maka ihu ya.
translations.hypothesis: Edgar Veguilla nwetara mmerụ na aka na isi, ebe Kristoffer Schneider dị njikere ịnweta usoro ahụike iji dozie ihu ya.

translations.source: Uka's weapon failed whilst pointed at a fifth man's head. Schneider has ongoing pain, blindness in one eye, a missing section of skull and a face rebuilt from titanium.
translations.reference: Ngwa agha Uka dara dị ka ọ tụwara ya n’isi ony nke ise. Schneider nwere ụfụ ka na-afụ, anya ọkpụkpọ n’otu anya, akụkụ okpokoro isi furu efu na ihu arụgharịrị site na taịtenọm.
translations.hypothesis: Ekwu ụkwụ Uka adịghị arụ ọrụ mgbe ọ na-ele anya n'isi otu nwoke ọzọ. Schneider na-enwe mgbe ọ na-eche, enweghị ahụ anya n'anya otu, akụkụ nke isi ya adịghị, ma ihu ya emechara ya site na ihe titanium.

translations.source: Schneider testified via videolink from a USAF base in his homeland.
translations.reference: Schnaida ji ihe vidiyo si na ọnọdụ USAF kwupụta okwu.
translations.hypothesis: Schneider akpọrọ uche site na vidiyo, ebe ọ nọrịrị na otu ụlọ ọrụ nke USAF (Usara Air Force) na obodo ya.

translations.source: Beyond Wednesday's event, Carpanedo competed in two individual races at the Championships.
translations.reference: N’ofe mmemme Wednesdee ahụ, Carpanedo zọrọ asọmpi n’ọsọ ụgbọala abụọ n’Asọmpi Iko ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: E wezụga ihe omume nke ụbọchị Tọọzdee, Carpanedo so n'asọmpi abụọ nke onye ọ bụla n'ime asọmpi ahụ.

translations.source: Her first was the Slalom, where she earned a Did Not Finish in her first run. 36 of the 116 competitors had the same result in that race.
translations.reference: Nke mbụ ya bụ Slalom ahụ, ebe o ritara otu Agbachaghị n'ọsọ mbụ ya. Mmadụ 36 n'ime 116 sọrọ mpi ahụ nwetara otu ihe ahụ n'ọsọ ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ gara n'asọmpi mbụ ya, bụ Slalom, ebe ọ nwetara "Anaghị emechapụ" (Did Not Finish) na ọkara mbụ ya. Ọtụtụ ndị asọmpi, bụ́ 36 n'ime 116, nwetakwara otu uru ahụ n'asọmpi ahụ.

translations.source: Her other race, the Giant Slalom, saw her finish in tenth in the women's sitting group with a combined run time of 4:41.30, 2:11.60 minutes slower than first place finisher Austrian Claudia Loesch and 1:09.02 minutes slower than the ninth place finisher Gyöngyi Dani of Hungary.
translations.reference: N'ọsọ ya nke ọzọ, Giant Slalom, ọ gbachara dị ka onye nke iri n'otu ụmụ nwanyị nọ ọdụ ebe oge ọsọ ya niile bụ nkeji 4: 41.30, nke ji nkeji 2: 11.60 nọrọ n'azụ onye nke mbụ Claudia Loesch onye Austria ma jiri nkeji 1: 09.02 nọrọ n'azụ Gyöngyi Dani onye Hungary gbara onye nke itoolu.
translations.hypothesis: N'oge ọzọ, n'asọmpi "Giant Slalom," ọ gwụchara n'ọkwa nke iri n'etiti ụmụ nwanyị na otu ndị na-anọghị n'ụkwụ, site na oge ọgba nke 4:41.30. Ọkara nkeji 2:11.60 karịrị oge nke Claudia Loesch nke Austria, onye ritere ọkwa mbụ, yana otu nkeji na sekọnd 1:09.02 karịrị oge nke Gyöngyi Dani nke Hungary, onye ritere ọkwa nke iri na ise.

translations.source: Four skiers in the women's sitting group failed to finish their runs, and 45 of the 117 total skiers in the Giant Slalom failed to rank in the race.
translations.reference: Skiers anọ nwanyị nọ n'otu ụmụ nwanyị dara ịgbacha ọsọ ha, na 45 n'ime skiers 117 nọ na Giant Slalom dara isonye na ndị gbatara ihe n'egwuregwu ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: Anọ ndị na-agba ọsọ anyanwụ n'ọtú ụmụ nwanyị na-anọghị n'ọdịnihu, na ndị ọzọ, 45 n'ime 117 ndị na-agba ọsọ anyanwụ niile, adịghị enwe ọkwa ọla edo na asọmpi ahụ.

translations.source: The Madhya Pradesh Police recovered the stolen laptop and mobile phone.
translations.reference: Ndị uwe ojii Madhya Pradesh weghachitela nkùnụkwụ na ekwentị kengagharị ndị e zuru n'ohi.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị ọrụ ụlọ ọrụ nchekwa Madhya Pradesh chọtara akpa kọmputa na ekwensị fọọrụ nke e chọpụrụ.

translations.source: Deputy Inspector General D K Arya said, "We have arrested five persons who raped the Swiss woman and recovered her mobile and laptop".
translations.reference: Onye na-esote Onye Isi Ndị Uweojii bụ D K Arya kwuru sị, "Anyị anwụchiela mmadụ ise ndị dinara n'ike nwanyị Swiss ahụ ma napụtakwa ekwentị na nkùnụkwụ ya".
translations.hypothesis: Onyeisi nke abụọ nke ndị nlochi, D K Arya, kwuru, "Anyị etolitee ndị mmadụ ise bụ ndị gbasara nwanyị Swiss ahụ, anyị welekwara ekwentị mkpanakota ya na kọmputa ya."

translations.source: The accused are named as Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar and Vishnu Kanjar.
translations.reference: Ndị eboro ebubo bụ Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar na Vishnu Kanjar.
translations.hypothesis: Akwụkwọ ụkpụrụ anyị na-akpọ aha ndị a: Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar, na Vishnu Kanjar.

translations.source: Police superintendent Chandra Shekhar Solanki said the accused appeared in court with covered faces.
translations.reference: Onye isi ndị uweojii Chandra Shekhar Solanki sị na ndị eboro ebubo kpuchiri ihu bịa n'ụlọ ikpe.
translations.hypothesis: Onye isi ndị uwe ojii, Chandra Shekhar Solanki, kwuru na onye ama akara ahụ pụtara n'ụlọ ikpe, ebe e kpuchiri ihu ya.

translations.source: Although three people were inside the house when the car impacted it, none of them were hurt.
translations.reference: Obu eziokwu na mmadu ato no nime ulo ahu mgbe ugbo-ala ahu kuru ya, onweghi onye nime ha meruru ahu.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bụ ezie na otu ụlọ ọkwụ kụrụ ụlọ ahụ, ma otu ụmụ mmadụ atọ nọ n'ime ụlọ ahụ, ọ dịghị onye n'ime ha jọrọ.

translations.source: However, the driver sustained serious injuries to the head.
translations.reference: N'agbanyeghị nke a, onye ọkwọ ụgbọ merụrụ ezigbo ahụ n'isi.
translations.hypothesis: Otú ọ dị, onye ọkwọ ụgbọ ala ahụ nweta mmerụ ahụ dị ukwuu n'isi ya.

translations.source: The road where the crash happened was temporarily closed while emergency services freed the driver from the red Audi TT.
translations.reference: E mechiri nwa oge okporo ụzọ ahụ ebe ihe mberede mere ebe ndị ọrụ mberede tọhapụrụ onye ọkwọ ụgbọ ala ahụ site na Audi TT na-acha uhie.
translations.hypothesis: Ọdụ ụzọ ebe ihe mgbagwoju anya ahụ mere bịara ekewapụ n'akụkụ, ebe ndị ọrụ ahụike na-akpakọrịta tinyere onye ọkọchị ahụ, bụ onye nọrị na ụgbọ ala ahụ nke bụ Audi TT na agba uhie, pụọ.

translations.source: He was initially hospitalised in the James Paget Hospital in Great Yarmouth.
translations.reference: Ọ nọbu n'ụlọ ọgwụ Jems Pajet dị na Gret Yamawụt.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bịara n'ụlọọgwụ James Paget na Great Yarmouth n'ime izu ụka mbụ.

translations.source: He was subsequently relocated to Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge.
translations.reference: E mechara kwagarịa ya n’Ụlọ ọgwụ Addenbrooke na Kembriji.
translations.hypothesis: Mgbe ahụ, a kọwara ya n'azụ na a ga-ebuga ya gaa ụlọ ọgwụ Addenbrooke na Cambridge.

translations.source: Adekoya has since been in Edinburgh Sheriff Court charged with murdering her son.
translations.reference: Adekọya anọrọla n'Ụlọ ikpe Obodo Edịnbọg ebe eboro ya ebubo maka igbu nwa ya nwoke.
translations.hypothesis: Adekoya, kemgbe ahụ, nọ na ụlọ ikpe Sheriff nke Edinburgh, ebe a na-akpọ ya aha maka mmebi ezinụlọ ya.

translations.source: She is in custody pending indictment and trial, but any eyewitness evidence may be tainted because her image has been widely published.
translations.reference: Atụrụ ya nga ma na-eche ikpe, mana akụkọ ọgba ama ọbụla nwere ike ịbụ nke rụrụ arụ n'ihi na ebipụtara onyonyo ya ọfụma.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ dị n'ọrụ ụlọ gọọmentị, na-echefu ụbọchị ebute ya na ụbọchị ikpe ya, mana enwere ike inwe nsogbu na ihe ndị anya ndị ama ama na-ahụ, n'ihi na foto ya emeela ka ọ bụrụ ihe a maara nke ukwuu.

translations.source: This is common practice elsewhere in the UK but Scottish justice works differently and courts have viewed publication of photos as potentially prejudicial.
translations.reference: Nke a bụ omume a na-ahụkarị ebe ndị ọzọ na UK mana íkpé íkpē Scottish na-arụ ọrụ n'ụzọ dị iche ma ụlọ ikpe eleela mbipụta nke fotò gasị dị ka ihe nwere ike ịbụ ajọ mbunobi.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bụ ihe nkịtị na ebe ndị ọzọ na United Kingdom, mana usoro ikpe na Scotland na-arụ ọrụ iche iche, ma ụlọ ikpe ahụ chọpụtala na ịkpọpụta foto nwere ike ịkpata nsogbu.

translations.source: Professor Pamela Ferguson of the University of Dundee notes "journalists do seem to be walking a dangerous line if publishing photos etc of suspects."
translations.reference: Ọkachamara Pamela Ferguson nke Mahadum Dundee kwuru "ndị nta akụkọ dị ka ndị na-aga ije n'ebe dị oke egwu ma ọ bụrụ na ha ebipụta foto na ihe ndị ọzọ nke ndị a na-enyo enyo."
translations.hypothesis: Prọfesọ Pamela Ferguson nke Mahadịm Enugu Dundee kwuru, "Ọ dị ka ndị na-akụkọ akụkọ na-aga n'okporo ụzọ emezughị eze ma ha na-akwupụ foto na ihe ndị ọzọ gbasara ndị a na-akpọrọ."

translations.source: Crown Office, which is in overall charge of prosecutions, has indicated to journalists that no further comment will be made at least until indictment.
translations.reference: Ụlọ ọrụ Krawn, nke nọ n'isi amamikpe, agwala ndị nta akụkọ na ha agaghị ekwu okwu gbasara okwu akpụ n'ọnụ ozo ruo mgbe amara mmadụ ikpe.
translations.hypothesis: Ofisi Crown, nke na-ahụ maka njikwa niile nke ikpe, egosiri ndị nta akụkọ na ọ gaghị enye ọzọ ọ bụla maka oge, ma ọ dịkarịa ọkachamara ruo mgbe a na-akpọkwa ikpe.

translations.source: The document, according to the leak, will refer to the borders dispute, which Palestine wants based on the borders before the 1967 Mideast War.
translations.reference: Dọkumentị ahụ, na-ndabere na ohihiahụ, ga-arụnye aka na ụmụ mgbagha oke ala ndị ahụ, nke Palestaịnụ chọrọ na-ndabere n’ụmụ oke ala tupu Agha Mideast 1967 ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: Akụkọ a, dịka akụkọ nke wepụtara, ga-ekwu banyere mgbe a na-agba mbọ gbasara mpụta uwe, nke Palestine chọrọ, dabere na mpụta uwe dị na mbụ, tupu agha nke 1967 na mpaghara Etinanị.

translations.source: Other topics covered reportedly include the future state of Jerusalem which is sacred to both nations and the Jordan Valley issue.
translations.reference: Isiokwu ndị ọzọ ekpuchiri gụnyere site n'ihe akọrọ ọdịnihu Jerusalem nke dị nsọ nye mba abụọ ahụ na okwu Ndagwurugwu Jọdan.
translations.hypothesis: Ụfọdụ ihe ndị ọzọ akọkwara, dịka akọrọ, gụnyere ọnọdụ Jerusalem n'ọdịnihu, ebe a na-eche ya dị ka ebe nzube site n'akụkụ abụọ, na nsogbu ebe Jordan Valley.

translations.source: Israel demands an ongoing military presence in the valley for ten years once an agreement is signed while the PA agrees to leave such presence only for five years.
translations.reference: Israel na-achọ ka ndị agha nọrọ na ndagwụrụgwụ a ruo afọ iri ozigbo abanyere na nkwekọrịta, mana PA chọrọ ka ndị agha a nọrọ ruo naanị afọ ise.
translations.hypothesis: Israel na-achọ ka a nọọ ọtụtụ ndị agha n'ebe ahụ ruo afọ iri, mgbe nkwekọrịta ahụ bịrịrị, ebe ọtụtụ ndị na-achịkwa Palestine (PA) kwenyere ka ndị agha ahụ nọọ naanị ruo afọ ise.

translations.source: Shooters in the supplementary pest control trial were to be closely supervised by rangers, as the trial was monitored and its effectiveness evaluated.
translations.reference: Ndị nche legidere ndị ọgbaa anya nke ọma ka ha mere nnwale njikwa ọtapịapịa nke ntụkwasị, dịka e lebara anya na nnwale ahụ ma tụlee ma ọ dị ire.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị na-eyi ihe na nyocha a maka ikwewanye ụgwọ maka ikpochapụ mkpụrụ ahụchụ ga-enwe ndị nlekọta obere ọdịdị, ebe a na-ele anya na nyocha ahụ wee họpụtara ọganihu ya.

translations.source: In a partnership of NPWS and the Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, qualified volunteers were recruited, under the Sporting Shooters Association's hunting program.
translations.reference: N’ime otu mmekọrịta nke NPWS na Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, e were n’ọrụ ndị ọrụ afọ ofufo tozuru oke, n’okpuru mmemme ịchụ nta nke Sporting Shooters Association ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: N'ime otu akwakọkwọ nke NPWS na Ụlọ ọrụ Sporting Shooters Association nke Australia (NSW) Inc, ndị otu n'ezie bịarutere, site na mmemme ntụzi nke Sporting Shooters Association.

translations.source: According to Mick O'Flynn, the Acting Director Park Conservation and Heritage with the NPWS, the four shooters selected for the first shooting operation received comprehensive safety and training instruction.
translations.reference: Dị ka Mik O'Flynn, Onye isi ọrụ na NPWS na-ahụ maka Ndokwa Ogige na Nketa, kwuru, ndị ọgba egbe anọ a họọrọ maka mmemme ọgbụgba nke mbụ bụ ndị akuzigorola nchekwa ma nye ha ọzụzụ.
translations.hypothesis: Dịka Mick O'Flynn, onye bụ Onye Ndịzi Ogeji maka Nchekwa Park na Ndụmọdụ Ndụ, sịrị, ndị na-akpọ ụkwụ anọ ahụ bụ ndị a họpụtara maka ọrụ akpọ ụkwụ mbụ ahụ, e nyere ha nduzi na nkuzi zuru oke gbasara nchekwa na usoro ọrụ.

translations.source: Martelly swore in a new Provisional Electoral Council (CEP) of nine members yesterday.
translations.reference: Martelly n̄ụrụ iyi n’ime otu Kansụl Ntuli aka Kenwa oge (CEP) ọhụrụ nke ndịòtù itoollu ụnyaahụ.
translations.hypothesis: N'ụbọchị gara echi, Martelly họpụtara ndị otu ọhụrụ nke Council Electoral mpaghara (CEP) nke nwere ndị otu ise.

translations.source: It is Martelly's fifth CEP in four years.
translations.reference: Ọ bụ CEP nke ise nke Marteli n'afọ anọ.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bụ ọkara nke ise nke CEP (Komisyoni Electoral) nke Martelly nwere n'ime afọ anọ.

translations.source: Last month a presidential commission recommended the prior CEP's resignation as part of a package of measures to move the country towards new elections.
translations.reference: N'ọnwa gara aga ozi sitere n'onye ọchịchị kwadoro ọgbụgba arụkwaghịm CEP nọbu anọ dịka ihe so n'usoro omume ihe ibuje obodo na ntuli aka ọhụrụ
translations.hypothesis: N'ọnwa gara aga, otu ọrụ nke gọọmentị kọwara na onye bụbu onye isi nke ụlọ ọrụ ahụ kwesịrị ịkwụsị ọrụ ya, dịka akụkụ nke atụmatụ iji kwalite mba ahụ n'ụzọ dị mma maka nhọrọ ọhụrụ.

translations.source: The commission was Martelly's response to widespread anti-regime protests that started in October.
translations.reference: Ntinye ọrụ ahụ bụ azịza Martelly maka ngagharị iwe nke mgbochi ọchịchị zuru ebe niile nke bidoro na Ọktoba.
translations.hypothesis: Ukwu a bụ azịza nke Martelly nye mkpakọrịta na-emepepe nke na-emepepe gọọmentị, nke malitere na Ọktoba.

translations.source: The sometimes-violent protests were triggered by failure to hold elections, some due since 2011.
translations.reference: Ụmụ ngagharị iwe a na-alụ ọgụ mgbe ụfọdụ na ya bụ ọdịda ime ntuli aka kpatara ya, ụfọdụ etozuola kemgbe 2011.
translations.hypothesis: Aghụta ụfọdụ, mgbe ụfọdụ na-emetụta ahụ, malitere n'ihi enweghị atụmanya maka nhọrọ, ụfọdụ nke kwesịrị ịgbawa kemgbe afọ 2011.

translations.source: Around 60 cases of malfunctioning iPods overheating have been reported, causing a total of six fires and leaving four people with minor burns.
translations.reference: E kwuputala na na e nweela nsogbu 60 sitere na iPods ndị n'anaghị arụ ọrụ nke ọma na-ekwo oke ọkụ, nke na-ebutala ọkụ ọgbụgba isii merụrụ ndị mmadụ ahụ obere.
translations.hypothesis: Ọtụtụ ihe karịrị 60 akụkọ egosiri banyere iPod ndị na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma ma na-adị ọkụ, nke mere ka mmiri ọkụ bute otu ugboro ise, na ọtụtụ mmadụ anọ nwetara mmerụ ahụ dị nta.

translations.source: Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) said that it had been aware of 27 accidents related to the devices.
translations.reference: Ministri Japan nke Akụnụba, Azụmaahịa na Ụlọ ọrụ mmepụta (METI) kwuru na ọ ma ama maka ihe mberede iri abụọ na asaa metụtara njìarụ ndị ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: Minista Ahia, Azụmahịa na Ọrụ Japan (METI) kwuru na ha maara banyere ihe dị ka akụkụ 27 nke ihe mgbechi nke mere n'ihi ngwaọrụ ndị a.

translations.source: Last week, METI announced that Apple had informed it of 34 additional overheating incidents, which the company called "non-serious."
translations.reference: N'izuka gara aga, METI mara okwa sị na Apple gwara ya gbasara oke ekpomoku iri atọ na anọ merenụ, nke ụlọ ọrụ kpọrọ "ihe na-abụghị ihe."
translations.hypothesis: N'izu gara enye, METI kọwara na Apple akọwara ya banyere 34 ọkwa ọzọ nke mmebi ọkụ, nke ụlọ ọrụ ahụ kpọrọ "ọdịda na-enweghị mberede."

translations.source: The ministry responded by calling Apple's postponement of the report "truly regrettable."
translations.reference: Ụlọ ozi zaghachiri sị na mbugharị oge rịpọt Apple mere dị "mwute n'ezie".
translations.hypothesis: Otu ọrụ ahụ kwadoro site na ịkọwa na mbelata oge nke Apple iji wetara akụkọ ahụ bụ "ihe na-atụ ntị na-atụ."

translations.source: The eathquake struck Mariana at 07:19 a.m. local time (09:19 p.m. GMT Friday).
translations.reference: Ala ọma jijiji ahụ mere Mariana na 07:19 elekere ụtụtụ mpaghara (09:19 p.m. GMT Friday).
translations.hypothesis: Ahụhụ ala ahụ tụrụ Mariana na elekere 7:19 nke ụtụtụ n'oge mpaghara (elekere 9:19 nke abalị GMT na Ụzọọ Friday).

translations.source: The Northern Marianas emergency management office said that there were no damages reported in the nation.
translations.reference: Ụlọ ọrụ nlekọta ihe mberede nke Nọtan Marianas sị na onweghị mmebi ihe akọpụtara n'obodo.
translations.hypothesis: Ozi sitere n'ofis njikwa ihe mgba ọrịa nke Northern Marianas kwuru na enweghị mmebi ọ bụla akọrọ n'obodo ahụ.

translations.source: Also the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center said that there was no Tsunami indication.
translations.reference: Ụlọọrụ ịdọ aka na ntị n'ihe gbasara ebili mmiri nke Pasifiki sị na onweghi ihe gosiri na ebili mmiri na-abịa.
translations.hypothesis: Ọzọkwa, ọkwa Pacific Tsunami Warning Center kwuru na ọ dịghị ihe na-egosi na enwere tsunami.

translations.source: A former Filipino policeman has kept Hong Kong tourists hostage by hijacking their bus in Manila, the capital of the Philippines.
translations.reference: Otu onye Filipino wụbụrụ onye uwe ojii edobela ndị njem nleta Hong Kong na njigide site n’ịkwụsị n’ike bọọsụ ha n’ime Manila, isiobodo nke ndị Filipaịnụ.
translations.hypothesis: Otu onye ọrụ ụlọ ọrụ nchekwa nke Philippines nke gara aga jidere ndị njalaba si Hong Kong n'aka site na ịgbatị ụgbọ oloko ha na Manila, bụ ibuolile nke Philippines.

translations.source: Rolando Mendoza fired his M16 rifle at the tourists.
translations.reference: Rolando Mendoza gbara egbe ya bụ M16 n’ebe ndị njem nọ.
translations.hypothesis: Rolando Mendoza jiri ọgba ọgụ ya nke M16 kpọrọ ndị njalaba ahụ.

translations.source: Several hostages have been rescued and least six have been confirmed dead so far.
translations.reference: Azọpụtara ọtụtụ ndị eji èji ma mmadụ isii ka ekwuru na ha anwụọla.
translations.hypothesis: Ọtụtụ ndị bịarara n'aka adịghị njikere eweghara ha, ma ruo ugbu a, e kwuru na enweghị opekempe ndị isii nwụrụ.

translations.source: Six hostages, including the children and elderly, were released early, as were the Filipino photographers.
translations.reference: Ndị ejigidere ejigide isii, tinyere ụmụaka na ndị okenye, ka ahapụrụ n'oge, ma ndị Filipino n'ese foto.
translations.hypothesis: Ezigbo mmadụ ise, gụnyere ụmụaka na ndị agadi, ji eweghara ha n'ụbọchị, otu ahụkwa ndị na-eyi foto ndị Filipino.

translations.source: The photographers later took the place of an aged lady as she needed the lavatory. Mendoza was gunned down.
translations.reference: Ndị ose foto ahụ mechara nọchie otu agadi nwanyị dịka ọ gara ụlọmposi. A gbagburu Mendoza.
translations.hypothesis: Onye ọchị foto ndị ahụ n'ụlọ ahụ n'oge na-edozi ụlọ mposi, onye nwanyị ochie ahụ chọrọ ịga ụlọ mposi. Mendoza jiri akwụkwọ ndụ akwụkwọ ndụ.

translations.source: Liggins followed in his father’s footsteps and entered a career in medicine.
translations.reference: Liggins soro n’uzoụkwụ nna ya ma banye n’ọrụ ọgwụ.
translations.hypothesis: Liggins soro n'ụzọ nna ya, wee bido ọrụ ya na ụlọọgwụ.

translations.source: He trained as an obstetrician and began to work at the Auckland's National Women's Hospital in 1959.
translations.reference: Ọ zụrụ ọzụzụ dị ka ọkachamara nke nne na-amụ nwa wee malite ịrụ ọrụ na Ụlọ Ọgwụ Ndị Inyom Nke ala Auckland na 1959.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ zụrụ ọrụ dị ka onye na-elekọta ndị inyom, wee malite ọrụ ya na ụlọ ọgwụ ụmụ nwanyị mba Auckland na afọ 1959.

translations.source: While he was working at the hospital Liggins began to investigate premature labor during his spare time.
translations.reference: Mgbe ọ na-arụ ọrụ n'ụlọ ọgwụ Liggins malitere inyocha ọmụmụ nwa akaghị aka n'oge ezumike ya.
translations.hypothesis: N'oge ọ na-arụ ọrụ na ụlọọgwụ ahụ, Liggins malitere ịlele ihe gbasara mmepụta ọmụmụ nke na-abịa n'oge na-adịghị izi ezi, n'oge o nwere oge ọzọ.

translations.source: His research showed that if a hormone was administered it would speed up the baby's foetal lung maturation.
translations.reference: Nlebaanya ya gosiri na e nye homonu, ọ ga-eme ka nkuume nwata dị n'afọ tozuo oke ọsịsọ karịa.
translations.hypothesis: Nnyocha ya gbakwuru na ọ bụrụ na a tinye usoro hormonal, ọ ga-agbaso ọganihu nke ahụike ume nke nwa ahụ n'ime afọ.

translations.source: Xinhua reported that government investigators recovered two 'black box' flight recorders on Wednesday.
translations.reference: Xinhua kwuru na ndị nnyocha gọọmenti chọtara igwe 'igbe ojii' na-edokọ etu njem ụgbọelu si gaa na Wenezdee.
translations.hypothesis: Akụkọ sitere na Xinhua gosiiri na ndị nyocha gọọmentị chọtara abụọ n'ime ngwaọrụ nchekwa ozi nke ọgbọ ụgbọ elu, nke a na-akpọ "black box," na Wednesdey.

translations.source: Fellow wrestlers also paid tribute to Luna.
translations.reference: Ndị mgba ibe ha mere ihe ndị gosiri nkwanye ugwu nye Luna.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị ọbụta ndị ọzọ nọkwa n'etiti ndị ji ekele na nkwado gosi maka Luna.

translations.source: Tommy Dreamer said "Luna was the first Queen of Extreme. My first manager. Luna passed away on the night of two moons. Pretty unique just like her. Strong woman."
translations.reference: Tọmi Drima sị na "Luna bụ Eze nwaanyị ihe ngabiga oke nke mbụ. Onye nlekwa ọrụ m nke mbụ. Luna nwụrụ n'abalị ọnwa abụọ. Ọ pụrụ iche dị ka ya. Nwaanyị siri ike."
translations.hypothesis: Tommy Dreamer kwuru, "Luna bụ nwanyị mbụ bụ "Queen of Extreme". Ọ bụ onye isi m mbụ. Luna nwụrụ n'abalị abụọ nke ọzọ. Ọ bụ ihe dị iche, dị ka ọ dị ya. Ọ bụ nwanyị dị ike."

translations.source: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels commented that "Luna was as freaky as me...maybe even more...love her and will miss her...hopefully she's in a better place."
translations.reference: Dọstin "Goldọst" Runnels sị na "Luna na-eme ihe ndị ara ka m...onwere ike karịa... ahụrụ m ya n'anya aga m na atụkwa anya ya... Enwerem olileanya na ọnọ ebe ka mma."
translations.hypothesis: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels kwuru na "Luna nwere ọdịmma dị ka m...ma ọ bụrụkwa karịa...anụ m ya ma ga-enwe ọchịchọ maka ya...ma amụma ka ọ nọ n'ebe dị mma."

translations.source: Out of 1,400 people polled prior to the 2010 federal election, those who oppose Australia becoming a republic grew by 8 per cent since 2008.
translations.reference: N'ime mmadụ otu puku na iri anọ tụrụ ụtụ tupu ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị gọọmenti etiti nke afọ 2010, ndị megidere mba Ọstrelia ịbụ obodo kwuuru onwe ya ji pasentị asatọ rịa elu kemgbe afọ 2008.
translations.hypothesis: N'ime ndị 1,400 bụ ndị akụụrụ echiche tupu nhọrọ ọchịchị etiti nke afọ 2010, ndị na-emezughị onwe ha banyere ịmụ Australia bụ obodo ahụike, gbadatara site na 8 pasent site na afọ 2008.

translations.source: Caretaker Prime Minister Julia Gillard claimed during the campaign of the 2010 federal election that she believed Australia should become a republic at the end of Queen Elizabeth II's reign.
translations.reference: Onye nlekota ala (Caretaker Prime Minister) Julia Gillard kwuru n’oge Kampeenu nke nhoputa ndi ochichi nke goomenti etiti na okwere na Australia kwesiri ibu repoblik ma Eze nwanyi Elizabeth nke abuo chicha.
translations.hypothesis: Nwanyị Julia Gillard, onye bụ Prisidenti dị n'aka na-agụnye, kwuru n'oge mpi maka nhọrọ ọchịchị nke afọ 2010 na ọ chọrọ ka Australia bụrụ obodo onye isi n'oge na-esote mgbe ọchịchị Queen Elizabeth II gwụchara.

translations.source: 34 per cent of those in the poll share this view, wanting Queen Elizabeth II to be Australia's last monarch.
translations.reference: 34 nime-otu-nari-nile bu ndi tinyere aka na ntuli aka ahu n’enwe otu uche ahu, n’acho ka Eze-nwanyi Elizabeth II buru onye eze nke ikpeazu nke Australia.
translations.hypothesis: Ọkara atọ na anọ (34%) n'ime ndị sonyere na nyocha ahụ na-akwado echiche a, ha chọrọ ka Queen Elizabeth II bụrụ onye ikpeazu ga-achị Australia.

translations.source: At the extremes of the poll, 29 per cent of those surveyed believe Australia should become a republic as soon as possible, while 31 per cent believe Australia should never become a republic.
translations.reference: Ka ịtụ vootu nọ na ngwụcha, pasentị iri abụọ na itolu n'ime ndị elebaara anya kwenyere na Ọstrelia kwesịrị ịbụrụ mba nọọrọ onwe ya ngwa ngwa, ebe pasentị iri atọ na otu kwenyere na Ọstrelia ekwesịghị ịbụ obodo nọọrọ onwe ya.
translations.hypothesis: N'ime ndị bịarutere ụdị atụmatụ dị iche iche, afọ 29 n'ụdị atụmatụ nke ndị bịara akụkọ ahụ chọrọ na Australia ga-aghọ obere ọchịchị ngwa ngwa, ebe afọ 31 n'ụdị atụmatụ chọrọ na Australia ekwaghị ekwa ga-aghọ obere ọchịchị.

translations.source: The Olympic gold medalist was due to swim in the 100m and 200m freestyle and in three relays at the Commonwealth Games, but due to his complaints his fitness has been in doubt.
translations.reference: Onye nwebụrụ mgbanye ọlaedo Olympicruru igwu mmiri na nke 100m na 200m ụdị nnwere onwe na ngwụgharị ugboro atọ n'Egwuregwu Commonwealth ahụ, mana n’ihi mkpesa ya, enweela obi abụọ maka ịdị mma nke ahụike ya.
translations.hypothesis: Onye meriri ọla edo na egwuregwu Olimpik ahụ kwesịrị ịgaba n'asọmpi 100m na 200m n'ọsụsụ, yana n'asọmpi iri atọọọ na atọọ, mana n'ihi mgbe ọ tụgharịrị anya, a na-atụgharị anya banyere ahụike ya.

translations.source: He has been unable to take the drugs needed to overcome his pain as they are banned from the Games.
translations.reference: O nwebeghị ike ịn̄ụ ọgwụ ndị ahụ o kwesịrị iji merie mgbu ya dị ka a machibidoro ha iwu site n’Egwuregwu.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ naghị enweghị ike iri ọgwụ ndị ọ chọrọ iji gbanwee mgbe ọ na-eche, n'ihi na a machibidoro ọgwụ ndị ahụ n'oge egwuregwu ahụ.

translations.source: Curtis Cooper, a mathematician and computer science professor at the University of Central Missouri, has discovered the largest known prime number to date on January 25.
translations.reference: Curtis Cooper, onye ọka mmụta mgbakọ na mwepụ na onye ọka mmụta sayensị kọmputa na Mahadum nke Etiti Missouri, achọpụtala akara praịm kachasị buo ibu ruo ta na Jenụwarị 25.
translations.hypothesis: Curtis Cooper, onye ọkà mmụta akọwapụta na onye nkuzi n'ihe gbasara teknụzụ kọmputa na Mahadum Central Missouri, chọpụtala ọnụọgụ prime kachasị ukwuu nke ama ama ruo taa, na Jenụwarị 25.

translations.source: Several people verified the discovery using different hardware and software by the beginning of February and it was announced on Tuesday.
translations.reference: Ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ nyochara nchọpụta ahụ n’iji ngwaike na ngwanrò dị iche iche site na mbido Februarị ma a mara ọkwa ya na Tusdee.
translations.hypothesis: Ọtụtụ ndị nwaliri nchọpụta ahụ site na iji ngwaọrụ na ngwanrọ dị iche iche, na mmalite nke ọnwa Febrụwarị, ma akụkọ ahụ bịara emepụta na Ụzọọ Tuesday.

translations.source: Comets may possibly have been a source of water delivery to the earth along with organic matter that can form proteins and support life.
translations.reference: Ụmụ Kọmetị nwere ike ịbụ isi mmalite nnefe mmiri nye ụwa ya na ihe dị ndụ nwere ike ịmepụta ụmụ protiin ma kwado ndụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ nwere ike bụrụ na ndị mmadụ (comets) bụ otu ụzọ eji ebu mmiri na ihe ndị ọzọ dị ndụ na ụwa, ebe ihe ndị a nwere ike ịmepụta prọtein na-akwalite ndụ.

translations.source: Scientists hope to understand how planets form, especially how the Earth formed, since comets collided with the Earth long ago.
translations.reference: Ndị ọka mmụta sayensị nwere olileanya ịghọta ka uwa dị iche iche sị kpụọ, ọkachasị otu ụwa anyị siri kpụọ, kemgbe okwute igwe na ụwa anyị sukọkọ isi n'ote aka.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị ọchịchịmma na-atụ anya ịmatakwu banyere otu ụwa ndị na-acha uhie na-ebili, karịsịa otu ụwa anyị, Ala, si ebili, ebe ọ bụ na ọtụtụ afọ gara aga, ụda mmiri na-acha ọbara ọbara gbapụrụ Ala.

translations.source: Cuomo, 53, began his governorship earlier this year and signed a bill last month legalizing same-sex marriage.
translations.reference: Kuomo, onye dị afọ iri ise na atọ, bidoro ọchịchị gọọmenti steeti na mbido afọ a ma binye aka n'ọnwa gara aga n'iwu kwadoro mmekọahụ nwoke na nwoke maọbụ nwanyị na nwanyị.
