translations.hypothesis: Anụ ọhịa nwere ike imegide nri, mee ka mmadụ nwee mmetụta na-adịghị mma, ma n'ọnọdụ ọjọọ, ha nwere ike mee ka mmadụ nwee mmetụta nke anụ ahụ na-ereagị, weta ihe ndị na-emerụ ahụ, ma ọ bụ wetakwanụ ọrịa.

translations.source: Infectious diseases themselves, or dangerous animals that can injure or kill people by force, do not usually qualify as pests.
translations.reference: Ụmụ ọrịa na-efe efe n’onwe ha, ma ọ bụ ụmụ anụmanụ dị egwu nwere ike imerụ ma ọ bụ gbuo mmadụ n’ike, a na-ghị etozukarị oke dị ka ụmụ ahụhụ a na-achọghị.
translations.hypothesis: Mgbaze ahụ nke ọrịa na-agbanwe, ma ọ bụ anụ ọhịa na-emetụta, nke nwere ike imetụta ma ọ bụ gbuo ndị mmadụ n'ụzọ ike, adịghịkarịrị ikwu dị ka "ihe na-emere mmetụ."

translations.source: Duty free shopping is the opportunity to buy goods exempted from taxes and excises at certain locations.
translations.reference: Azụmaahịa na-enweghị ụtụ isi bụ ohere ịzụ ngwaahịa ndị ewezụgara site na ụtụ isi n’ụgwọ ndị ọzọ n’ebe ụfọdụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ịzụ ahịa na-enweghị ụgwọ ọrụ bụ ohere ịzụta ngwaahịa ndị a na-ewepụta ụgwọ ọrụ na ụgwọ ọzọ na ụlọ ahịa ndị a na-achọpụta.

translations.source: Travellers bound for countries with heavy taxation can sometimes save a considerable amount of money, especially on products such as alcoholic beverages and tobacco.
translations.reference: Ndị njem na-aga mba ndị nwere nnukwu ụtụ isi nwere ike mgbe ụfọdụ ichekwa ọkpụrụkpụrụ ego, tụmadị na ngwaahịa dị ka ụmụ ihe ọn̄ụn̄ụ ndị na-aba n'anya na ụtaba.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị na-eje ije gaa mba ndị nwere ọrụ ụgwọ ọha na ụgwọ akụ ụlọ karị, n'ụdị ihe dị iche iche, nwee ike ịchekwa ego dị ukwuu, karịsịa na ngwaahịa dị ka mmanya na akwụkwọ.

translations.source: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain.
translations.reference: Mgbatị ụzọ nọ n'etiti Point Marion na Fairmont na-enye ọnọdụ ịnya ụgbọala kachasị taa akpụ n'Okporoụzọ Buffalo-Pittsburg, na-agafe ọtụtụ oge site n'ọdịdịala azụ ọhịa dịpụrụ adịpụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ọdụ ụgbọ ala dị n'etiti Point Marion na Fairmont bụ ụzọ kacha sie ike ịnya ụgbọ ala na ọdụ ụgbọ ala Buffalo-Pittsburgh, n'ihi na ọ na-agafe ugboro ugboro n'ebe obere na ebe mpụrụ ma ama.

translations.source: If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate.
translations.reference: Oburu na imaatachabeghi ka esi anya ugboala n’okporouzo ime obodo, ume ahapukwala gi: uzo n’akpode akpode, uzo di wara wara na nkuku nko juru eju.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bụrụ na ị maghị ịnya ụgbọ ala na okporo ndị obere obere, jide onwe gị ike: ọtụtụ okporo nwere ogwe dị elu, ọtụtụ ọkpọrọ dị nta, na ọtụtụ akụkụ dị mkpụrụ.

translations.source: Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise.
translations.reference: Ókè ekwomọsọ ebipụtara dị obere karịa n'ụzọ ahụrụ anya na ngalaba ndị ọzọ gara aga ma ndị na-abịa abịa - na-abụkarị mph 35-40 (km/h 56-64) - ma nrubeisi siri ike na ha kara dị mkpa karịa otu ọzọ.
translations.hypothesis: Ọdịdị ọsọ a na-akọwapụta na agba osimiri bụkarị ala karịa na mpaghara ndị ọzọ tupu ya na mgbe ya—karịrị 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h)—ma ọtụtụ isi na-achọpụta na ọ dị mkpa karịa ihe ọ bụla ịkpa otu a n'ihi na ọ bụ iwu.

translations.source: Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
translations.reference: Na mmata ihe, n'agbanyeghị, ọrụ ekwentị mkpààgagharị ka dị ike ebe a karịa ọtụtụ ogologo ụzọ ndị ọzọ ahụ, dịka ọmụmaatụ Ọhịa Pennsylvania ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: N'ile, ọ bụ eziokwu na ọrụ ekwentị mọbịlụ na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma karị ebe a karịa na ọtụtụ ebe ndị ọzọ n'oge a na-aga, dịka ọmụmaatụ, Pennsylvania Wilds.

translations.source: German pastries are quite good, and in Bavaria, are quite rich and varied, similar to those of their southern neighbor, Austria.
translations.reference: Pastrị ndị Jamini dị nnọọ mma; na Bavaria, ọ na-enwe ọtụtụ ihe ma dịkwa iche iche ka nke ndị Ọstrịa, agbata obi ha n'akụkụ ndịda.
translations.hypothesis: Akụkụ nri ndị German dị mma, ma na Bavaria, ha dị oke ọnụ na dị iche iche, dị ka akụkụ nri ndị e sitere na obodo ochie ha, Austria.

translations.source: Fruit pastries are common, with apples cooked into pastries year round, and cherries and plums making their appearances during the summer.
translations.reference: A na-ahụkarị ụmụ achịcha mkpụrụ osisi, e ji apụl eme achịcha mgbe niile n'afọ, ejikwa cheri na plọm eme achịcha n'oge sọma.
translations.hypothesis: Ụkpụrụ nke akwụkwọ nri na-adịkarị, ebe a na-etinye akwụkwọ osisi, dị ka apple, n'ime ụkpụrụ ndị ahụ ruo afọ niile, yana akwụkwọ cherry na plum na-apụta n'oge ọkọchị.

translations.source: Many German baked goods also feature almonds, hazelnuts, and other tree nuts. Popular cakes often pair particularly well with a cup of strong coffee.
translations.reference: Ọtụtụ ngwaahịa achịcha eghere eghe na Jamanị na-egosipụtakwa njirimara ụmụ alịmọndụ, hezelnọt, na mkpụrụ osisi ndị ọzọ. Achịcha ndị ama ama na-agakarị nke ọma ya na otu iko nke kọfị siri ike.
translations.hypothesis: Ọtụtụ nri ndị German nke a na-esi n'ime oven, ọtụtụ n'ime ha nwekwara almonds, hazelnuts, na akụrụ ndị ọzọ sitere na osisi. Akụkọ ndụ nke ndị na-eri akụkọ ndụ, ọtụtụ n'ime ha na-adị mma karịsịa mgbe ha jiri kọfị siri ike.

translations.source: If you want some small though rich pastries, try what depending on region are called Berliner, Pfannkuchen or Krapfen.
translations.reference: Ọ bụrụ na ị chọrọ ụmụ achịcha ndị pere mpe ma baakwa ụba, nwaa ihe na-ndabere na mpaghara a na-akpọ Berliner, Pfannkuchen ma ọ bụ Krapfen.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bụrụ na ị chọrị ụdị akụ na-acha nta ma nwere ọtụtụ ụtọ, gbalịa ihe ndị a, bụ ndị a na-akpọ "Berliner," "Pfannkuchen," ma ọ bụ "Krapfen," dabere na ebe ha si.

translations.source: A curry is a dish based on herbs and spices, together with either meat or vegetables.
translations.reference: Curry bu nri eji ngwa nri nke di iche iche esi, ana etinyekwa ya anu ma o bu akwukwo nri.
translations.hypothesis: Ụdị nri nke ahụ bụ "curry" bụ nri nke e ji akwụkwọ na osisi eme, yana otu n'ime ihe ndị a: anụ ma ọ bụ osisi.

translations.source: A curry can be either "dry" or "wet" depending on the amount of liquid.
translations.reference: Kọrị nwere ike ịdị "akọrọ" maọbụ dị "mmiri mmiri", ọ dabeere na mmiri dị adị.
translations.hypothesis: Ụdị nri curry nwere ike ịbụ "karịrị" ma ọ bụ "ọkara," dabere na ọtụtụ mmiri dị na ya.

translations.source: In inland regions of Northern India and Pakistan, yogurt is commonly used in curries; in Southern India and some other coastal regions of the subcontinent, coconut milk is commonly used.
translations.reference: Ụmụ mpaghara imeala nke Ebe Ugwu Indịa na Pakistan, a na-ejikarị yogọọt n'ime ụmụ kọrị; n'ime Ebe Ndịda Indịa na mpaghara ndị ọzọ dị n'akụkụ mmiri nke okpuru kọntinent ahụ, a na-ejikarị mmiri ara akị oyibo.
translations.hypothesis: N'ime obere mpaghara ndị dị n'ebe ugwu India na Pakistan, a na-eji yogọt karịsịa na akwụkwọ nri; n'ebe ndịda India na ụfọdụ mpaghara ndị ọzọ dị n'akụkụ osimiri n'obere mpaghara ahụ, a na-eji mmiri coconut karịsịa.

translations.source: With 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian food is an umbrella term covering a vast variety of regional cuisines found across the nation.
translations.reference: Ebe enwere agwaetiti 17,000 isi wee họrọ, nri Indonesia bụ aha gburugburu nke a na-akpọ ọtụtụ erimeri nke ọtụtụ mpaghara dị na mba ahụ niile.
translations.hypothesis: N'ihi na e nwere ihe karịrị 17,000 ọkpụkpụ dị na Indonesia, nri Indonesia bụ okwu zuru oke nke na-ekpuchi ọtụtụ ụdị nri ndị dị iche iche na mpaghara dị iche iche n'ofe mba ahụ.

translations.source: But, if used without further qualifiers, the term tends to mean the food originally from the central and eastern parts of the main island Java.
translations.reference: Mana, e kwuo ya n'etinyeghi nkọwa ọbụla, ihe a na-achọkarị ikwu bụ nri ahụ si n'etiti na ọwụwa anyanwu nke nnukwu agwaetiti Java.
translations.hypothesis: Mana, ọ bụrụ na a jiri okwu ahụ na-enweghị mgbakwunye ọ bụla, ọ na-etolitekarị na ọ pụtara nri nke sitere n'akụkụ etu na ọdịda anyanwụ nke ụlọ ọwụ anya Java.

translations.source: Now widely available throughout the archipelago, Javanese cuisine features an array of simply seasoned dishes, the predominant flavorings the Javanese favor being peanuts, chillies, sugar (especially Javanese coconut sugar) and various aromatic spices.
translations.reference: Ugbu a ọ dị adị nke ukwuu na gburugburu òtù ụmụ agwaetiti ndị ahụ, nri Ndị Java nwere njirimara nri ndị etijuru ngwa nri na mfe n’usoro, ekpomeekpo ahụ kara dị ike Ndị Java kara nwee mmasị na ya ndị nke bụ ahụekere achịcha kpuchiri, ose, shuga (tụmadị shuga akị Ndị Java) na ngwa nrị ndị ọzọ nwere usi ọma.
translations.hypothesis: Ugbu a, nri ndị Java dị zuru ebe niile n'obere osimiri ahụ. Nri ndị Java nwere ọtụtụ ụtụtụ dị mfe, ebe ihe ndị a na-eji na-acha ụtọ bụ ofe, ose, shuga (karịsịa shuga nke coconut Java), na ụdị akụkụ ọgwụ dị iche iche.

translations.source: Stirrups are supports for the rider's feet that hang down on either side of the saddle.
translations.reference: Ihe nkonye ụkwụ bụ ihe na-ejide ụkwụ onye na-agba ịnyịnya nke na-awụdata n'akụkụ abụọ site oche elu ịnyịnya.
translations.hypothesis: Ọkpụkpụ bụ akụrịta nke na-adị n'akụkụ ọzọ ọzọ nke oche, na-enyere ụkwụ onye na-eji ya ụkwụ.

translations.source: They provide greater stability for the rider but can have safety concerns due to the potential for a rider's feet to get stuck in them.
translations.reference: Ha na-ewetara onye na-agba ha nnukwu nnọsi ike mana ha nwere ike inwe nsogbu nchekwa maka na ụkwụ onye na-agba ya pụrụ ịkpachi n'ime ha.
translations.hypothesis: Ha na-enye ụdị nkwụsi ike karịa maka onye na-eji ya, mana ha nwere ike ịbụ ihe mgbaara n'ihi na ụkwụ onye na-eji ya nwere ike ịbụkwa n'ime ha.

translations.source: If a rider is thrown from a horse but has a foot caught in the stirrup, they could be dragged if the horse runs away. To minimize this risk, a number of safety precautions can be taken.
translations.reference: Ọ bụrụ na esị n'elu ịnyịnya tụpụ onye na-anya ya mana ụkwụ onye ahụ ekonye n'ekike ịnyịnya, ịnyịnya nwere ike ịsekpụrụ ya na-aga ma ọ gbaa ọsọ. Iji belata ihe egwu a, enwere ụfọdụ ihe mkpachapụ anya enwere ike ime.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bụrụ na onye na-eji ahịhịa na-agba ịnyịnya na ahịhịa ahụ, ma otu ụkwụ ya jide n'ime akpa ahịhịa, ọ nwere ike ịgbawa ma ọ bụrụ na ahịhịa ahụ gbaa. Iji belata ihe mgba ọrịa a, enwere ụfọdụ usoro nchekwa nke enwere ike iji.

translations.source: First, most riders wear riding boots with a heel and a smooth, quite narrow, sole.
translations.reference: Na mbụ, ọtụtụ n’ime ndị na-anya na-eyi akpụkpọ ụkwụ ọnyịnya ndị nwere kọị kọị na okpuru dị nrọ ma pee mpe.
translations.hypothesis: Mbụ, ọtụtụ ndị na-eje ije na-eyi akpụkpụ ụkwụ eji eje ije, nke nwere ụkwụ na igwe na ụkwụ nke na-adị ọcha, na-adịkwa sie ike.

translations.source: Next, some saddles, particularly English saddles, have safety bars that allow a stirrup leather to fall off the saddle if pulled backwards by a falling rider.
translations.reference: Ọzọ, ụfọdụ sadụl, ọkachasị sadụl Bekee, nwere ebe nchekwa na-ekwe ka akpụkpọ anụ si na sadụl dapụ ma onye na-anya anya sere ya laa azụ mgbe ọ na-ada.
translations.hypothesis: Nke ọzọ, ụfụfụ ụkwụ ụfụ, karịsịa ụfụfụ ụkwụ nke ndị Ingliish, nwere ọdụ ụkwụ nchekwa nke na-enye ahịhịa ụkwụ ịgbapụsite na ụfụfụ ahụ ma ọ bụrụ na onye na-eji ya, nke na-ebu ụzọ, gbapụ.

translations.source: Cochamó Valley - Chile's premier climbing destination, known as the Yosemite of South America, with a variety of granite big walls and crags.
translations.reference: Ndagwurugwuru Cochamó - ebe arimelu nwere ogo kachasị elu nke Chile, a mara dị ka Yosemite nke Ndịda Amerịka, ya na ụdị dị iche iche nke ụmụ nnukwu ahụaja kọnkịrị na nnukwu nkume.
translations.hypothesis: Vali Cochamó - bụ ebe kacha ama ama na Chile maka ịgbatị elu, nke a na-akpọ "Yosemite" nke Amerika Kọntinent. E nwere ọtụtụ akụrí dị ukwuu na mpaghara ahụ.

translations.source: Summits include breath-taking views from peaks. Climbers from all parts of the world are continually establishing new routes amongst its endless potential of walls.
translations.reference: Ụmụ ọnụ ugwu kachasị elu gụnyere nlenle ndị magburu onwe ha site n'elu ebe ndị ahụ. Ndị na-arị elu si n'akụkụ ụwa niile na-awapụta mgbe niile ụzọ ọhụrụ site n'ahụaja ya niile e nwere ike isi wapụta ụzọ nke anaghị agwụ agwụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ọdịmma ndị uwe dị elu nwere ọdịdị ezigbo dị ọnụ na mpụga ha. Ndị na-agba elu sitere n'ebe niile n'ụwa na-anọgide na-eme ụzọ ọhụrụ n'etiti ọtụtụ ebe dị iche iche e nwere n'ebe ahụ.

translations.source: Downhill snowsports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports involving sliding down snow-covered terrain with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.
translations.reference: Kpoda-ugwu egwuregwu-snow, bu nke gunyere igba igwe mmiri ski na snowboard, bu egwuregwu amaara-amaara nke gbasara ikpoda ala site n’elu n’ogige juputara na snow jiri igwe ski na snowboard eyigidere n’ukwu gi.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị mmadụ na-enwe mmasị na egwuregwu ndị a na-eme n'elu akụkụ osimiri ma ọ bụ n'ebe dị elu, dị ka ịnya akwụkwọ ahụ na igwe akwụkwọ (skiing) na ịnya akwụkwọ ahụ na igwe akwụkwọ ọzọ (snowboarding). Egwuregwu ndị a pụtara na ịgbatị akwụkwọ ahụ gaa n'okpuru akụkụ osimiri ma ọ bụ ebe dị elu nke ejiri akwụkwọ ahụ kpọrọ akwụkwọ ahụ (ski) ma ọ bụ igwe akwụkwọ ọzọ (snowboard) jikọtara n'ụkwụ gị.

translations.source: Skiing is a major travelling activity with many enthusiasts, occasionally known as "ski bums," planning entire vacations around skiing at a particular location.
translations.reference: Egwuregwu skii bụ otu isi ihe omume n'etiti ndị ọ na-amasị, mgbe ụfọdụ a na-amara ya dị ka "ski bums," na-eme atụmatụ nke oge ezumike niile gburugburu ime skii n'otu ebe kpọmkwem.
translations.hypothesis: Ịgba egwu n'elu igwe (skiing) bụ otu ọrụ njem dị mkpa, ebe ọtụtụ ndị na-amasị ya, bụ́ ndị ha na-akpọkarị "ski bums," na-eme atụmatụ maka ọtụtụ iri na ngosi ha niile n'akụkụ ịgba egwu n'elu igwe n'ebe ọdịnihu.

translations.source: The idea of skiing is very old — cave paintings depicting skiers date back as far as 5000 BC!
translations.reference: Egwuregwu ski eteela ọ nọ — ụmụ eserese esere n'ọgba kemgbe 5000 BC na-egosi ndị egwuregwu ski!
translations.hypothesis: Ide nke ịgba egwu n'ubube bụ ihe ochie karịrị - akwụkwọ ụkpụrụ nke e mechiri n'ime ụlọ ọrụ, nke na-egosi ndị na-agba egwu n'ubube, nwere ọmụma ruo ọtụtụ afọ 5000 gara aga!

translations.source: Downhill skiing as a sport goes back to at least the 17th century, and in 1861 the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia.
translations.reference: Igwu skii na mgbada ugwu dị ka otu egwuregwu gara azụ ruo opekata mpe ọ bụrụ na arị afọ iri na asaa, ma n’ime 1861 òtù egwuregwu skii ntụrụndụ nke mbụ bụ nke emepere site n’aka Ndị Nọọwei n’ime Ọstrelịa.
translations.hypothesis: Ịgba egwuregwu nke ịgbasa n'elu akụ na ala malitere ọtụtụ narị afọ gara, yana na afọ 1861, ndị Norway họpụtara ụlọ ọrụ izi egwu izi egwu mbụ na Australia.

translations.source: Backpacking by ski: This activity is also called backcountry ski, ski touring or ski hiking.
translations.reference: Njem mfe ski: A na-akpọkwa omume a bakkọntrị ski, ije nlegharị anya ski maọbụ ịrị ugwu ski.
translations.hypothesis: Ịgba egwuregwu skiing n'okpuru igwe: A na-akpọkwa ọrụ a "backcountry skiing," "ski touring," ma ọ bụ "ski hiking."

translations.source: It is related to but usually not involving alpine style ski touring or mountaineering, the latter ones done in steep terrain and requiring much stiffer skis and boots.
translations.reference: O metụtara mana ọ naghị agụnyekarị ọdịdị njem nleta ski keugwu ma ọ bụ egwuregwu ịrị elu ugwu, nke ikpeazụ ndị a e mere n'ọdịdịala kpodara ekpoda ma na-achọ ụmụ ski na buutu kara sie ike.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bụ ihe metụtara ịnya skis na ịgbawa, mana ọ na-adịghịkarịkarị na-emetụta ụdị ịnya skis na ịgbawa nke eji na akụkụ osimiri, ma ọ bụ ịgbawa n'oké osimiri. Ọrụ ndị a eji na ebe dị oke elu, na ọ chọrọ skis na akpụkpụ ụkwụ siri ike karị.

translations.source: Think of the skiing route as of a similar hiking route.
translations.reference: Chee echiche maka ụzọ esi egwu egwuregwu skii dị ka ụzọ e si aga njem ije nke yiri.
translations.hypothesis: Cheta banye na ọnyá ahụ dị ka ọnyá ọzọ nke ịga ụlọ.

translations.source: In good conditions you will be able to cover somewhat greater distances than walking – but only very seldom you will get the speeds of cross country skiing without a heavy backpack in groomed tracks.
translations.reference: N'ọnọdụ dị mma i nwere ike ịgarute ntoanya buru ibu karịa ịga ije - mana ọ na-ara ahụ tupu i rute ekwomọsọ nke ime skii ofe mba n'enweghị otu akpa azụ dị arụ n'ime mkpọwaraụzọ akwadogwere.
translations.hypothesis: N'ọnọdụ dị mma, ị ga-enwe ike ịgaebe ụzọ karịa ka ị na-aga n'ụkwụ – mana naanị otu ụbọchị ole na ole ka ị ga-enwe ọsọ dị ka nke ị na-agba egwuregwu n'okpuru igwe, ọ bụrụ na ị na-adịghị ebu akpa ibu.

translations.source: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.
translations.reference: Yurop bụ kọntinent dị obere na mmetụta ma nwee ọtụtụ mba nwere onwe ha. N’okpuru ọnọdụ nkịtị, ime njem gafee ọtụtụ mba ga-apụta ị ga site na ntinye akwụkwọ maka visa na njikwa paspọọtụ ọtụtụ oge.
translations.hypothesis: Europe bụ obere osimiri, mana ọ nwere ọtụtụ mba ndị nọ n'onwe ha. N'ọnọdụ nkịtị, ịga njem site na ọtụtụ mba pụrụ ịpụta na ịkwesịrị ịkwụ ụgwọ visa na ịlele paspọtụ ọtụtụ ugboro.

translations.source: The Schengen zone, however, works somewhat like one country in this respect.
translations.reference: Agbanyeghị, mpaghara Schengen na-arụ ọrụ dịka mba a na-akwanyere ugwu.
translations.hypothesis: Ọdịdị "Schengen," n'ụdị ụfọdụ, na-arụ ọrụ dị ka otu mba n'ihe gbasara nke a.

translations.source: As long as you stay in this zone, you can generally cross borders without going through passport control checkpoints again.
translations.reference: Ọ bụrụ na ị nọrọ n'ọgbọ a, i nwere ike igafe oke ala ma zere nnyocha paspọtụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ dị mma ka ị nọ na mpaghara a, ọ bụ ezie na ị nwere ike ịgafe mpụga ndị dị iche iche n'enweghị ịgafe ọtụtụ ebe nyocha paspọtụ ọzọ.

translations.source: Similarly, by having a Schengen visa, you do not need to apply for visas to each of the Schengen member countries separately, hence saving time, money and paperwork.
translations.reference: N'otu aka ahụ, site n’inwe otu visa Schengen, ị kwesịghịzi itinye akwụkwọ maka visa otu n’ime mba ndịòtù Schengen nke ọ bụla iche, ya mere chekwa oge, ego na mmepe akwụkwọ.
translations.hypothesis: Dị ka otu ahụ, site n'ị nwe visa Schengen, ị aghaghị ịkwụ ụgwọ maka visas nke ọ bụla n'ime mba ndị otu Schengen n'onwe ya, ya mere, ọ na-azọpụta oge, ego, na akwụkwọ.

translations.source: There is no universal definition for which manufactured items are antiques. Some tax agencies define goods older than 100 years as antiques.
translations.reference: Onweghi nkwekọrịta zuru ụwa maka ngwa a na-akpọ ihe ochie. Ụfọdụ ụlọ ọrụ ụtụ na-akpọ ngwa ndị karịrị afọ 100 ihe ochie.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ dịghị mmasị dị iche iche maka ihe ndị e rụpụtara bụ nke dị ogologo oge. Ụfọdụ ọha mmụta ụlọ akwụkwọ na-akọwa ihe ndị dị karịa afọ 100 dị ka ihe ochie.

translations.source: The definition has geographic variations, where the age limit might be shorter in places such as North America than in Europe.
translations.reference: Nkọwasị ahụ nwere ọdịiche kwa ọdịdị ala, ebe ókè afọ nwere ike ịdị obere karịa n'ebe ndị dị ka Ugwu Amerịka karịa n'ime Yurop.
translations.hypothesis: Ụdị echiche a nwere ọdịiche dị iche iche n'oge, ebe ọ dịkarịa ụba na mpaghara dị iche iche, dịka ebe dị ka North America, mgbe ọ bụla ọ nwere ike ịdị dị mkpụrọ karịa na Europe.

translations.source: Handicraft products might be defined as antiques, though they are younger than similar mass-produced goods.
translations.reference: Enwere ike ikpo ngwaahia eji aka ruo ihe mgbe ochie, n’agbanyeghi na o di ohuru karia ngwaahia ndi nke emere maka oha.
translations.hypothesis: Ngwaaka ndị e mere aka n'aka nwere ike ịkọwa dị ka ihe ochie, ọ bụ ezie na ha bụ ndị ọhụrụ karịa ngwaahịa ndị yiri ha nke e mere n'ọtụtụ.

translations.source: Reindeer husbandry is an important livelihood among the Sámi and the culture surrounding the trade is important also for many with other professions.
translations.reference: Ọzụzụ Reindeer dị mkpa nke ukwuu ọkachasị n’ime ihe banyere ndụ na omenaala ndị Sámi nakwa ahịa gbara ya okirikiri dịkwa mkpa maka ọtụtụ akaọrụ ndị ọzọ.
translations.hypothesis: Ọrụ nke ịkụ ụlọ ọhịa bụ ihe dị mkpa na ndụ ndị Sámi, ma ọkachapụ, ọ bụkwa ebe ha na-eme ihe nkiri. Ọzọkwa, ọrụ a na usoro ndụ nke na-eso ya bụ ihe dị mkpa kwa maka ọtụtụ ndị nwere ọrụ ndị ọzọ.

translations.source: Even traditionally, though, not all Sámi have been involved in big scale reindeer husbandry, but lived from fishing, hunting and similar, having reindeer mostly as draft animals.
translations.reference: Ọbụna n'ọdịnala, agbanyeghị, ọ bụghị Sámi niile bụ ndị metụtara n'ime nnukwu ogo ọzụzụ anụmanụ reendiya, mana biri site n'igbu azụ, ịchụ nta na ihe yiri ya, na-enwe reendiya n'ọtụtụ oge dị ka ụmụ anụmanụ akpọbatara.
translations.hypothesis: Ọbụna n'oge gara aga, ọ bụghị niile ndị Sámi ji eji ụdị anụ ọhịa ahụ (reindeer) eme ihe na nnukwu ọrụ, kamakwa ha na-ebi n'ihe ha na-eri site na ịbụrụ mmiri, ịgba ọchịchị, na ihe ndị yiri ya, ebe ha na-eji anụ ọhịa ahụ (reindeer) karịsịa eme ka ha na-ebu ihe.

translations.source: Today many Sámi work in modern trades. Tourism is an important income in Sápmi, the Sámi area.
translations.reference: Taa ọtụtụ Sámi na-arụ ọrụ n’ụmụ ahịa nke ugbu a. Njem nleta bụ mkpata egọ dị mkpa na Sápmi, mpaghara Sámi ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: Taa, ọtụtụ ndị Sámi na-arụ ọrụ n'ọrụ ndị ọhụrụ. Nkọwa ụlọ na-abụta ụlọ ọrụ dị mkpa na Sápmi, ebe ndị Sámi bi.

translations.source: Though it is widely used, especially among non-Romani, the word "Gypsy" is often considered offensive because of its associations with negative stereotypes and inaccurate perceptions of Romani people.
translations.reference: Agbanyeghị na ndị abụghị ndị Roma na-ekwu ya n'etiti ha, a na-ahụta aha a bụ "Gypsy" dị ka aha ọjọọ maka na ọ gbasara ụfọdụ ụzọ ọjọọ ndị ọzọ si ahụta ndị Roma, nke abụghị eziokwu.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bụ ezie na okwu ahụ "Gypsy" na-eji eji karịrị, ọkachasị n'etiti ndị na-abụghị ndị Romani, ọtụtụ ndị na-eche ya ka ọ bụ okwu na-emerụ ahụ n'ihi ihe ọ na-egosi, dị ka akụkọ ifụndụ na echiche ndị adịghị zuru oke banyere ndị Romani.

translations.source: If the country you will be visiting becomes subject to a travel advisory, your travel health insurance or your trip cancellation insurance may be affected.
translations.reference: Ọ bụrụ na mba ahụ ị ga-aga ileta bụrụ nke nọ n'okpuru otu ndụmọdụ njem, mkpuchi ahụike njem gị ma ọ bụ mkpuchi nkagbu njem gị bụ nke o nwere ike imetụta.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bụrụ na mba nke ị ga-aga gaa nwee ihe ndụmọdụ gbasara njem, ahụike njem gị ma ọ bụ nsogbu nke ịkwụsị njem gị nwere ike ịdabere.

translations.source: You may also wish to consult the advice of governments other than your own, but their advice is designed for their citizens.
translations.reference: Ị nwere ike ịjụta ndụmọdụ nke ndị ọchịchị karịa nke gị, mana ndụmọdụ ha bụ ndị e mebere maka ndị amaala ha.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bụ eziokwu na ị nwere ike ịlegharị anya na ndụmọdụ nke gọọmentị ndị ọzọ, mana ndụmọdụ ndị ahụ emebere ka ọ bụrụ maka ndị ọchịchị nke gọọmentị ndị ahụ.

translations.source: As one example, American citizens in the Middle East might face different situations from Europeans or Arabs.
translations.reference: Iji mee atụ, ndị Amerịka nọ na Mịdụl Ist nwere ike igabiga ihe dị iche n'ihe ndị Yurop maọbụ Arab ga-agabiga.
translations.hypothesis: Dịka ihe atụ, ndị amaala Amerika nke nọ na mpaghara Oké Osimiri Ndụ (Middle East) nwere ike ịbụ na ha na-eche echiche dị iche na ndị Europe ma ọ bụ ndị Arab.

translations.source: Advisories are merely a brief summary of the political situation in one country.
translations.reference: Ndị ndụmọdụ gasị bụ naanị obere nchịkọta nke ọnọdụ ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị n’otu obodo.
translations.hypothesis: Ntuziaka ndị a bụ naanị akụkọ mkpirisi dị mkpụrọ banyere ọnọdụ ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị na otu mba.

translations.source: The views presented are often cursory, general and oversimplified compared to the more detailed information available elsewhere.
translations.reference: Uche ndị e gosipụtara na-esekarị n'elu, n'izugbe na ntọghasị dị ukwuu ma a tụnyere ya ozi ndị a kọwara nke ọma dị ebe ọzọ.
translations.hypothesis: Ụfọdụ oge, echiche ndị a etinyere n'ụzọ dị mkpirikpi, dị jụọ, na enweghị nkọwa zuru oke, ma eweghachite na ozi ndị ọzọ dị n'ebe ndị ọzọ nwere ozi zuru oke.

translations.source: Severe weather is the generic term for any dangerous weather phenomenon with the potential to cause damage, serious social disruption, or loss of human life.
translations.reference: Ajọ ihu igwe bụ aha izugbe a na-akpọ ihe ọbụla gbasara ihu igwe nke nwere ike imebi ihe, ghasaa mmekọrịta, maọbụ gbuo mmadụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ọdịmma iwe na-emetụta bụ okwu zuru oke iji akpọkwa ihe ọ bụla metụtara iwe na-emetụta nke nwere ike ibute mmebi, mgbanwe dị ukwuu na ndụ mmadụ, ma ọ bụ ọnwụ.

translations.source: Severe weather can occur anywhere in the world, and there are different types of it, which can depend on geography, topography, and atmospheric conditions.
translations.reference: Ihu igwe dị oke njọ nwere ike ime n'ebe ọbụla n'ụwa, ma o nwere ụdị dị iche iche, nke nwere ike idabere na ọdịdịala, ọdịdịebe na ọnọdụ keikuku.
translations.hypothesis: Ọnọdụ iwe na-apụta n'ebe ọ bụla n'ụwa, ma e nwere ụdị dị iche iche nke ọ dị, nke nwere ike ịdabere na ebe obibi, ụdị ala, na ọnọdụ ikuku.

translations.source: High winds, hail, excessive precipitation, and wildfires are forms and effects of severe weather, as are thunderstorms, tornadoes, waterspouts, and cyclones.
translations.reference: Ụmụ oke ifufe, mkpụrụ mmiri, oke mmiri ozuzo, na ọkụọhịa bụ ụmụ ụdị na mmetụta nke ihu igwe dị oke njọ, dị ka ụmụ egbe eluigwe mmiri ozuzo, ajọọ̀ oke ifufe, ajọọ̀ ifufe mmiri, na ajọọ̀ oke mmiri ozuzo.
translations.hypothesis: Ihe ndị na-ebute gbasara ihu igwe na-adị oke egwu, dị ka ikpuru ikpuru, osisi, mmiri dị ukwuu, na ọkụ na-erugharị, bụ ihe na-ebute ụdị na mgbaàmà nke ihu igwe na-adị oke egwu. Otú ọ dị, ihe ndị ọzọ na-ebute ụdị na mgbaàmà ndị a bụ: mmiri osisi, ifufe, mmiri na-agba n'elu osimiri, na akụkọ.

translations.source: Regional and seasonal severe weather phenomena include blizzards, snowstorms, ice storms, and dust storms.
translations.reference: Ihe ihu igwe siri ike na-eme na mpaghara na n'oge ụfọdụ gụnyere blizadị, oke ikuku na ọdịda ibubeoyi, oke ikuku na ọdịda aịzị, na oke ifufe na-ebu aja.
translations.hypothesis: Ụdị ihe mgbagwoju anya nke na-emetụta mpaghara na oge dị iche iche gụnyere: ifufe zuru oke, ifufe ice, mmiri ice, na ifufe uzu.

translations.source: Travellers are strongly advised to be aware of any risk of severe weather affecting their area as they may affect any travel plans.
translations.reference: Ana adusi ndi njem odu ike ha mara gbasara ihe ndaba nke ekpem-oku maobu di oke ukwuu nke na emetuta ogbe ha dika onwere ike imetuta atumatu ime-njem obula.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ dị mkpa ka ndị njem na-eme njem mara anya maka ihe mgbaara ọ bụla nke iwe ihu igwe nwere ike imetụta ebe ha nọ, n'ihi na ọ nwere ike ịemetụta atụmatụ ha maka njem.

translations.source: Anyone planning a visit to a country that could be considered a war zone should get professional training.
translations.reference: Onye ọbụla na-achọ ịga mba ọbụla bụ ọgbọ agha kwesịrị ka e kuziere ya etu e si eme ya.
translations.hypothesis: Onye ọ bụla na nwere atụmanya ịgba ụta na obodo nke enwere ike ikwu na ọ bụ ebe agha, ga-enweta ọzụmụ ọkachamara.

translations.source: A search of the Internet for 'Hostile environment course' will probably provide the address of a local company.
translations.reference: Ọchịchọ n'ịntanetị maka 'Ọmụmụ gburugburu keiro' nwere ike iweta adreesị otu ụlọọrụ imeobodo.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bụrụ na ị chọrọ ozi gbasara "akwụkwọ ọmụma gbasara ebe ndị na-adịghị dị mma," ị ga-enwe ike ịchọta adreesị ụlọ ọrụ dị nso na ịntanetị.

translations.source: A course will normally cover all the issues discussed here in far greater detail, usually with practical experience.
translations.reference: Otu ihe ọmụmụ ga-akọwa nke ọma ihe niile a kọwara ebe a tinyekwa ahụmihe bara uru.
translations.hypothesis: Ọzụzụ a ga-atụgharịkarị ihe niile a na-atụkọrịta ebe a, n'ụzọ zuru oke, na-ejikwa ọtụtụ ozi, ọkachamị na-ebunye ya site n'oge ọrụ.

translations.source: A course will normally be from 2-5 days and will involve role play, a lot of first aid and sometimes weapons training.
translations.reference: Ihe ọmụmụ na-abụkarị site na ụbọchị abuo ruo ụbọchị ise ma ọ ga-emetụta mmepụta omume, ọtụtụ mgbata ọsọ enyemaka mbụ na ọzụzụ maka ngwaagha n'oge ụfọdụ .
translations.hypothesis: Ọzụzụ ahụ ga-adịkarịrị ụbọchị 2 ruo 5, ọ ga-agụnye egwu egwuregwu, ọtụtụ usoro enyemaka n'ọnọdụ mberede, na mgbe ụfọdụ, ọzụzụ maka ojiji ngwaọrụ.

translations.source: Books and magazines dealing with wilderness survival are common, but publications dealing with war zones are few.
translations.reference: Ụmụ akwụkwọ na magaziini ndị na-akọ maka nlanarị nke ọzara juru eju, mana ụmụ mbipụta na-akọ maka ebe a na-alụ agha dị obere.
translations.hypothesis: Akwụkwọ na magazịnụ ndị na-akparịta ụzọ ndụ na ebe obibi ebe anaghị nwee ebe obibi, bụ ihe nkịtị, mana akwụkwọ na magazịnụ ndị na-akparịta gbasara mpaghara agha adịghịkarị.

translations.source: Voyagers planning sex reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they're carrying valid documents for the return trip.
translations.reference: Ndị njem ụgbọ mmiri na-eme atụmatụ ịwa ahụ ntụgharị mmekọahụ na mba ofesi ga-ejiriri n'aka na ha ji ụmụ akwụkwọ ziri ezi maka njem nlaghachi.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị na-eme atụmanya ịnweta ọrụ ahụike nke ịgbanwe ụdị ahụ ha n'ụsọ osimiri ga-ahụ na ha nwere akwụkwọ ndị dị mkpa maka njem ọzọ ha ga-eme n'azụ.

translations.source: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.
translations.reference: Ịdị njikere ndị ọchịchị inye akwụkwọ ikike ngafe ndị a na-edepụtaghị jenda ha (X) maọbụ dọkụmentị emelitere ka ọ daba n’aha a chọrọ ma jenda adị iche.
translations.hypothesis: Ọtụtụ ihe dị iche na otú gọọmentị na-enye akwụkwọ njem (pasaport) ebe agbụrụ onye ahụ (ihe dị ka "X") adịghị ede, ma ọ bụ akwụkwọ ndị a na-emelite iji họrọ aha na agbụrụ nke onye ahụ chọrọ.

translations.source: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.
translations.reference: Njikere nke ndị ọchịchị mba ndị ọzọ ịsọpụrụ akwụkwọ ndị a dị nnọọ ka ihe na-agbanwe agbanwe.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ dịkarịa mma ka gọọmentị ndị mba ọzọ na-akwenye ịkweta akụkọ ndị a, mana ọtụtụ n'ime ha na-eme ya n'ụzọ dị iche iche.

translations.source: Searches at security checkpoints have also become far more intrusive in the post-September 11, 2001 era.
translations.reference: Ọchịchọ na ebe nyocha nchedo abụrụkwala oke nsogbu mbanye n’ike n’ime oge Septemba 11, 2001 gachara.
translations.hypothesis: N'oge mgbe ọgụ nke Septemba 11, 2001 gasịrị, usoro nyocha ndị na-achọpụta ihe na ụzọ nchekwa abụọla nke ukwuu, na-eme ka ọ bụrụ ihe na-adị gbasasị.

translations.source: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.
translations.reference: Ndi transgender n’emebeghi oparashon atubekwana anya na ha gafecha ihe nyocha na ha ka ga ano na nzuzo ma ugwu ha adikwachim.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị mmadụ ndị na-achọ ịgbanwe ụdị ahụ ha n'oge ọrụ ahụ (transgender) ekwughị m ka ha ga-atụkwa anya ịgafe akụkụ ndị na-achọpụta ihe (scanners) n'enweghị mmebi nke ha privacy na ihe dị ha mkpa.

translations.source: Rip currents are the returning flow from waves breaking off the beach, often at a reef or similar.
translations.reference: Oke ọchịchị mmiri bụ mmiri na-asọlata asọlata site n'ebili mmiri tikapụrụ n'ọnụ, na-emekarị n'okwute ala mmiri maọbụ ihe yiri ya.
translations.hypothesis: Ọdọọdọọ nke mmiri bụ ọdọọdọọ nke na-agbachi mmiri mgbe mmiri na-ebili na akwa osimiri, ọtụtụ oge n'ebe obere agwa ma ọ bụ ebe yiri ya.

translations.source: Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there.
translations.reference: N'ihi tọpọlọjì nke okpuru mmiri ahụ, mmiri na-abanyeghachi dị ike n'akụkụ ole na ole miri emi, ma ike ọwụwụ mmiri ngwa ngwa ruo na mmiri dị omimi nwere ike ịmepụta n'ebe ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: N'ihi ụkpụrụ mmiri dị n'okpuru osimiri, mmiri na-agbachi n'azụ na-agbakwunye n'ebe ole na ole dị n'ime osimiri, ma ọ nwere ike ịmepụta ọsọ mmiri dị ukwuu na-aga n'ime osimiri n'ebe ndị ahụ.

translations.source: Most deaths happen as result of fatigue trying to swim back against the current, which may be impossible.
translations.reference: Imirikiti ọnwụ na-eme n'ihi ike ọgwụgwụ n'ịgbalị igwughachi azụ megide kọrenti mmiri, nke nwere ike ọ gaghị ekwe omume.
translations.hypothesis: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-anwụ n'ihi mmerụ ahụ nke ịgba ọsọ iji banye n'ọdọ mmiri, mgbe ha na-agba ọsọ n'ebe ọdọ mmiri na-aga, nke nwere ike ịbụ ihe na-adịghị ozo.

translations.source: As soon as you get out of the current, swimming back is no more difficult than normally.
translations.reference: Ozugbo ị na-esi n'ọwụwụ mmiri ahụ pụta, igwughachi azụ na-aka ara ahụ karịa na nkịtị.
translations.hypothesis: Ozugbo ịkpụpụrụ mmiri nke na-agba, ịgafegharị n'ime mmiri ahụ adịghịkwa siri ike karịa ka ọ dị na nkịtị.

translations.source: Try aiming somewhere where you are not caught again or, depending on your skills and on whether you have been noticed, you might want to wait for rescue.
translations.reference: Gbalịa tụọ atụmatụ ọzọ maka ebe ejidebeghi gị, maọbụ, dabere na nka gị yana ma achọpụtala gị, ị nwere ike ịchere maka nnapụta.
translations.hypothesis: Gbalịa ịga ebe ọ bụla ebe ị gaghị enwe mmetụta ọzọ, ma ọ bụ, dabere na ọrụ gị na ma ha ahụrụ gị, ọ ga-adị mma ka ị chịe ume ruo mgbe ha ga-abata iji tụọ gị.

translations.source: Re-entry shock comes on sooner than culture shock (there's less of a honeymoon phase), lasts longer, and can be more severe.
translations.reference: Mmenyeụjọ mbanyegharị abia na nkpirikpi karia mmenyeụjọ omenala (enwere agba họnịịmuunu dịtụ ntakịrị), dịruru ogologo, ma nwee ike ịka njọ.
translations.hypothesis: Mmetụta nke ịbụgharị azụ na-abata ngwa karịa mmetụta nke ịbụgharị na obodo ọhụrụ (ọ nwere oge obere nke ịzụlite), na-adị ogologo, ma nwekwara ike ịbụ nke ukwuu.

translations.source: Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to the new culture sometimes have a particularly hard time readjusting to their native culture.
translations.reference: Ndị njem ndị nwere oge dị mfe ịnọgharị n’omenala ọhụrụ mgbe ụfọdụ na-enwe oge siri ike ịnọgharịkwa n’omenala keobodo ha.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị mmadụ na-eleta ebe ndị ọzọ bụ ndị nwere ọtụtụ mgbe enwere mmetụta dị mfe mgbe ha na-agbanwe na usoro ndụ nke ebe ahụ, mgbe ụfọdụ na-enwekarị nsogbu karịa mgbe ha na-agbalị ịlaghachi na usoro ndụ nke ha nwere na obodo ha si.

translations.source: When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture.
translations.reference: Mgbe a na-alaghachite n’ụlọ mgbe e bichara n’obodo oyibo, ị nweela mmara ahụ nye omenala ọhụrụ ahụ ma tufuokwa ụfọdụ agwa gị si n’omenala nke ụlọ gị.
translations.hypothesis: Mgbe ị na-alaghachi n'ụlọ mgbe ị nọrọ n'èzí obodo, ị ga-adabere n'ọgbakwa ọhụrụ ahụ, ma ị ga-ewe ụfọdụ ọdịdị omume nke ị nwere n'ụlọ gị.

translations.source: When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt.
translations.reference: Mgbe ị gara na mba ofesi na mbụ, ndị mmadụ nwere ike ha nwere ndidi na nghọta, na-amara na ndị njem nọ n'ime mba ọhụrụ chọrọ imegharị ahụ nnọshị̀.
translations.hypothesis: Mgbe ị gbara ụzọ gaa mba ọzọ n'imepe, ndị mmadụ nwere ike ịbụ ndị nwere ndu na uche, ebe ha matara na ndị njem na mba ọhụrụ chọrọ iji agbanwe.

translations.source: People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.
translations.reference: Ikekwe ndị mmadụ agaghị atụ anya na ndidi na nnagide bụ ihe ndị njem na-alaghachi ụlọ aghaghị inwe.
translations.hypothesis: Ọtụtụ mmadụ enweghị ike iche na ọ dị mkpa ịdị na-adị gị na ịghọta ihe ndị na-eme, ọ bụrụ na ndị njem na-alaghachi n'ụlọ.

translations.source: The pyramid sound and light show is one of the most interesting things in the area for kids.
translations.reference: Ihe ngosi uda na oku piramidi bu ihe kachasi akpalite mmuo emere maka umuaka n’ebe a.
translations.hypothesis: Ụdị egwu egwu na ọkụ nke "pyramid" bụ otu n'ime ihe ndị na-amasị ụmụaka kachasị na mpaghara ahụ.

translations.source: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in silence before the show begins.
translations.reference: Ị nwere ike ịhụ piramidi n'ime itiri ma ị nwere ike ịhụ ha n'ịgbachi nkịtị tupu ihe ngosi ahụ ebido.
translations.hypothesis: Ị nwere ike ịhụ pyramids ahụ n'ọchịchị, ma ọ bụkwa ịhụ ha n'ọdịala tupu ihe ngosi malite.

translations.source: Usually you always here the sound of tourists and vendors. The story of the sound and light is just like a story book.
translations.reference: Mgbe niile ị na-anụkarị ụda ndị njem nleta na ndị na-ere ahịa. Akụkọ gbasara ụda na ọkụ dị nnọọ ka otu akwụkwọ akụkọ ifo.
translations.hypothesis: N'aka, ị na-anụkarị ụda ndị njalaba na ndị na-ere ahịa. Akụkọ banyere ụda na ọkụ ahụ bụ otu akụkọ dị ka akwụkwọ akụkọ.

translations.source: The Sphinx is set as the backdrop and the narrator of a long story.
translations.reference: Edobere Sphinx ka ihe mgbakwasa na onye na ako akuko toro ogologo
translations.hypothesis: Ụdị ihe nkiri ahụ na-eji Sphinx dị ka ihe eji egosi ihe omume na dị ka onye na-akọkwa akụkọ ogologo.

translations.source: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.
translations.reference: A na-egosipụta ihe ngosi ndị ahụ na piramidi ndị ahụ ma mere ka piramidi ndị ahụ dị iche iche na-enwukepụ.
translations.hypothesis: Aha ihe omume ahụ na-egosi n'elu pyramids, na pyramids ndị ọzọ na-enwu.

translations.source: South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several nations and have the most bases, with sixteen active in 2020.
translations.reference: Sawụt Shetland Aịlands, nke a chọpụtara na 1819, bụ ebe ọtụtụ mba na-azọ; Agwaetiti nọ na ya karịrị ndị nọ ebe ọzọ, ebe agụtara iri na isii nọ n'ọrụ n'afọ 2020.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị Isle South Shetland, nke a chọpụtara na afọ 1819, bụ nke mba ụfọdụ na-achọsi, yana bụ ndị nwere ụlọ ọrụ kacha ọtọ, n'ihi na ha nwere iri na ise n'ime ha na-arụ ọrụ n'afọ 2020.

translations.source: The archipelago lies 120 km north of the Peninsula. The largest is King George Island with the settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.
translations.reference: Archipelago ahụ tọgbọọrọ na Km 120 na mpaghara ugwu nke obodo akụkụ mmiri ahụ. Nke kachasị buo ibu bụ Agwaetiti Eze George nwere ebe obibi nke Villa Las Estrellas.
translations.hypothesis: Aghụta ahụ ahụ dị kilomita 120 anya n'ebe ugwu nke Peninsula ahụ. Ndị ebe obibi kachasị ukwuu bụ King George Island, ebe obodo Villa Las Estrellas dị.

translations.source: Others include Livingston Island, and Deception where the flooded caldera of a still-active volcano provides a spectacular natural harbour.
translations.reference: Ndị ọzọ gụnyere Agwaetiti Livingston, na Nghọgbu ebe caldera mmiri tojuru nke ugwu mgbawa ka dị ire na-enye otu ebe obibi dị ịtụnanya.
translations.hypothesis: Ụfọdụ ebe ndị ọzọ bụ Livingston Island, na Deception, ebe osimiri na-agbaze n'ime obara nke volcano na-enweghị ọrụ, na-eme ka ebe ahụ bụrụ osimiri dị ụtọ na nke dị mma.

translations.source: Ellsworth Land is the region south of the Peninsula, bounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.
translations.reference: Ala Ellsworth bụ mpaghara ndịna nke Penịnsụla, Oke osimiri Bellingshausen gbara ya gburugburu.
translations.hypothesis: Ellsworth Land bụ obere mpaghara dị n'ebe ndịda nke Peninsula, ma ebe a na-agba ya gburugburu bụ Oké Osimiri Bellingshausen.

translations.source: The mountains of the Peninsula here merge into the plateau, then re-emerge to form the 360 km chain of the Ellsworth Mountains, bisected by the Minnesota Glacier.
translations.reference: Ugwu ndị Peninsụla ahụ nọ ebe a jikọtara ọnụ ịghọ ugwu dị larịị ahụ, mgbe ahụ jikọgharịa ịghọ km 360 eriri igwe nke Ugwu ndị Ellsworth ahụ, egbubiri abụọ site n’aka Glesịa Minnesota ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: Uwe ndị osimiri nke peninsula a na-ejikọta na obere uwe, wee pụta ọzọ iji guzọta ọnyá nke kilomita 360 nke uwe Ellsworth, nke Minnesota Glacier na-ekewa.

translations.source: The northern part or Sentinel Range has Antarctica's highest mountains, the Vinson Massif, peaking at 4892 m Mount Vinson.
translations.reference: Akụkụ ebe ugwu ma ọ bụ Renji Sentinel nwere ugwu ndị kachasị elu nke Antaatika, Vinson Massif ahụ, na-eru ọnụ elu na 4892 m Ugwu Vinson.
translations.hypothesis: Akụkụ osimiri nke ugwu ma ọ bụ Oké Osimiri Sentinel nwere ụlọ ọkwụkwa kacha elu na Antarctica, bụ Vinson Massif, nke na-erutọ 4892 mita, bụ Mount Vinson.

translations.source: In remote locations, without cell phone coverage, a satellite phone may be your only option.
translations.reference: N'ebe ndị zopuru ezopu, n'enweghị netwọk ekwentị, ikekwe ekwentị satịlaịt ga-abụ naanị nzọpụta i nwere.
translations.hypothesis: N'ebe ndị dị anya, ebe ekekọghịkwa ọrụ ekwentị mkpanakota, ekwentị satelaite nwere ike ịbụ naanị nhọrọ gị.

translations.source: A satellite phone is not generally a replacement for a mobile phone, as you have to be outdoors with clear line of sight to the satellite to make a phone call.
translations.reference: Otu ekwentị satịlaịtị abụghị nnọchite anya n’izugbe nke ekwentị kengagharị, dị ka ị kwesịrị ịnọ n’ezi ya na inwe ụzọ warawara ịhụ satịlaịtị iji ya kpọọ oku ekwentị.
translations.hypothesis: Ekwensu eletrọniki abụghịkarị ihe na-anọchi anya ekwensu mkpanulo, n'ihi na ị ga-abụ n'èzí na ị ga-enwe nghọta zuru oke iji wee kpọọ ekwensu ahụ.

translations.source: The service is frequently used by shipping, including pleasure craft, as well as expeditions who have remote data and voice needs.
translations.reference: Ọrụ ahụ bụ nke mbupu na-ejikarị, gụnyere nka obi ụtọ, ya na ụmụ njem nchọpụta ndị nwere mkpa datà ebe dịanya na olu.
translations.hypothesis: A ọrụ a na-ejikarịta nke ukwuu site na ụlọ ọrụ njem, gụnyere ụgbọ mmiri maka oriri na ọṅụṅụ, yana ndị na-eme njem ndị chọrọ ozi na mkpanakota n'ebe dịpụrụ adịpụ.

translations.source: Your local telephone service provider should be able to give more information about connecting to this service.
translations.reference: Onye ọrụ ekwentị ebeụlọ gị kwesịrị inwe ike inyekwu ozi gbasara ị na-ejikọta n'ọrụ a.
translations.hypothesis: Ọrụ ekwentị gị na mpaghara ahụ ga-enwe ike inye gị ozi ndị ọzọ banyere otu esi ejikọta na ọrụ a.

translations.source: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.
translations.reference: Otu nhọrọ kara ewu ewu n'ụzọ na-amụbanye maka ndị na-atụ arọ ịnara otu ohere-afọ bụ ime njem ma mụta.
translations.hypothesis: Ụzọ ọzọ na-eto n'ọdịnihu maka ndị na-atụgharị uche banyere oge "gap year" bụ ịga njem ma mụọ ihe.

translations.source: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.
translations.reference: Ọ bụ ndị si ụlọ akwụkwọ pụta na-emekarị nke a, maka ọ na-ekwe ka ha jiri otu afọ zuo ike tupu ha abanye mahadum, ma ghara imebi mmụta ha.
translations.hypothesis: Nke a na-adọrọ mmasị karịsịa maka ndị na emechara akwụkwọ n'ụlọ akwụkwọ, ọ na-enyere ha ohere iji otu afọ n'ihu tupu ha bidoụ ụlọ akwụkwọ mahadum, na-eme ka ha wee nwee ohere ịmụta ihe ọzọ, na-eme ka agụmakwụkwọ ha adịkwaghị ọdịda.

translations.source: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
translations.reference: Ọtụtụ oge, ịdebanye aha n'ọmụmụ ohere-afọ na mba ofesi nwere ike imelite n'ezie ohere i nwere isonye n'agụmakwụkwọ dị elu n'obodo ebe i si.
translations.hypothesis: N'ọtụtụ ọnọdụ, ịbanye n'akwụkwọ ụlọọka nke afọ otu a na mba ọzọ nwere ike inye gị ohere karịa ịga n'ụlọ akwụkwọ dị elu na obodo gị.

translations.source: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.
translations.reference: A ga-enwekarị ụgwọ akwụkwọ iji debanye aha n’ime ụmụ emume mmụta ndị a.
translations.hypothesis: Ọdịmma, a na-atụ anya na ga-abụ ụgwọ maka ịbụ akwụkwọ na ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị a.

translations.source: Finland is a great boating destination. The "Land of a thousand lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and in the coastal archipelagos.
translations.reference: Finlandị bụ ebe dị oke mma maka inya ụgbọ mmiri. “Ala nke otu puku ọdọ mmiri” ahụ nwekwara ọtụtụ puku agwaetiti, n’ime ọdọ mmiri ndị ahụ ma n’akụkụ mmiri nke òtù agwaetiti.
translations.hypothesis: Finland bụ ebe dị mma iji gaa n'ọdọ. "Ala nke puku osimiri" nwekwara puku ọkpụkpụ, n'osimiri ndị ahụ na n'obere osimiri ndị dị n'akụkụ osimiri.

translations.source: In the archipelagos and lakes you do not necessarily need a yacht.
translations.reference: Na otu agwaetiti n’umu ọdọ mmiri ị gaghị achọriri ụgbọ mmiri.
translations.hypothesis: N'ime obodo ndị dị n'okpuru mmiri na osimiri, ọ gaghị ekwe omume ka ị chọrọ ụgbọ mmiri dị ukwuu.

translations.source: Although the coastal archipelagos and the biggest lakes are indeed big enough for any yacht, smaller boats or even a kayak offer a different experience.
translations.reference: Agbanyeghị n'òtù agwaetiti akụkụ mmiri ahụ na ụmụ ọdọ mmiri kachasị ibu bụ ndị nke buru ibu n'ezie maka yaach ọ bụla, ụgbọ mmiri ndị kara obere ma ọ bụ ọbụna otu kayak na-enye ahụmihe dị iche.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bụ ezie na obere ọghọmọ na osimiri na osimiri kacha ukwuu dị ukwuu nke ọma maka ụgbọ olili anya, ụgbọ mmiri ndị nta ma ọ bụ ọbụla kayak na-enye ahụmịhe dị iche.

translations.source: Boating is a national pastime in Finland, with a boat to every seven or eight people.
translations.reference: Akwọm ụgbọmmiri bụ ihe mmemme nchereoge na mba Finlandị, nke bụ otu ụgbọmmiri ibu mmadụ asaa maọbụ asatọ.
translations.hypothesis: Ọrụ ịnya ụgbọ mmiri bụ ihe a na-emekarị na Finland, ebe ọ bụ na e nwere ụgbọ mmiri otu maka mmadụ asaa ma ọ bụ asatọ.

translations.source: This is matched by Norway, Sweden and New Zealand, but otherwise quite unique (e.g. in the Netherlands the figure is one to forty).
translations.reference: Norway, Sweden na New Zealand emegokwa ya, mana ewezụga ha, ihe a bụ ihe mmeta pụrụ iche (dịka ọmụmaatụ na Netherlands fịgọ a bụ otu nye iri anọ).
translations.hypothesis: Akwụkwọ a bụ otu ihe dị iche, mana mba ndị dị ka Norway, Sweden, na New Zealand nwere otu ihe. N'agbanyeghị, ọ bụ ihe dị iche iche (dịka na Netherlands, ọ bụ otu maka ụma iri anọ).

translations.source: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
translations.reference: Ọtụtụ n'ime Njem Ụgbọmmiri Baltik pụrụiche na-enye njirimara nke ọnụnọ agbatịrị n'ime St. Pitasbọọg Rọshịa.
translations.hypothesis: Ọtụtụ n'ime njem n'okpuru mmiri nke Baltic na-agụnye oge dị ogologo na St. Petersburg, na Russia.

translations.source: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
translations.reference: Nke a pụtara na i nwere ike ịwere ụfọdụ ụbọchị gaa leta obodo ochie a, ma na-echighata n'ụgbọ mmiri ịrahụ ụra abalị.
translations.hypothesis: Nke a pụtara na ị nwere ike ịgaba n'ụlọ obodo ochie ahụ maka ụbọchị abụọ niile, ma ọ bụghị naanị ụbọchị abụọ, ebe ị na-agbachi echiche na ịga na-alaghachi, ma ị na-anọkwa na ụgbọ mmiri ahụ mgbe ụtụtụ na-abata.

translations.source: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
translations.reference: Ọ bụrụ na ị nọ n'ụgbọmmiri eme njem nlereanya nke naanị elu ala ị gaghị enweta visa dị iche maka ya (bidori na 2009).
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bụrụ na ị gaba naanị na njem ndị a na-eme n'ụgbọ mmiri, ị gaghị arụ na-achọ visa dị iche (dịka ọ dị na afọ 2009).

translations.source: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.
translations.reference: Ụfọdụ njem ụgbọ mmiri na-enye njirimara Beelịn, Jamani n'ime ụmụ broshuọ ahụ. Dị ka ị nwere ike ịhụ site na maapụ ahụ n'elu Beelịn anọghị oke osimiri ahụ nso ma ọlị ma otu nleta n'obodo ahụ bụ nke agụnyeghị n'ọnụahịa nke njem ụgbọ mmiri ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ụfọdụ njem n'efe na-egosi Berlin, na Germany, na akwụkwọ ndụ akwụkwọ. Dị ka ị na-ahụ na akwụkwọ akụkọ efu a, Berlin enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na osimiri, ma ịgba ụgbọ oloko gaa n'obodo ahụ abụghị akụkụ nke ọnụ ahịa njem ahụ.

translations.source: Travelling by plane can be a scary experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, particularly if they've not flown before or have experienced a traumatic event.
translations.reference: Njem ụgbọ elu nwere ike bụ ihe egwu ny onye ọbụla agbanyeghị afọ ole ha dị maobụ ebe ha si, ọkachasị ma ọ bụrụ na ha efebeghị mbụ maọbụ na ha enwego ihe ọghọm mbụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ibi ụgbọ elu nwere ike ịbụ ihe na-atụ ụjọ maka ndị mmadụ nke afọ ọ bụla na ọdịdị dị iche iche, karịsịa ma ọ bụrụ na ha etu ụgbọ elu tupu ma ọ bụ ma ha nwetakwara mmerụ ahụ.

translations.source: It is not something to be ashamed of: it is no different from the personal fears and dislikes of other things that very many people have.
translations.reference: Ọ bụghị ihe ihere: ọ dịghị iche dị n'etiti ya na mmadụ inwe egwu gbasara ihe nwere ike ime na ndụ ya nakwa enweghi mmasị n'ihe ndị ọzọ nke ọtụtụ mmadụ nwere.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bụghị ihe ga-eme ka onye ji ebere: ọ dịghị iche na ụfụ na ihe ndị ọzọ na-adịghị n'anya nke ndị mmadụ ọtụtụ na-enwe.

translations.source: For some, understanding something about how aircraft work and what happens during a flight may help to overcome a fear which is based on the unknown or on not being in control.
translations.reference: Maka ụfọdụ, nghọta ihe gbasara otu ụgbọ elu si arụ ọrụ na ihe na-eme n'ime otu njem ụgbọelu nwere ike inye aka ịgabiga ụjọ nke dabere na ihe amaghị ma ọ bụ anọghị na njikwa.
translations.hypothesis: Dịka ụfọdụ mmadụ, ịmụta ihe dịka otú ọgbụgbuebe na-arụ ọrụ na ihe na-eme n'oge ụbọrọ, nwere ike inyere aka iwelite ụfụfụ nke bụrụsite n'ihe ndị a maara ma ọ bụ n'ihi na enweghị ikike ịleba anya.

translations.source: Courier companies are well paid for delivering things quickly. Frequently, time is very important with business documents, merchandise or spare parts for an urgent repair.
translations.reference: A na-akwụ ndị ụlọ ọrụ na-ebugharị ngwa ụgwọ nke ọma maka ibuga ihe ngwa ngwa. Kwa ugboro, oge dị ezigbo mkpa n'ebe akwụkwọ azụmahịa nọ, ngwa ahịa maọbụ akụkụ nnochite maka nrụzi igwe ọbụla ngwa ngwa.
translations.hypothesis: Ụlọ ọrụ ndị na-ebufe ngwaahịa na-eri ụgwọ dị elu maka ibufe ngwaahịa ngwa ngwa. Ọtụtụ oge, oge bụ ihe dị mkpa, ọkachasị mgbe ọ bụla maka akwụkwọ azụmahịa, ngwaahịa, ma ọ bụ akụrụngwa dị mkpa maka nrụzi ngwa ngwa.

translations.source: On some routes, the larger companies have their own planes, but for other routes and smaller firms there was a problem.
translations.reference: N’ụzọ ụfọdụ, ụlọ ọrụ ndị kara buo ibu nwere ụgbọ elu nke ha, mana maka ụzọ ndị ọzọ na obere ụlọ ọrụ ndị ọzọ enwere otu nsogbu.
translations.hypothesis: N'ọtụtụ ụzọ ọchịchị, ụlọ ọrụ ndị kasị ukwuu nwere ụgbọ elu ha nke onwe ha, mana maka ụzọ ndị ọzọ na ụlọ ọrụ ndị nta, enwere nsogbu.

translations.source: If they sent things by air freight, on some routes it may have taken days to get through unloading and customs.
translations.reference: Ọ bụrụ na ha jị ụgbọelu ziga ihe, n'ụfọdụ ụzọ, ikekwe ọ gaara ewe ọtụtụ ụbọchị igafere mbupusi na ndị kọstom.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bụrụ na ha zipụrụ ihe site n'ikpesa ụgbọ elu, n'ọtụtụ ụzọ, ọ nwere ike ịdọrọ ụbọchị ole ma ole iji kwụsọ ihe ndị a zuru ezu wee gaa n'ọdụ ụlọ ahịa.

translations.source: The only way to get it through faster was to send it as checked luggage. Airline regulations will not allow them to send luggage without a passenger, which is where you come in.
translations.reference: Naanị ụzọ a ga-esi ewefe ya ọsịịsọ wụbụ iziga ya dị ka ibu e nyochagoro. Iwu ụlọọrụ ụgbọelu agaghị ekwe ha izipụ ibu na-enweghị otu onye njem, nke bụ ebe ị ga-esi bata n'ime.
translations.hypothesis: Ụzọ pụrụ iche iji nweta ya ngwa ngwa bụ ịziputa ya dị ka akụrụngwa a na-elekwasị anya. Iwu ụgbọ elu anaghị akwụsị ha ịziputa akụrụngwa ọ bụla n'enweghị onye njem, ma ị bụ onye nwere ike inyere aka.

translations.source: The obvious way of flying in first or business class is to fork out a thick wad of money for the privilege (or, better yet, get your company to do it for you).
translations.reference: Ụzọ kachasị doo anya nke ife n’ime klaasị mbụ ma ọ bụ azụmahịa bụ iwepụta nnukwu ego maka urūàmàrà (ma ọ bụ, nke ka mma, mee ka ụlọ ọrụ gị mere gị ya).
translations.hypothesis: Ụzọ kachasị mfe iji eje ụgbọ elu n'okpuru ụlọ ọrụ ma ọ bụ ụlọ ọrụ azụmahịa bụ ịkwụ ụgwọ dị ukwuu iji nweta ohere ahụ (ma ọ dị mma, gwa ụlọ ọrụ gị ka ha mee ya maka gị).

translations.source: However, this does not come cheap: as rough rules of thumb, you can expect to pay up to four times the normal economy fare for business, and eleven times for first class!
translations.reference: Mana nke a adịghị ọnụ ala: dịka ihe i ga-ebu n'uche, lewe anya ịkwụ ugboro anọ ihe a na-akwụ maka ekọnọmi nkịtị maka biznes, na ihe ruru ugboro iri na otu maka fest klas!
translations.hypothesis: Otú ọ dị, nke a abụghị ihe dị mfe: dị ka atụmatụ dị mfe, ị nwere ike ịtụ anya ịkwụ ụgwọ ruo ụkwụ oge ụfọdụ maka ụlọ ọrụ, na ruo eleven oge ụfọdụ maka ụlọ ọrụ kacha elu!

translations.source: Generally speaking, there is no point in even looking for discounts for business or first-class seats on direct flights from A to B.
translations.reference: Ikwu n'ozuzu, ọ baghị uru ọbụna ị na-ele anya maka ụmụ mbelata maka ochie ndị azụmaahịa ma ọ bụ klaasị-mbụ n'ụmụ njem ụgbọelu ozugbo sitere na A ruo B.
translations.hypothesis: N'aka nke ọzọ, ọ gaghị ekwe omume ịhụ ụdị arụmụrụ ọzọ ma ọ bụ mmezi ọnụahịa maka oche ndị ahịa ma ọ bụ oche dị elu na ụbọrọ ndị na-aga ozugbo site na A gaa B.

translations.source: Airlines know well that there is a certain core group of flyers who are willing to pay top dollar for the privilege of getting somewhere fast and in comfort, and charge accordingly.
translations.reference: Ndị ụgbọ elu mara nke ọma na o nwere isi òtù ndị na-agba ụgbọ elu ndị nwere ike ịkwụ ezigbo ego maka urūàmàrà nke irute ebe ọzọ ọsịsọ nakwa n’ezigbo ọnọdụ, ma gbaa ụgwọ etu o kwesịrị.
translations.hypothesis: Ụkwu ụgbọ elu na-amara nke ọma na enwere otu ndị na-eji ụgbọ elu nke sitere na ụdị mmadụ ole na ole, bụ ndị nwere ọchịchọ ịkwụ ụgwọ dị ukwuu iji gaa ebe ọ bụla ngwa ngwa na n'ụdị dị mma, ma ha na-atụ ụgwọ ha dị ka ọ dị.

translations.source: The capital of Moldova is Chişinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is widely used.
translations.reference: Isiobodo nke Moldova bụ Chișinău. Asụsụ keobodo ahụ bụ Romanian, mana a na-ejikarị Rọshịan.
translations.hypothesis: Obodo n'isi nke Moldova bụ Chişinău. Asụsụ ndị bi n'ebe ahụ bụ Romanian, mana Russian na-eji ya nke ukwuu.

translations.source: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict.
translations.reference: Moldova mba nwere ọtụtụ-agbụrụ nke nke tagwere ahụhụ sitere na ndọkụrịta agbụrụ.
translations.hypothesis: Moldova bụ obodo obula nke nwere ọtụtụ ndị obodo dị iche iche, ma ewezuga ọtụtụ mgbe agha okpukpu ụka mere n'etiti ndị obodo ahụ.

translations.source: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised by any UN member country.
translations.reference: N'afọ 1994, ọgbaaghara a butere nkepụta Mba Transnistria kenkwupụta-onwe n'ime ebe ọwụwaanyanwụ Moldova, nke nwere ọchịchị na ego nke ya mana onweghi mba ọbụla so n'otu UN nabatara ya.
translations.hypothesis: N'afọ 1994, a mgbe agha ahụ malitere, e guzobere Repubọliki Transnistria, nke ha na-akpọ onwe ha, n'ebe ndịda-uto Moldova. Ọ nwere gọọmentị na ego ya, mana ọ naghị adị ka ọ bụ eziokwu site n'akụkụ mba ọ bụla nke nọ na United Nations.

translations.source: Economic links have been re-established between these two parts of Moldova despite the failure in political negotiations.
translations.reference: E dozigharịala njikọ akụnaụba dị n'etiti nkewa Moldova abụọ a n’agbanyeghi ọdịda na mkpakọrịta nkwe nke ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị.
translations.hypothesis: Ọbụna mgbe ọtụtụ mkparịta ụka ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị adịghị aghụta, mmekọrịta azụmahịa dị n'etiti akụkụ abụọ a nke Moldova emeela ka ọlaghachi.

translations.source: The major religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christian.
translations.reference: Okpukpe kachasị n'ime Moldova bụ Ụka Kraịstị Keọdịnala.
translations.hypothesis: Ọrụ ugbo bụ ihe kacha mkpa na Moldova.

translations.source: İzmir is the third largest city in Turkey with a population of around 3.7 million, the second biggest port after Istanbul, and a very good transport hub.
translations.reference: Izmir bụ obodo nke atọ kacha buo ibu na mba Tọkị nwere ọnụọgụgụ ndị mmadụ dị ihe dịka nde 3. 7, ọdụ ụgbọmmiri nke abụọ kacha buo ibu ma a gụpụ Istanbulu, na ọdụ ụgbọ njem dị ezigbo mma.
translations.hypothesis: Izmir bụ obodo nke atọ kacha ukwuu na Turkey, nwere mmadụ banyere 3.7 miriyọn, bụkwa ọdọ ụgbọ oloko kacha ukwuu nke abụọ mgbe Istanbul, yana ebe njemanya dị mma.

translations.source: Once the ancient city of Smyrna, it is now a modern, developed, and busy commercial center, set around a huge bay and surrounded by mountains.
translations.reference: Obodo ochie nke Smyrna na mbụ, ọ bụzi ugbu a otu ebe na-ewi ewi, mepere emepe, na azụmaahịa dịnọrụ, e wubere gburugburu otu nnukwu ọnụ mmiri ma ụmụ ugwu gbaakwa ya gburugburu.
translations.hypothesis: Ọdụgọ nke Smyrna ochie, ugbu a bụ obodo ọhịa, nke nwere ọganihu, na-adị ọcha, na-agba ọsọ, nke dị n'etiti osimiri dị ukwuu ma gbara ya gburugburu n'akụkụ uwe.

translations.source: The broad boulevards, glass-fronted buildings and modern shopping centers are dotted with traditional red-tiled roofs, the 18th century market, and old mosques and churches, although the city has an atmosphere more of Mediterranean Europe than traditional Turkey.
translations.reference: Ụmụ buulivadị ahụ sara mbara, ụlọ ndị nwere karama n'ihu ha na ebe ụlọ ahịa na-ewi ewi bụ ndị e wubechara n'iji eluụlọ taịlị-uhie keọdịnala, ụlọ ahịa narị afọ iri na asatọ ahụ, na ụmụ ụlọ alakụba na ụlọ ụka, agbanyeghị n'obodo ahụ nwere nkwụrụ nke kara bụrụ Mediterranean Yurop karịa Tọki keọdịnala.
translations.hypothesis: Ọdụ ụlọ dị ukwuu, ụlọ ndị nwere akwa glasị n'ihu, na ụlọ ahịa ndị ọgbakọ ahụ dị n'ebe ahụ, mana ha ejiri akwa ụlọ agba aja aja dị ka ndị Igbo na-eme, yana ahịa nke narị afọ nke iri na asatọ, ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ ochie, na ụkaachị na ụlọ ụka ochie. Agbanyeghị, obodo a nwere ọdịdị nke dị ka Europe nke Oké Osimiri Mediterrania, karịa ọdịdị nke Turkey dị mfe.

translations.source: The village of Haldarsvík offer views of the nearby island Eysturoy and has an unusual octagonal church.
translations.reference: Obodo Haldarsvik na-ekwe ka ahụta Eysturọị, agwaetiti dị ya nso, ma nwekwaa ụlọ ụka akụkụ asatọ pụrụ iche.
translations.hypothesis: Obodo Haldarsvík nwere ebe ndị mmadụ na-ele anya na ọkpụkpụ ebe obibi nke Eysturoy dị nso, yana ụlọ ibe nzuzo nke nwere ụdị ọkpụkpụ isiri asatọ.

translations.source: In the churchyard, there are interesting marble sculptures of doves over some tombs.
translations.reference: Na yaadị ụlọ ụka, e nwere ụmụ nduru akpụrụ n’ofe ụfọdụ ili na-adọrọ mmasị.
translations.hypothesis: N'ime obodo ụlọ igwe, enwere ọtụtụ ọkpụkpụ nke agwaetiti nke e jiri akwa na-acha ọcha eme, nke dị n'elu ụfọdụ ebe a kpọrọ.

translations.source: It's worth half an hour to stroll about the intriguing village.
translations.reference: Ọ meritere nkeji iri atọ iji gagharịa n’ime obodo ahụ na-akpali akpali.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ dị mma ịna-akwadebe ọkara awa iji gaa gbalịa ebe obodo a na-enwe mmasị.

translations.source: To the north and within easy reach is the romantic and fascinating town of Sintra and which was made famous to foreigners after a glowing account of its splendours recorded by Lord Byron.
translations.reference: Na aka-ugwu ma gburu-gburu dikwa nso igaru di obodo ihunanya na itunanya Sintra bukwa nke emere amara-amara nye ndi mba-ozo ka akowaputara idi-ukwu ya n’uzo egbuke-egbuke site na-aka Onye-nwe Byro.
translations.hypothesis: N'ebe ugwu, na ebe dị mfe ịga, bụ obodo Sintra, nke mara mma na nke na-atọ ọchị, nke akpọrọ aha n'etiti ndị mba ọzọ mgbe Lord Byron kọwara uru ya n'ụzọ dị mma.

translations.source: Scotturb Bus 403 travels regularly to Sintra, stopping at Cabo da Roca.
translations.reference: Bọọsụ 403 Scotturb na-eme njem mgbedum aga Sintra, na-akwụsị na Cabo da Roca.
translations.hypothesis: Ọkọ ifịzi Scotturb nọmba 403 na-aga Sintra kwa ụbọchị, na-agakọta na Cabo da Roca.

translations.source: Also to the north visit the great Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima (Shrine), a place of worldwide famous Marian apparitions.
translations.reference: Ọzọkwa n'ugwu leta nnukwu Ebe Nsọ nke Nwanyị Anyị nke Fatima (Ebenchụaja), otu ebe ama ama n'ụwa niile maka ụmụ ihe ngosipụta nke Marịa.
translations.hypothesis: Ọzọkwa, gaa n'ebe ndịda anyanwụ lee ụlọ nsọ nke "Our Lady of Fatima" (Shrine), bụ ebe a maara nke uwa niile maka ihe mere ebe ahụ, bụ nke a na-akpọ "Marian apparitions."

translations.source: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population.
translations.reference: biko cheta na ebe ina aga izute bu n’ezie ogige eliri otutu ozu, dika kwa nwere ihe-oputara ana agaghi agutali onu nye okere onu-ogugu uwa putara-ihe
translations.hypothesis: Biko, cheta na ị na-agụta ebe a bụ ebe ebe a na-etinye ahụ ndị nwụrụ, yana ebe nke nwere isi otu dị ukwuu maka ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ n'ụwa niile.

translations.source: There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike.
translations.reference: A ka nwere ọtụtụ ndị dị ndụ taa lanarịrị oge ha nọrọ ebe a, na ọtụtụ ndị ọzọ ndị nwere ndị ha hụrụ n'anya ndị e gburu ma ọ bụ jiri ọrụ gbuo ha ebe ahụ, ma Ndị Juu ma ndị ọzọ na-abụghị Ndị Juu.
translations.hypothesis: Ọtụtụ ụmụ nwoke na ụmụ nwanyị ka dị ndụ, ha bụ ndị nwetara ahụ nke oge ha nọ ebe ahụ, yana ọtụtụ ndị ọzọ nwere ezinụlọ nke ndị e gburu ma ọ bụ ndị a jidere ruo mgbe ha nwụrụ, ndị Juu na ndị ọzọ, niile.

translations.source: Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis.
translations.reference: Biko kwanyere webụsaịt a ugwu niile dịịrị ya. Ejila Họlọkọst maọbụ ndị Nazi eme ihe ụka ọchị.
translations.hypothesis: Biko, jiri uche dị mma, ọbụrụ, na nkwanye ọhụrụ n'iwu ụlọ ahụ. Akwụsịla ịmakụ okwu dị ichegbu onwe ma ọ bụ okwu gbasara "Holocaust" ma ọ bụ ndị "Nazi."

translations.source: Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.
translations.reference: Emebila saịtị ahụ site n'ise akara maọbụ ịkanye grafiti n'ime ihe ndi owuwu.
translations.hypothesis: Akụkụ a adịghị mma ịme ya ọnya ma ọ bụ ịkpụta akụkọ na ihe ndị dị n'ebe ahụ.

translations.source: Barcelona's official languages are Catalan and Spanish. About a half prefer to speak Catalan, a vast majority understands it, and virtually everyone knows Spanish.
translations.reference: Ụmụ isi asụsụ nke Baselona bụ Katalan na Spanish. Ihe dị ka ọkara kara chọọ ịsụ Katalan, imirikiti na-aghọta ya, ma onye niile kendịnuche mara Spanish.
translations.hypothesis: Asụsụ ndị ọchịchị Barcelona bụ Catalan na Spanish. Karịrị ọkara n'ime ha kọwara na ha chọrọ ịmakparịta Catalan, ọtụtụ ndị na-aghọta ya, ma ọtụtụ mmadụ maara Spanish.

translations.source: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.
translations.reference: Ma otu-osi-di, ihe-ngosi ka n’onu ogugu ka egosiri na asusu Catalan nani n’ihi na eguzosiri ya ike n’iwu dika asusu nke bu nke obodo.
translations.hypothesis: Otú ọ dị, ọtụtụ akwụkwọ ozi na-egosi ozi naanị n'asụsụ Catalan, n'ihi na iwu kọwara ya dị ka asụsụ ọkachamara mbụ.

translations.source: Yet, Spanish is also widely used in public transport and other facilities.
translations.reference: Ma, a na-ejikwa asụsụ ndị Spenụ njem ọha ebe ọ dị ukwuu nakwa akụrụngwa ndị ọzọ.
translations.hypothesis: Agụ, ụzọ Igbo Spanish na-eji akpọọrọ n'ọtụtụ ebe, gụnyere ụgbọ njem ọha na ụlọ ọrụ ndị ọzọ.

translations.source: Regular announcements in the Metro are made only in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced by an automated system in a wide variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.
translations.reference: A na-ama ọkwa mgbedum na Metro naanị na asụsụ Catalan, mana mmesasị nke a na-emeghị atụmatụ ya bụ ndị a na-ekwuputa site na sistemụ akpaghị aka n'ọtụtụ asụsụ dịgasị iche iche gụnyere Spanish, English, French, Arabic na Japanese.
translations.hypothesis: Ozi ndị a na-agwa na Metro na-agwa naanị n'asụsụ Catalan, mana mgbe mgbe enwere nsogbu na-abata, ozi gbasara ya na-agwa site na usoro eletrọniki n'ọtụtụ asụsụ dị iche iche, gụnyere Spanish, English, French, Arabic, na Japanese.

translations.source: Parisians have a reputation for being egocentric, rude and arrogant.
translations.reference: Ndi Parisi nwere aha imaara isi, nganga na mpako.
translations.hypothesis: Ndị bi na Paris nwere aha na ha bụ ndị na-ele onwe ha anya, ndị na-adị oke egwu, na ndị na-achị ọchị.

translations.source: While this is often only an inaccurate stereotype, the best way to get along in Paris still is to be on your best behavior, acting like someone who is "bien élevé" (well brought up). It will make getting about considerably easier.
translations.reference: Mgbe nke a na-abụkarị naanị nhụnuche na-ezighị ezi, ụzọ kachasị mma iji na-aga n’ihu n’ime Parii bụ na ị nọ n’omume gị kachasị mma, na-eme ka onye bụ "bien élevé" (a zụrụ nke ọma). Ọ ga-eme ka ngagharị n’ebe ahụ kara dị mfe.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bụ ezie na nke a bụkarị naanị otu echiche adịghị zọrọ, ụzọ kacha mma iji nwee ọdịmma na Paris bụ ịmere onwe gị nke ọma, dị ka onye "bien élevé" (onye zutere ọmụmụ mma). Ọ ga-eme ka ịga na iburu ihe ndị ọzọ dịkwuo mfe.

translations.source: Parisians' abrupt exteriors will rapidly evaporate if you display some basic courtesies.
translations.reference: Agwa ọjọọ Ndị Pari ga-akwụsị ọsịịsọ ma ọ bụrụ na i gosi ụfọdụ nruweisi nkịtị.
translations.hypothesis: Ọtụtụ ndị bi na Paris nwere ọdịdị dị egwu, mana ọ nwere ike ịgbanwe ngwa ngwa ma ọ bụrụ na ị na-eme ụfọdụ omume dị mma.

translations.source: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation.
translations.reference: Ebe nnọkọọha mba nke Ụmụ ndọrọ mmiri Plitvice nwere oke ọhịa, nwejuru ụmụ osisi beech, spruce, na fir, ma nweekwa mwụkọta nke Alpine na ahịhịa Mediterranean.
translations.hypothesis: Parki mba nke Plitvice Lakes bụ ebe eji ọhịa kpọrọ nkịtị, ọkachasị ọhịa beech, spruce, na fir, yana ọtụtụ ụdị osisi na akwụkwọ n'ime ọhịa Alpine na Mediterranean.

translations.source: It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude.
translations.reference: Onwere otutu osisi ama ama, maka ebea nwere klimeti di icheiche, aja ya di iche iche, altitude ya dikwa iche n’iche.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ nwere ọtụtụ ụdị osisi na akwụkwọ n'ime ya, n'ihi ọdịiche nke ihu igwe na ebe obibi, ụdị ala dị iche iche, na ọkwa ịdị elu dị iche iche.

translations.source: The area is also home to an extremely wide variety of animal and bird species.
translations.reference: Ebe a bụkwa ebe obibi nye ọtụtụ ụdị dị iche iche nke ụdị ụmụ anụmanụ na ụmụ nnụnnụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ebe ahụ bụkwa ebe nwere ọtụtụ ụdị anụmanụ na anụ ọhịa dị iche iche.

translations.source: Rare fauna such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, wild cat and capercaillie can be found there, along with many more common species
translations.reference: Ụmụ anụmanụ nke ebe obibi pụrụ iche nke anaghị ahụkarị dị ka anụ ọhịa bea ndị Yurop na-acha uri, agụ owulu, ugo, ikwiikwii, nwamba oke ọhịa linz, e nwere ike ịhụ nwamba oke ọhịa na eruru, ya na ọtụtụ ụdị ndị ọzọ a na-ahụkarị.
translations.hypothesis: Ụdị anụmanụ dị oke iche, dị ka arụsi Europe, ụjọ, ọkụkọ, ọkụkọ ọhịa, lynx, ụjọ ọhịa, na capercaillie, nwere ike ịgafe ebe ahụ, na ọtụtụ ụdị ndị ọzọ na-adịkarị.

translations.source: While visiting the monasteries, women are required to wear skirts covering the knees and have their shoulders covered, too.
translations.reference: Ụmụ nwanyị na-aga na monastrị ga-eyi sket na-ekpuchi ikpere ha ma mechiekwa ubu ha.
translations.hypothesis: Mgbe ụmụ nwanyị na-agba ụlọ oriri na ofufe, ha aghaghị ịkpụta uwe akwa na-ekpuchi ụkwụ ha, ma ọ bụghị naanị, kamakwa ha aghaghị ekpuchi akụkụ uwe ha.

translations.source: Most of the monasteries do provide wraps for women who come unprepared, but if you bring your own, especially one with bright colors, you'll get a smile from the monk or nun at the entrance.
translations.reference: Ọtụtụ n'ime ebe obibi ndị mọnk na-enye akwa mkpuchi maka ụmụ nwanyị ndị bịara na-adịghị njikere, mana ọ bụrụ na ị weta nke gị, tụmadị nke nwere agba chapụrụ achapụ, ị ga enweta otu mmụmụ ọnụ ọchị sitere na mọnk ma ọ bụ nọn nọ n'ọnụ ụzọ ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ọtụtụ monasterị na-enye akwa iji kpọchie ụmụ nwanyị ndị bịara na-enweghị otu, mana ọ bụrụ na ịwetara gị onwe gị, karịsịa otu nwere agba ndị mara mma, ị ga-enweta ọchịchọ nke monki ma ọ bụ nun na ngosi ụzọ.

translations.source: Along the same line, men are required to wear trousers covering the knees.
translations.reference: N'otu ụzọ ahụ, a chọrọ ka ụmụ nwoke na-eyi ụmụ traụza na-ekpuchi ikpere.
translations.hypothesis: N'otu ụzọ ahụ, ndị nwoke aghalịrị ịkpụ ọkpụkpụ nke na-ekpuchi ụkwụ ha.

translations.source: This too can be borrowed from the stock at the entrance but that clothing isn't washed after every user so you may not feel comfortable wearing these skirts. One size fits all for men!
translations.reference: E nwere ike ịgbaziri nke a kwa site n'akwa ndị nọ n'ọnụ ụzọ mana anaghị asa akwa ahụ ma mmadụ yichaa ya mere ị nwere ike ị gaghị enwe ahụ iru ala iyi sket ndị a. Otu nha na-adaba ụmụ nwoke niile!
translations.hypothesis: Ọrụ a pụkwara ịgbatị ya site na ihe ndị dị na ụzọ n'ime ụlọ, mana akwa ahụ adịghị ewu mgbe ọ bụla onye ọ bụla ji ya, ya mere ọ nwere ike ịbụ na ị gaghị eji ya n'ụzọ dị mma. Otú ọ dị, akwa ahụ dabara ụmụ nwoke niile!

translations.source: Majorcan cuisine, like that of similar zones in the Mediterranean, is based on bread, vegetables and meat (specially pork), and uses olive oil throughout.
translations.reference: Nri ndị Majorca, dị ka nke ndị mpaghara ndị yiri ya n'ime Mediterranean, na-adabere n'achịcha, akwụkwọ nri na anụ (tụmadị anụ ezi), ma na-eji mmanụ oliv mgbe niile.
translations.hypothesis: Nri Majorca, dịka nri ndị ebe ndị ọzọ yiri ya na Oké Osimiri Mediterranean, dabere n'akụ, osisi, na anụ (karịsịa anụ ọpụ), ma jiri mmanụ oliv dị iche iche.

translations.source: A simple popular dinner, especially during the summer, is the Pa amb Oli: Bread with olive oil, tomato, and any available condiments such as cheese, tunafish, etc.
translations.reference: Pa amb Oli bụ nri abalị dị mfe nke amaara ọkachasị n'oge sọma: Achịcha na mmanụ oliv, tomato, na ụmụ orishirishi ndị ọzọ dị adị dịka chiizi, azụ tuna, dzg.
translations.hypothesis: Ụtọ nri dị mfe na ọtụtụ mmadụ na-eri, karịsịa n'oge ọkụkọ, bụ "Pa amb Oli": akụ na mmanụ oliv, tomato, na akụkụ ọzọ dị ka chiiz, tuna, wdg.

translations.source: All nouns, alongside the word Sie for you, always begin with a capital letter, even in the middle of a sentence.
translations.reference: Aha niile, tinyere okwu Sie maka gị, na-ebidokarị n’iji mkpụrụ edemede ukwu, ọbụnadị n’etiti ahịrịokwu.
translations.hypothesis: Okwu niile, na okwu "Sie" nke pụtara "gị," na-amalite mgbe niile na akwụkwọ ndụ akwụkwọ ndụ, ọbụlagodi na n'etiti okwu.

translations.source: This is an important way to distinguish between some verbs and objects.
translations.reference: Ụzọ a bụ ụzọ dị mkpa e si amata ihe dị iche n’etiti ụfọdụ ngwaa na nnara.
translations.hypothesis: Nke a bụ ụzọ dị mkpa iji kpọọsa dị iche n'etiti ụfọdụ okwu na ihe.

translations.source: It also arguably makes reading easier, though writing is somewhat complicated by the need to find out whether a verb or adjective is used in a substantivized form.
translations.reference: Ọ na-emekwa ka ọgụgụ dị mfe karịa, mana edemede bịara ratụ ahụ maka aghaghị ịmara ma ngwaa maọbụ nkọwa aha ọbụla ọ bụ mpụta ahịrịokwu ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ nwekwara ike ịmere ka ịgụ akwụkwọ bụrụ nke dị mfe, ọ bụ ezie na ịna-ede akwụkwọ na-adịkarị ịtụkwasị obi n'ihi mkpa ịchọpụta ma ọ bụrụ na okwu ma ọ bụ ihe atụ bụ nke eji eme ka ọ bụrụ ihe omume.

translations.source: Pronunciation is relatively easy in Italian since most words are pronounced exactly how they are written
translations.reference: Mkpọpụta okwu dịtụ mfe n' Ịtalịan ebe ọtụtụ mkpụrụokwu bụ ndị a na-akpọpụta kpọmkwen etu esi dee ha
translations.hypothesis: Ọ dị mfe ịgụ okwu Igbo n'asụsụ Italy, n'ihi na ọtụtụ okwu etu esi agụ ha bụ otu etu ha edebiwo.

translations.source: The main letters to watch out for are c and g, since their pronunciation varies based on the following vowel.
translations.reference: Ụmụ isi mkpụrụabịdịị ndị a ga-elesi anya maka bụ c na g, ebe mkpọpụta ha na-adị iche na-ndabere na ụdaume na-esote.
translations.hypothesis: Akwụkwọ ụda bụ "c" na "g" bụ ndị anyị ga-elekwasị anya, n'ihi na ụda ha na-agbanwe dịka akwụkwọ ụda nke na-eso ha.

translations.source: Also, make sure to pronounce r and rr differently: caro means dear, whereas carro means chariot.
translations.reference: Jisiekwa ike hụ na ị kpọpụtara r na rr n'ụzọ dị iche. caro pụtara ezigbo, ebe carro pụtara ụgbọ ịnyịnya.
translations.hypothesis: Ọzọkwa, jide n'aka na ị na-akọwa ụda "r" na "rr" iche iche: "caro" pụtara "ọkpara," ebe "carro" pụtara "ọkwọ ụgbọ."

translations.source: Persian has a relatively easy and mostly regular grammar.
translations.reference: Asụsụ Peshịa nwere ụtọasụsụ kacha dị mfe ma bụrụ nke a kacha agbaso.
translations.hypothesis: Asụsụ Persia nwere usoro akụkọ na-adịkarị mfe, ọkachasị usoro akụkọ nke na-adị otu.

translations.source: Therefore, reading this grammar primer would help you learn much about Persian grammar and understand phrases better.
translations.reference: Ya bu igu akwukwo uto asusu ga enyere gi aka imuta maka uto asusu Persia makwa ghota ahiriokwu ofuma.
translations.hypothesis: Ya mere, ịgụ akwụkwọ a gbasara usoro okwu ahụ ga-enyere gị aka ịmụta ọtụtụ ihe gbasara usoro okwu nke Persian, ọ bụkwa ga-enyere gị aka ịghọta okwu ndị ọzọ nke ọma.

translations.source: Needless to say, if you know a Romance language, it will be easier for you to learn Portuguese.
translations.reference: Ọ baghị uru ikwu, ọ bụrụ na ị mara otu asụsụ Ịhụnanya, ọ ga-adịtụ mfe ịmụta asụsụ Pọtụgiiz.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ dịkarịa mma ịsị, ọ bụrụ na ị maara asụsụ ọdịda anyanwụ, ọ ga-adị gị mfe ịmụ asụsụ Portuguese.

translations.source: However, people who know a little Spanish may hastily conclude that Portuguese is close enough that it need not be studied separately.
translations.reference: Agbanyeghi, ndị mara asụsụ Spenụ obere nwere ike ikpebi ọsịịsọ na ya na asụsụ Pọtugiizi yrir nke ọma na o kwesịghị ka a mụọ ya n’iche.
translations.hypothesis: Otú ọ dị, ndị na-amụkarịasị Spanish nwere ike ịgwa ngwa ngwa na Portuguese yiri ya nke ukwuu, ya mere ọ gaghị ekwe omume ịmụ ya n'onwe ya.

translations.source: Pre-modern observatories are usually obsolete today, and remain as museums, or sites of education.
translations.reference: Ọbzavetrị ndị oge gara aga anaghị abachazi uru taa; e jizi ha eme ụlọ ndokwa ihe nka maọbụ ebe mmụta.
translations.hypothesis: Ọtụtụ ụlọ nyocha nke ochie, nke etụbeghị akụkọ, abụghị nke ọma taa, ma ha ka nọrịrị dị ka ụlọ ihe ngosi, ma ọ bụ ebe mmụta.

translations.source: As light pollution in their heyday was not the kind of problem it is today, they are usually located in cities or at campuses, easier to reach than those built in modern times.
translations.reference: Dị ka mmetọ keọkụ n'isimbụ ha abụghị ụdị nsogbu ọ bụ ugbu a, a na-ahụkarị ha n'ime obodo ma ọ bụ na kampọs, nke dị mfe irute karịa ndị ahụ arụrụ n'oge ugbu a.
translations.hypothesis: N'ihi na mmiri ọkụ na-emetụta ha adịghị dị ka ọ na-adị taa, ha na-adịkarị na obodo ma ọ bụ n'ụlọ akwụkwọ, ebe ha dị mfe ịga karịa ndị e wuru n'oge ochie.

translations.source: Most modern research telescopes are enormous facilities in remote areas with favorable atmospheric conditions.
translations.reference: Otutu teliskop eji eme resaach n'oge ugbu a bu nnukwu ulo oru di n'ebe dipuru adipu nwere ezigbo ihu igwe.
translations.hypothesis: Ọtụtụ teleskopọ nyocha nke oge a bụ ụlọ ọrụ dị ukwuu nke dị na mpaghara dịpụrụnke, ebe e nwere ikuku dị mma.

translations.source: Cherry blossom viewing, known as hanami, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century.
translations.reference: Nlere ifuru Cheri, nke a maara dị ka hanami, bụ omenala na Japan kemgbe nari afọ nke 8.
translations.hypothesis: Ịhụ akwụkwọ cherry na-egbuke egbuke, nke a na-akpọ "hanami," abụrụla akụkụ nke ọdịnala Japan kemgbe narị nke asatọ.

translations.source: The concept came from China where plum blossoms were the flower of choice.
translations.reference: Echiche ahụ sitere na mba Chaịna bịa ebe plum blossom bụ okooko kacha amasị.
translations.hypothesis: A magụkwa a si na China, ebe akwụkwọ plum bụ akwụkwọ a họọrọ karịa ndị ọzọ.

translations.source: In Japan, the first cherry blossom parties were hosted by the emperor only for himself and other members of the aristocracy around the Imperial Court.
translations.reference: Na Japan, Onye eze Emperọ haziri mmemme mkpụrụ osisi cheri izizi maka naanị ya na ndị otu ndị ọzọ na-ahụ maka ọchịchị Ụlọ ikpe etiti.
translations.hypothesis: Na Japan, emume ndị mbụ maka ife cherry (akwụkwọ osisi na-acha ọbara ọbara) malitere site n'aka onye ala (emperor), mana ọ bụ naanị maka ya na ndị ọzọ nwere ọkwa dị elu n'ụlọ ọwụwa anya.
