translations.source: Plants look their best when in a natural environment, so resist the temptation to remove even "just one" specimen.
translations.reference: Ụmụ akụmakụ na-adị n'ụdị ha kacha mma mgbe ha nọ na gburugburu ebe obibi ekere, ya mere gbochie ọnwụnwa iwepụ ọbụna "naanị otu" ihe nlere.
translations.hypothesis: Ahụ anụ ọchịchị na-adị mma karị mgbe ha dị n'ebe ebe dị n'ime okirikiri, ya mere, gbalịa ịgaghị akpa anya ịchụpụ otu anụ ọchịchị ma ọ bụ ọkara otu.

translations.source: If visiting a formally arranged garden, collecting "specimens" is also going to get you ejected, without discussion.
translations.reference: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-eleta otu ubi ahazigoro etu o kwesịrị, ị na-ewere "ụmụ ihe nlere" ga-eme ka a chụpụ gị, na-emeghị mkparịta ụka.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-agba ụlọ ogige nke e rụrụ ya nke ọma, ị na-atụgharị ihe ndị ahụ (ihe ndị e ji eme ihe) ga-ewepụta gị, na-enweghị ọ bụla mkparị.

translations.source: Singapore is generally an extremely safe place to be and very easy to navigate, and you can buy almost anything after arriving.
translations.reference: Singapore bu kwanu ebe di mma ino makwa igaghari ma inwere ike igote ihe o bula i choro ma irute.
translations.hypothesis: Singapore bụ ebe dị mma na dị ọha, ọ bụkwa ebe dị mfe iji gaa ebe ọ bụla, yana ị nwere ike ịzụta ihe ọ bụla ịchọrọ mgbe ị ruru ebe ahụ.

translations.source: But being placed in the "high tropics" just a few degrees north of equator you will need to deal with both heat (always) and strong sun (when the sky is clear, more rarely).
translations.reference: Mana ị na-edobe gị n'ime "ebe ndị na-ekpo oke ọkụ" ị ga-achọ naanị digiri ole na ole n'ugwu nke ikwuetọ imeso ma ekpomọkụ (mgbe niile) ma anwụ siri ike (mgbe elu igwe kpochara ekpocha, nke kara raa ahụ omume).
translations.hypothesis: Mana, ebe a dị nso na "ebe oké ọhụrụ," dịka obere oge n'ebe ugwu nke ekwe, ị ga-enwe ụdị mmiri ozuzo na ọkụ (n'oge niile), yana ọkụ anyanwụ siri ike (mgbe igwe na-adị ọcha, ọ na-abịakarị).

translations.source: There are also a few buses going north to Hebron, the traditional burial place of the Biblical patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and their wives.
translations.reference: E nwekwara ụfọdụ burumbu na-aga mgbago ugwu ruo Hebrọn, ebe ọdịnala e liri ndị nnaochie nke akwụkwọ nso bụ Ebraham, Aịzik, Jekọb, na ndị nwunye ha.
translations.hypothesis: E nwekwara ụfọdụ ụgbọ oloko na-aga n'ebe ndịda anyanwụ, na-aga Hebron, ebe a na-eburu ndị patriachị nke Akwụkwọ Ibe Ya, bụ Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, na nwunye ha, ụlọ.

translations.source: Check that the bus you are thinking of taking goes into Hebron and not just to the nearby Jewish settlement of Kiryat Arba.
translations.reference: Lelee na bọọsụ ị na-eche maka ịbanye na ya na-aga Hebron ma ọ bụghị naanị na ebe obibi ndị Juu nke Kiryat Arba dị nso.
translations.hypothesis: Lelee ma hụ na ụgbọ oloko ị na-eche banyere ịnya ya na-aga Hebron, ọ bụghị naanị na obere obere obodo ndị Juu nke Kiryat Arba.

translations.source: Inland waterways can be a good theme to base a holiday around.
translations.reference: Ụzọ mmiri ndị ime obodo nwere ike ịbụ ezigbo isiokwu iji hazie oge ezumike.
translations.hypothesis: Ọrụ mmiri dị n'ime ala nwere ike ịbụ ihe omume dị mma iji mee ka ọdịnala ahụ dị mkpa.

translations.source: For example visiting castles in the Loire Valley, the Rhine valley or taking a cruise to interesting cites on the Danube or boating along the Erie Canal.
translations.reference: Maka ọmụmatụ ileta ụmụ nnukwu ụlọ n’ime Ndagwurugwu Loire, Ndagwurugwu Rhine ma ọ bụ ime njem ụgbọ mmiri gaa obodo ndị na-adọrọ mmasị n’ime Danube ahụ ma ọ bụ ịgba ụgbọ mmiri n’ogologo ụzọ Kanaal Erie ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ịga leta ụlọ ndị e ji akwa na mpaghara Loire, mpaghara Rhine, ma ọ bụ ịga njem n'ọdọ mmiri na obodo ndị dị mkpa na osimiri Danube, ma ọ bụ ịnya ọdọ n'okporo mmiri Erie.

translations.source: They also define routes for popular hiking and cycling trails.
translations.reference: Ha na akọwapụtakwa ụmụ ụzọ a ga-eso maka ụzọ haịkịnụ na ọghụgha igwe ama ama.
translations.hypothesis: Ha nwekwa ike ịkọwa ụzọ maka ụzọ ndị a na-eji maka ịnya ụkwụ na ịnya igwe ndị a ma ama.

translations.source: Christmas is one of the most important holidays of Christianity, and is celebrated as the birthday of Jesus.
translations.reference: Ekeresimesi bụ otu n’ime ezumike kachasị mkpa nke Ndị na-eso Ụzọ Kraịst, ma a na-eme ememme ya dị ka ncheta omumu Jizos.
translations.hypothesis: Kọlịsịmas bụ otu n'ime ememme kacha mkpa na Kristiana, ma a na-emem ya dị ka ụbọchị ọmụmụ Jisiịs.

translations.source: Many of the traditions surrounding the holiday have been adopted also by non-believers in Christian countries and non-Christians around the world.
translations.reference: Ndi na-ekweghi na Chukwu na mba ndi otu Kristi gasi ma ndi n’abughi ndi otu Kristi n’uwa niile anabatago otutu odinala enwere maka oge ezumike.
translations.hypothesis: Ọtụtụ usoro na ọdịnala ndị metụtara ụbọchị ahụ emeela ka ndị na-adịghị akwụsị uche na Kristiana na mba ndị Kristiana, yana ndị na-adịghị na Kristiana n'ụwa niile, jikwa ha.

translations.source: There's a tradition to pass the Easter night awake at some exposed point to see the sunrise.
translations.reference: Enwere ọdịnala maka ịmụ anya n'abalị Ista n'ebe mepere emepe iji hụ ọwụwa anyanwụ.
translations.hypothesis: E nwere usoro ka ndị mmadụ na-awụli elu na abalị Easter, na-eri n'ebe ọdịda anyanwụ na-apụta, iji hụ anyanwụ na-ebili.

translations.source: There are of course Christian theological explanations for this tradition, but it may well be a pre-Christian Spring and Fertility ritual.
translations.reference: Enwere n'ezie nkọwa na nkà mmụta okpukpe nke Ndị Kraịst maka ọdịnala a, mana ọ nwere ike bụrụ emume ọmụmụ tupu nchụaja Oge mmiri na Ọmụmụ nwa Ndị Kristi abịa.
translations.hypothesis: Ọtụtụ ihe omume dị n'ime usoro okpukpe Kraist, mana ọ nwere ike ịbụ usoro ọdịnala nke e mere tupu Kraist, nke na-echeta mgbe mmiri na-ebili na ọganihu.

translations.source: More traditional churches often hold an Easter Vigil on Saturday night during the Easter weekend, with the congregations often breaking into celebration at the stroke of midnight to celebrate Christ's resurrection.
translations.reference: Ọtụtụ ụlọụka agba ochie na-amụkarị anya abalị Ista n'abalị Satọde n'oge ngwụcha izu Ista, ebe ndị ụka na-abanye na mmemme ma ọ kụọ elekere abụọ nke etiti abalị iji mee mmemme mbilite n'ọnwụ Kraịstị.
translations.hypothesis: N'ọtụtụ ụka ochie, a na-eme emume nke "Easter Vigil" na abali Saturday mgbe ehihie n'oge izu Easter. Ndị otu ụka ahụ na-adịkarị ka ha na-emeri egwu na akụkọ ife mgbe elekere na-agba elekere nke elekere iri na abụọ nke abalị, iji cheta ọganihu Kristus.

translations.source: All animals that originally arrived in the islands came here either by swimming, flying or floating.
translations.reference: Ụmụ anụmanụ niile ndị nke bịarutere n’ime agwaetiti ndị ahụ bịarutere ebe a site n’igwu mmiri, ife efe ma ọ bụ ise n’elu mmiri.
translations.hypothesis: Ufọdụ ụmụ anụmọrụ niile bụ ndị bịara n'isi ụko ahụ n'oge mbụ, bịara ebe a site n'ịgbọ, igwe, ma ọ bụ site n'ịgafe n'elu mmiri.

translations.source: Due to the long distance from the continent mammals were unable to make the journey making the giant tortoise the primary grazing animal in the Galapagos.
translations.reference: N'ihi ogologo ntoanya site na kọntinentị ahụ ụmụ anụ na-an̄ụ ara enwenwughị ike ịga njem ahụ ya mere na-eme nnukwu mbe isi anụmanụ na-ata ahịhịa n'ime Galapagos ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: N'ihi ogologo ọdịda anya site na ala ahụ, anaghịzi enwekarị ụmụ anụmanụ na-agba njem, ya mere, ụkọ mmanụ dị ukwuu bụ ụmụ anụmanụ kachasị mkpa na-eri ọkụkọ na Galapagos.

translations.source: Since the arrival of man to the Galapagos, many mammals have been introduced including goats, horses, cows, rats, cats and dogs.
translations.reference: Ke,gbe mbịarute nke mmadụ na Galapagos, ewebatala ọtụtụ anụ na-an̄ụ ara gụnyere ewu, inyinya, ehi, oke, nwamba na nkịta.
translations.hypothesis: Kemgbe mmadụ bịara n'akụkụ Galapagos, ọtụtụ anụmanụ na-ebu akpụ na-abata, gụnyere ụkọ, ahịa, nkita, ọtụtụ ụdị ọtụtụ, ụta, na nkita.

translations.source: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic areas in the winter you will experience the polar night, which means that the sun doesn't rise above the horizon.
translations.reference: Ọ bụrụ na ị leta ụmụ ebe Aktik ma ọ bụ Antatik n'ime oge oyi ị ga-enwe ahụmihe nke abalị pola, nke pụtara na anyanwụ agaghị awa na horaịzọn ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ bụrụ na ị gaa ebe Arctic ma ọ bụ Antarctic n'oge ọkụ, ị ga-ahụ "abali nke akụkụ ụwa," nke pụtara na anyanwụ ahụ adịghị ebili elu.

translations.source: This offers a good opportunity to see the Aurora borealis, as the sky will be dark more or less around the clock.
translations.reference: Nke a na-enye ezigbo ohere iji hụ Aurora borealis, dị ka eluigwe ga-agba itiri karịa ma ọ bụ obere gburugburu elekerea ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: Nke a na-enye ohere dị mma iji hụ Aurora Borealis, n'ihi na ọkụ nke elu igwe ga-adị ọchịchịkarama karịa n'oge niile.

translations.source: As the areas are sparsely populated, and light pollution therefore often not a problem, you will also be able to enjoy the stars.
translations.reference: Dika ebe ndị ahụ bụ ebe ndị mmadụ ebichabeghị etu ahụ, na mmetọ nke ọkụ ya mere anaghị abụkarị nsogbu, ị ga-enwekwa ike ịnụ ụtọ ụmụ kpakpando.
translations.hypothesis: N'ihi na obere mmadụ bi n'ebe ndị ahụ, ọ bụkwa ebe ebe ọkụ na-acha ọkụ adịghị eme ka enweghị nsogbu, ị ga-enwekwa ohere ịcheta ihe ndị dị n'elu igwe.

translations.source: Japanese work culture is more hierarchical and formal that what Westerners may be used to.
translations.reference: Omenala ọrụ ndị Japan nwere ogugo na iwu dị iche iche karịa ihe ndị ọdịda anyanwụ maara.
translations.hypothesis: Ọrụ na Japan nwere usoro na ụkpụrụ kasị ukwuu karịa otú ndị Westernụ na-achọpụta.

translations.source: Suits are standard business attire, and coworkers call each other by their family names or by job titles.
translations.reference: Suutu uwe azụmaahịa izugbe, ma ndị ọrụ ibe na-akpọ onye ọ bụla site n'aha ezinụlọ ha ma ọ bụ site n'aha ọrụ ha.
translations.hypothesis: Uwe ọrụ bụ uwe a na-eji n'ọrụ, ndị ọrụ na-akpọ ibe ha n'aha ezinụlọ ha ma ọ bụ n'aha ọrụ ha.

translations.source: Workplace harmony is crucial, emphasizing group effort rather than praising individual accomplishments.
translations.reference: Nkwekorita nke ebe oru di nkpa, na-ekwusi ike na mbọ otu karịa ito ụmụ mmezu nke otu onye.
translations.hypothesis: Ọ dị mkpa inwe udo na ebe ọrụ, ebe a na-akpọrọ ọrụ otu kpamkpam, ọ bụghị naanị ịkpọrọ mmeri nke onye ọ bụla.

translations.source: Workers must often get their superiors' approval for any decisions they make, and are expected to obey their superiors' instructions without question.
translations.reference: Ndi oru kwesiri inweta nkwado onye isi ha maka mkpebi obula ha ga ekpebi, ha kwesikwara irube isi n’ozi o bula onye isi ha ziri ha n’ajughi ajuju.
translations.hypothesis: Ọrụ ndị ọrụ ga-adịkarị na-enweta ikike nke ndị nchịachị anya ha tupu ha mee ihe ọ bụla, ma a tụrụ anya na ha ga-agbaso iwu ndị nchịachị anya ha n'enweghị ajụjụ ọ bụla.
